AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统提供经济专家群体通胀偏好的全球性实证证据；识别出驱动专家通胀偏好异质性的三个关键机制；将专家偏好与政策评价联系起来，拓展了货币政策偏好对政策影响的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为央行理解专家群体对通胀目标的看法提供了实证参考；有助于央行在设计通胀目标框架和沟通策略时考虑专家偏好的多样性；提示政策制定者关注专家偏好对政策评价和公众信心的潜在影响。

title: A Regressive Shock? The Distributional Consequences of Middle East Conflict-Driven Inflation for German Households
affiliations: Universidad Loyola Andalucía,  and

detail.title: A Regressive Shock? The Distributional Consequences of Middle East Conflict-Driven Inflation for German Households
detail.abstract: The escalation of the conflict in the Middle East in late February 2026 led to a sharp upward revision in inflation forecasts for Germany, which we attribute primarily to the conflict itself. Using microsimulation methods adapted to simulate a commodity price change, we translate this forecast revision into upper bounds on household-specific purchasing-power losses via a compensating variation approach, distinguishing the loss recovered through consumption taxes from the full loss including the pre-tax transfer to producers. Both measures are sizeable and regressive: in 2026, the average household loses 0.25% of income through the tax channel and 1.15% under the full measure, with bottom-decile losses of 0.63% and 2.87% against 0.12% and 0.65% for the top decile. The Gini coefficient rises by up to 0.14 points, and elderly households are disproportionately affected. Our results show that a supply-side shock originating outside Europe can have a sizeable and unequal impact on household living standards.

AI.tldr: 本文利用微观模拟方法，将2026年2月德国因中东冲突升级导致的通胀预测上修转化为家庭购买力损失的上界估计，发现该损失规模可观且呈累退性（即低收入家庭受损更重），并导致基尼系数上升，老年家庭受冲击尤为严重。
AI.research_question: 外部供给冲击（中东冲突）通过通胀渠道对德国家庭购买力造成了多大的损失？这种损失在不同收入群体和年龄群体之间如何分配？
AI.motivation: 2026年2月末中东冲突升级导致德国通胀预测大幅上修，但现有研究缺乏对家庭层面分配效应的量化分析。理解外部供给冲击对家庭福利的异质性影响，对政策制定具有重要价值。
AI.theoretical_framework: 补偿变差（compensating variation）方法、微观模拟（microsimulation）方法、消费税收传导分析
AI.method: 采用自适应的微观模拟方法模拟商品价格变动，通过补偿变差方法将通胀预测修订转化为家庭层面的购买力损失上界估计。区分两种损失测量：通过消费税回收的损失和包含税前转移给生产者的完全损失。
AI.findings: 2026年德国平均家庭通过税收渠道损失收入的0.25%，完全损失为1.15%。损失具有显著累退性：最底层十分位家庭损失0.63%和2.87%，而最顶层十分位仅损失0.12%和0.65%。基尼系数最多上升0.14个百分点，老年家庭受损尤为严重。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将外部地缘政治冲突通过通胀渠道对家庭福利的影响进行微观层面量化，揭示了供给冲击在家庭层面的累退性分配效应，拓展了外部冲击传导至家庭福利的机制理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为德国及欧洲政策制定者提供了外部冲突冲击下不同家庭群体受损程度的量化依据，有助于设计针对低收入和老年家庭的有针对性的补偿政策。

title: Fiscal Sustainability and Sovereign Risk Pricing: Evidence from Time-Varying Fiscal Reaction
affiliations: Bielefeld University - Department of Business Administration and Economics

detail.title: Fiscal Sustainability and Sovereign Risk Pricing: Evidence from Time-Varying Fiscal Reaction
detail.abstract: This paper investigates whether fiscal sustainability is priced in sovereign bond markets. For this purpose, we construct a standard measure of fiscal sustainability for 21 EU countries, namely, a time-varying fiscal reaction coefficient measuring the response of the cyclically adjusted primary balance to lagged debt. Next, we examine the response of sovereign yield spreads and credit default swap (CDS) to our fiscal sustainability parameter within a panel data framework. The results from static and dynamic linear panel models do not reveal statistically significant effects of fiscal sustainability on sovereign risk premia. However, nonlinear regime-switching estimations indicate significant threshold effects. In particular, fiscal sustainability exerts a significant effect on sovereign bond spreads once public debt exceeds a threshold of approximately 60% of GDP. The evidence for CDS spreads is mixed. For a subsumple of Eurozone group of countries, the threshold effect is more pronounced. Overall, the findings suggest that sovereign debt markets become more sensitive to fiscal sustainability considerations when public debt levels exceed the Maastricht threshold.

AI.tldr: 本文研究财政可持续性是否在主权债券市场中被定价。通过构建21个欧盟国家随时间变化的财政反应系数（衡量周期调整后的初级财政余额对滞后债务的响应），并运用面板数据框架检验该参数对主权收益率利差和信用违约互换（CDS）的影响。静态和动态线性面板模型未发现显著效应，但非线性区制转换估计揭示了显著的阈值效应：当公共债务超过GDP约60%时，财政可持续性对主权债券利差产生显著影响，欧元区国家尤为明显。
AI.research_question: 财政可持续性是否被主权债券市场定价？即财政可持续性指标是否显著影响主权收益率利差和CDS利差。
AI.motivation: 此前研究大多关注债务水平、赤字等财政变量对主权风险溢价的影响，但鲜有研究直接检验财政可持续性（作为综合动态指标）是否被市场定价。理解市场何时以及如何对财政可持续性变化做出反应，对于政策制定和投资者决策具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 财政反应函数理论（财政可持续性定义为基础财政盈余对债务水平的反应系数）；主权风险定价理论；非线性区制转换模型；阈值效应理论（马斯特里赫特标准60%债务阈值）。
AI.method: 首先构建21个欧盟国家的时变财政反应系数作为财政可持续性指标；然后采用静态和动态线性面板数据模型检验财政可持续性对主权收益率利差和CDS利差的影响；最后使用非线性区制转换（threshold/regime-switching）估计方法检验阈值效应，并区分欧元区与非欧元区子样本进行稳健性分析。
AI.findings: （1）静态和动态线性面板模型中，财政可持续性对主权风险溢价没有统计上显著的影响；（2）非线性区制转换估计显示存在显著的阈值效应，当公共债务超过GDP约60%时，财政可持续性对主权债券利差产生显著影响；（3）CDS利差的证据较为混合；（4）欧元区子样本中阈值效应更为显著；（5）总体表明主权债务市场在公共债务超过马斯特里赫特阈值（60%）时对财政可持续性更为敏感。
AI.theory_contributions: （1）首次将时变财政反应系数作为财政可持续性度量引入主权债券定价研究，为财政可持续性与市场定价的关系提供了新的实证证据；（2）揭示了线性模型中不显著的效应在非线性框架下可能显著，说明财政可持续性对利差的影响具有非线性、状态依赖的特征；（3）实证验证了马斯特里赫特60%债务阈值在市场定价中的实际相关性，衔接了制度性财政规则与市场行为。
AI.practical_contributions: （1）对政策制定者而言，表明财政可持续性在债务水平超过60%阈值后才会引起市场关注，低于该阈值时财政调整的市场压力较小；（2）对投资者而言，提供了主权债券和CDS定价中财政可持续性因素是否被纳入的判断依据，有助于风险管理；（3）对欧盟财政框架的讨论提供了实证支持，说明马斯特里赫特标准不仅具有制度意义，也具有市场定价意义。

title:
Mapping Diplomatic Representation in Europe, 1648-1715 
New Data from the Repertorium der diplomatischen Vertreter
affiliations: University of Gothenburg - Department of Political Science

detail.title:
Mapping Diplomatic Representation in Europe, 1648-1715 
New Data from the Repertorium der diplomatischen Vertreter
detail.abstract: This paper introduces new data on diplomatic representation in Europe between 1648 and 1715, drawn from Band I of the Repertorium der diplomatischen Vertreter aller Länder. The data comprise 13,344 diplomatic missions, exchanged among 141 sending and 201 receiving polities, and 8,852 individual representatives. The paper describes the source and coding procedure, assesses the quality and limits of the data, and reports patterns in participation, rank, and mission duration. In an illustrative application, I use the data to examine diplomatic continuity across ruler successions, with findings suggesting that individual appointments remained tied to the person of the ruler even as the relationships they served proved durable. The dataset will be useful for research on recognition and membership in the states system, status and hierarchy among polities, and the formation of the early modern state. Data collection will continue, and Bands II and III will extend the series to 1815.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了1648-1715年间欧洲外交代表的新数据集，包含13,344次外交使团、141个派遣国、201个接收国及8,852名代表。文章描述了数据来源和编码过程，评估了数据质量与局限，并展示了在外交连续性方面的示例性应用。
AI.research_question: 如何构建1648-1715年间欧洲外交代表的系统数据集，并利用该数据考察外交连续性等核心问题？
AI.motivation: 早期现代欧洲的外交体系缺乏系统性的量化数据，限制了对国家体系成员资格、地位等级和早期现代国家形成等重大议题的实证研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 国际关系中的国家体系理论、承认与成员资格理论、地位与等级理论、早期现代国家形成理论
AI.method: 基于Repertorium der diplomatischen Vertreter aller Länder第一卷档案，建立系统数据库，采用描述性统计和示例性应用分析（考察统治者更替前后的外交连续性）
AI.findings: 数据涵盖了13,344次外交使团、141个派遣国和201个接收国，共8,852名代表。示例性分析发现：即使外交关系本身具有持久性，个人任命仍与特定统治者的个人密切相关。
AI.theory_contributions: 为研究国家体系中的承认与成员资格、政治体之间的地位与等级、以及早期现代国家形成提供了全新的系统性基础数据，弥补了该领域量化数据不足的空白。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了可扩展、可复现的外交历史数据集，后续Band II和III将把数据延伸至1815年，为更广泛的研究群体提供公共数据资源。

title: Factory Parents, Classroom Outcomes: Occupational Networks and Peer Effects in Education

detail.title: Factory Parents, Classroom Outcomes: Occupational Networks and Peer Effects in Education
detail.abstract: We study how exposure to classmates from manufacturing and production worker families affects academic achievement in urban Chinese middle schools. Exploiting the random assignment of students to classrooms within school-grade cohorts in the China Education Panel Survey (CEPS), we find that a ten-percentage-point increase in the share of peers with production worker parents reduces standardized academic scores by approximately 0.21 standard deviations. The effect is robust and statistically significant across all specifications, and present for all three core subjects (mathematics, Chinese language, and English). We investigate mechanisms using rich parent questionnaire data. Exposure to the working-class peer families significantly reduces other parents' engagement with children's friendship networks, particularly the inter-family social connections and peer-relationship communication that require bridging social capital, as well as school discussion frequency, parental confidence in children's academic futures, and parent-initiated teacher contact. Parents in classrooms with more working-class families also report systematically lower evaluations of the educational environment. Heterogeneity analysis reveals that the effect is stronger for students from non-low-income families, consistent with higher initial social capital endowments amplifying the cost of peer-composition shifts. Falsification tests using business and service sector workers, who share comparable earnings and education levels but work in more socially interactive occupations, yield uniformly null effects across all outcomes. These findings reveal how occupational class composition of the classroom shapes the parental social capital networks that support children's education, with implications for school integration policies and class-based educational inequality in rapidly industrializing economies.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用中国教育追踪调查（CEPS）中学生在班级内的随机分配，发现与产业工人家庭子女同班比例每增加10个百分点，会使标准化学业成绩下降约0.21个标准差。机制在于工人阶层同班家庭降低了其他家长参与子女友谊网络、家校互动和学校环境的评价，反映了职业阶层构成通过家长社会资本影响教育结果。
AI.research_question: 与来自制造业和生产工人家庭的同班同学接触如何影响城市中国中学生的学业成绩？其背后的机制是什么？
AI.motivation: 在快速工业化的经济体中，职业阶层构成如何通过家长社会资本影响教育不平等尚不清晰。既有研究多关注同伴效应本身，而较少关注同班家庭职业阶层如何影响其他家长的社会网络参与和教育支持行为。
AI.theoretical_framework: 社会资本理论（尤其是桥接型社会资本）、同伴效应理论、阶层构成的教育外部性理论
AI.method: 利用CEPS数据中学生到班级的随机分配作为准自然实验，采用OLS回归估计同伴效应；使用丰富的家长问卷数据进行机制检验；进行异质性分析和以商业服务业工人家庭为对照的证伪检验。
AI.findings: （1）工人阶层同班比例每增加10个百分点，标准化成绩下降约0.21个标准差，且对数学、语文、英语三科均显著；（2）机制上，工人阶层同班家庭显著降低了其他家长在子女友谊网络参与（尤其需要桥接社会资本的家庭间联系和同伴关系沟通）、学校讨论频率、对子女学业未来的信心以及家长主动联系教师的行为；（3）家长对班级教育环境的评价系统性降低；（4）异质性显示对非低收入家庭学生影响更强；（5）以收入和教育水平可比但职业更具社交互动性的商业服务业工人为对照的证伪检验结果均为零。
AI.theory_contributions: 将职业阶层构成引入同伴效应研究，揭示了班级阶层构成通过家长社会资本网络（而非仅学生间互动）影响教育结果的机制路径，扩展了社会资本理论与教育分层研究的交叉领域。
AI.practical_contributions: 为学校融合政策和班级分配策略提供实证依据，提示政策制定者关注班级职业阶层混合对家校互动和家长参与的影响，有助于缓解快速工业化经济体中的阶层教育不平等。

title: Inside the Black Box: Class Environment and Performance in Chinese Middle Schools

detail.title: Inside the Black Box: Class Environment and Performance in Chinese Middle Schools
detail.abstract: This paper jointly examines three theoretically distinct dimensions of classroom social environment-teacher-student relationship quality, peer academic norms, and peer relationship quality-and their effects on student academic achievement. Using two waves of the China Education Panel Survey (CEPS), a nationally representative panel of 7,653 middleschool students across 112 schools (2013-2015), we estimate value-added models with school fixed effects, rich baseline controls, and multiple robustness specifications. A one-standarddeviation improvement in teacher-student relationship quality predicts a 0.045-SD gain in composite academic achievement, stable across class fixed effects, change-in-environment, and ability-tracking subsamples. A one-SD improvement in peer academic norms predicts a 0.049-SD gain, confirmed by Double Machine Learning. Peer relationship quality is null in the full model; psychological safety promotes achievement while social cohesion modestly crowds out academic effort through social time substitution. Peer norm effects are largest for students with low prior ability and rural household registration, consistent with academically oriented peer norms functioning as a compensating resource for students with fewer external academic supports. Mechanism analysis shows that within teacher-student quality, instructional engagement dominates emotional support in a 1.7-to-1 ratio; within peer norms, academic values exert more than twice the effect of behavioral effort conformity, favoring an aspirational over a conformity-based interpretation of peer influence. We develop a novel reverse-causality falsification test exploiting within-index heterogeneity in sensitivity to performance feedback.

AI.tldr: 本文利用中国教育追踪调查（CEPS）两波面板数据，联合检验课堂社会环境的三个理论维度——师生关系质量、同伴学业规范、同伴关系质量——对学生学业成就的影响。研究发现师生关系质量每提升一个标准差带来0.045个标准差的成绩提升，同伴学业规范每提升一个标准差带来0.049个标准差的提升，而同伴关系质量总体效应不显著。研究还揭示了心理安全感与社交凝聚力的不同作用机制，以及同伴规范对低能力和农村户籍学生的补偿性作用。
AI.research_question: 课堂社会环境的三个理论维度（师生关系质量、同伴学业规范、同伴关系质量）如何分别影响学生的学业成就？各自的作用机制是什么？
AI.motivation: 以往研究往往将课堂社会环境作为单一构念处理，未能区分其三个理论上截然不同的维度。此外，课堂社会环境与学生成绩之间的因果关系受到反向因果和遗漏变量偏差的困扰，缺乏严格的因果识别策略和机制分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 课堂社会环境理论（将课堂环境分为师生关系、同伴规范、同伴关系三个维度）；社会比较与同伴影响理论；心理安全理论；社交时间替代理论；补偿性资源理论。
AI.method: 使用增值模型（value-added models），结合学校固定效应和丰富的基线控制变量；采用班级固定效应、环境变化模型、能力分层子样本等多种稳健性检验；运用Double Machine Learning（DML）验证同伴学业规范效应；开发新颖的反向因果证伪检验，利用指标内对表现反馈敏感性的异质性。
AI.findings: （1）师生关系质量每提升1个标准差预测0.045个标准差的学业成绩提升；（2）同伴学业规范每提升1个标准差预测0.049个标准差的提升，经DML验证；（3）同伴关系质量在完整模型中效应为零，其中心理安全感促进学业，而社交凝聚力通过社交时间替代温和挤出学业努力；（4）同伴规范效应对低初始能力和农村户籍学生最大，体现补偿性作用；（5）机制上，师生关系中教学投入对情感支持的效应比为1.7:1；同伴规范中学术价值观的效应是行为努力遵从的两倍以上，支持抱负性而非遵从性的同伴影响解释。
AI.theory_contributions: （1）将课堂社会环境分解为三个理论维度并分别估计其效应，推进了课堂环境理论的精细化；（2）提出同伴影响的"抱负性"解释优于"遵从性"解释，深化了同伴效应理论；（3）识别出心理安全感与社交凝聚力的差异化机制，补充了社交时间替代理论；（4）开发了反向因果证伪检验的新方法，为教育因果推断提供了方法论贡献。
AI.practical_contributions: （1）为教师培训提供指导：教学投入比情感支持更重要（1.7:1），可优化教师资源配置；（2）提示学校营造学术价值导向的同伴文化比单纯规范行为更能提升成绩；（3）为教育干预的精准定位提供依据：同伴学业规范干预应优先针对低能力和农村户籍学生；（4）为政策制定者理解课堂社会环境如何"补偿"外部支持不足提供实证证据。

title: The Scandinavian Greenium: Sector Asymmetry and Currency Effects in Green Bond Pricing
affiliations: Grenoble Ecole de Management, Grenoble Ecole de Management, Grenoble Ecole de Management and

detail.title: The Scandinavian Greenium: Sector Asymmetry and Currency Effects in Green Bond Pricing

declarations.declarationOfInterest: All authors declare that they have no conflict of interest.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This article does not contain any studies with human participants or animals performed by any of the authors.
declarations.funderStatement: The authors received no financial support for the research, authorship, and/or publication of this article.

detail.abstract: Scandinavian bond markets are among the world's most sustainability-oriented, yet evidence on their green bond pricing remains limited. Using 55,900 bond-month observations for 1,883 bonds issued in Norway, Sweden, and Denmark between 2018 and 2025, we examine whether the greenium is a broad market feature or concentrated in specific segments. We find a modest market-wide greenium of about 6 basis points, but this average masks a sharp sector asymmetry: government green bonds trade at a persistent 9 to 16 basis point yield discount, while corporate green bonds show no significant greenium. We also show that omitting currency effects inflates the estimated greenium to 26 basis points. These findings suggest that the Scandinavian greenium is concentrated in government bonds and that currency composition is a key methodological issue in multi-currency green bond markets.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用2018-2025年间挪威、瑞典和丹麦三国1,883只债券的55,900个债券-月度观测值，检验斯堪的纳维亚绿色债券市场的greenium（绿色溢价）。研究发现市场整体存在约6个基点的温和greenium，但这一平均值掩盖了显著的部门不对称：政府绿色债券存在9-16个基点的持续收益率折价，而企业绿色债券没有显著的greenium。此外，忽略货币效应会使greenium被高估至26个基点。
AI.research_question: 斯堪的纳维亚债券市场的绿色溢价（greenium）是广泛的市场特征，还是集中在特定细分市场中？
AI.motivation: 斯堪的纳维亚债券市场是全球最具可持续性导向的市场之一，但关于其绿色债券定价的证据仍然有限。现有研究缺乏对多货币绿色债券市场中greenium的系统性检验，特别是部门（政府vs企业）差异性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 绿色债券定价理论、绿色溢价（greenium）理论、资产定价中货币效应理论
AI.method: 使用2018-2025年挪威、瑞典、丹麦三国1,883只债券的55,900个债券-月度观测值，通过面板回归等方法检验绿色债券与传统债券的收益率差异，并分析部门（政府vs企业）和货币效应的调节作用。
AI.findings: 1) 市场整体存在约6个基点的温和greenium；2) 政府绿色债券存在9-16个基点的持续收益率折价，而企业绿色债券无显著greenium；3) 忽略货币效应会显著高估greenium（从6个基点膨胀至26个基点）。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 揭示了绿色溢价在市场中并非均匀分布，而是在政府部门集中；2) 指出多货币绿色债券市场研究中的一个关键方法学问题——货币效应处理不当会严重扭曲greenium估计。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者和政策制定者提供了斯堪的纳维亚绿色债券定价的实证证据；强调了在跨货币绿色债券分析中正确处理货币效应的必要性，对后续研究和投资决策具有方法论指导意义。

title: The Insurance Gap: Liability Frameworks for Ontological Attacks on Clinical AI
affiliations: Martin-Luther-University Halle-Wittenberg and

detail.title: The Insurance Gap: Liability Frameworks for Ontological Attacks on Clinical AI
detail.abstract: The European Union's AI Act and the European Health Data Space regulate the technical compliance and data quality of clinical artificial intelligence systems, but neither addresses liability for a distinct category of attack: the ontological attack, in which adversarial inputs corrupt the semantic layer of clinical terminology systems rather than their technical infrastructure. Existing cyber-insurance products cover the confidentiality, integrity, and availability triad but not the case in which data is technically intact while semantically corrupted. Drawing on an adversarial ontology threat taxonomy recently formalised in the clinical AI literature (Stummer 2026), we map six attack categories to existing insurance product classes, identify two categories (terminology poisoning and semantic drift induction) for which no coverage exists, and provide a Fermi estimate of the uninsured annual exposure in the European Union of approximately EUR 2 to 5 billion, with a central estimate of EUR 3 billion. We propose a three-layer liability framework distinguishing technical, semantic, and ontological damage, discuss moral hazard and adverse selection implications, and analyse three regulatory pathways: soft-law guidance from the European Insurance and Occupational Pensions Authority, amendment of Article 15 of the AI Act to require liability cover for high-risk clinical AI systems, and market-led standardisation through a Lloyd's or Munich Re pilot product. Limitations: the market-size estimate is Fermi-anchored rather than actuarial; documented ontological-attack incident data do not yet exist; the regulatory focus is the European Union, with United States and Asian markets analysed only secondarily; the proposed insurance products are conceptual and require dedicated actuarial modelling before underwriting feasibility can be assessed.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了欧盟《人工智能法案》和《欧洲健康数据空间》监管框架的空白：它们未涵盖"本体论攻击"（对抗性输入腐蚀临床术语系统的语义层）的赔偿责任。研究将六种攻击类别映射至现有保险产品，识别出两种无保险覆盖的类别（术语投毒和语义漂移诱导），并对欧盟年度未保险敞口给出Fermi估计（约20-50亿欧元，中心估计30亿欧元），提出三层责任框架及三条监管路径。
AI.research_question: 面对临床人工智能系统遭受的本体论攻击（语义层腐蚀），现有的欧盟监管框架和保险产品是否存在责任覆盖空白？应如何设计保险产品和监管路径来应对这一新型风险？
AI.motivation: 欧盟《人工智能法案》和《欧洲健康数据空间》仅监管临床AI的技术合规与数据质量，但本体论攻击通过对抗性输入腐蚀临床术语系统的语义层，不涉及技术基础设施破坏。现有网络安全保险仅覆盖CIA三元组（保密性、完整性、可用性），无法覆盖"数据技术上完好但语义上被腐蚀"的情形，导致此类风险既无监管也无保险保障。
AI.theoretical_framework: Stummer（2026）提出的对抗性本体威胁分类法；三层责任框架（区分技术损害、语义损害和本体论损害）；保险经济学中的道德风险与逆向选择理论。
AI.method: 将六种攻击类别与现有保险产品类别进行映射分析；采用Fermi估算（而非精算方法）估计欧盟年度未保险敞口；提出三层责任框架概念模型；分析三种监管路径的可行性。
AI.findings: 在六种攻击类别中，两种（术语投毒和语义漂移诱导）不存在任何现有保险覆盖；欧盟年度未保险敞口估计为20-50亿欧元，中心估计为30亿欧元。
AI.theory_contributions: 将先前临床AI文献中形式化的本体论威胁分类法拓展至保险与责任领域；提出了区分技术、语义和本体论损害的三层责任框架，填补了现有CIA三元组框架无法应对语义层攻击的理论空白。
AI.practical_contributions: 为欧盟监管机构提供三条可选择的监管路径（EIOPA软法指引、修订AI法案第15条要求高风险临床AI系统购买责任保险、通过劳合社或慕尼黑再保险试点产品推动市场标准化）；为保险公司开发本体论攻击保险产品提供概念基础。

title: First They Came for the Others: A Theory of Divide-and-Conquer
affiliations: Columbia University, Hong Kong University of Science & Technology (HKUST) and Hong Kong University of Science & Technology (HKUST) - Department of Economics

detail.title: First They Came for the Others: A Theory of Divide-and-Conquer
detail.abstract: Divide-and-conquer tactics often succeed not through mechanical coordination failures, but through epistemic friction regarding an aggressor's underlying intent. When an attacker strikes a first target, bystanders must infer whether the assault represents a localized grievance or a systemic campaign. If the attack is rationally interpreted as particularized, bystanders abstain, prompting the isolated victim to surrender. We demonstrate how higher attack costs and lower correlation between victims' fates facilitate this division. We then study how behavioral responses, rhetoric, treaty commitments, and downstream defense networks modify this inference.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了"分而治之"策略如何通过"认知摩擦"而非机械性协调失败来产生效果。攻击者打击首个目标时，旁观者需推断袭击是局部怨愤还是系统性运动；若被理性解读为特定性攻击，旁观者会袖手旁观，迫使孤立受害者屈服。研究显示更高的攻击成本和受害者命运间更低的关联性会促进这种分化，并考察了行为反应、修辞、条约承诺和下游防御网络如何调节这一推断过程。
AI.research_question: 攻击者如何通过影响旁观者对攻击意图的推断（将系统性攻击解读为局部攻击）来实现"分而治之"策略，以及哪些因素会调节这种认知推断过程？
AI.motivation: 传统的分而治之理论多聚焦于协调失败的机械性解释，忽略了认知层面的关键机制。作者试图从"认知摩擦"（epistemic friction）角度重新理解这一经典政治策略，解释旁观者为何在面对袭击时选择不干预。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于信号博弈和贝叶斯推断的理论框架，将攻击者的意图视为不确定信息，旁观者通过观察首轮攻击行为来更新对攻击者意图（局部性vs系统性）的信念，从而决定是否干预。
AI.method: 理论建模与形式化分析，通过博弈论模型考察攻击成本、受害者命运相关性、行为反应、修辞、条约承诺和防御网络等因素如何影响旁观者的推断和干预决策。
AI.findings: （1）更高的攻击成本和受害者命运间更低的关联性会促进"分而治之"策略的成功；（2）行为反应、修辞策略、条约承诺和下游防御网络等制度与行为因素会显著改变旁观者对攻击意图的认知推断，进而影响是否干预的决策。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"认知摩擦"（epistemic friction）作为理解分而治之策略的新理论视角，弥补了传统解释中仅关注协调失败而忽视信息与信念推断过程的不足；为攻击成本、命运关联性等因素对集体行动的影响提供了微观认知基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为潜在受害者和旁观者提供了识别系统性攻击的认知工具，有助于设计更有效的防御联盟和条约承诺机制；为理解如何通过制度安排（如条约、防御网络）降低认知摩擦、增强集体防抗能力提供了实践指导。

title: Cryonic Trusts and the Architecture of Indefinite Control
affiliations: The University of Georgia

detail.title: Cryonic Trusts and the Architecture of Indefinite Control
detail.abstract: Thousands of Americans have been cryonically frozen or have arranged to be frozen after death in hopes that they will one day be revived. Reanimation remains scientifically impossible, but estate planning has not treated that impossibility as a reason to wait. The cryotrust exists to spare a successfully revived decedent the indignity of being resurrected and poor by placing wealth in storage: a modest $1 million investment, compounded for a century with no distributions and no transfer tax to slow it down, emerges worth over $2 billion, waiting for a settlor who may never return to claim it. This Article argues that the cryotrust is not a futuristic curiosity but a logical, doctrinally ordinary product of a trust law that has spent decades hollowing out the safeguards meant to keep it tethered to living people and finite time. Drawing on the concepts of reification and tilt, the Article argues that cryotrusts are troubling precisely because they are unremarkable: the modern dynasty trust, the asset protection trust, and the offshore trust all share the same architecture, and all depend upon treating a legal form as a neutral "thing" rather than a set of contestable social and distributive choices. The cryotrust is offered here as a diagnostic case study, not a call to regulate cryonics, but rather an argument that the proper unit of analysis is the system of trust law that produced this result, not any single statute. The Article closes with a menu of reforms designed to restore temporal and beneficiary-based limits without sacrificing the flexibility that makes trust law valuable.

AI.tldr: 本文以"冷冻信托"（cryotrust）为诊断性案例，论证其并非未来主义的新奇事物，而是信托法数十年来逐步掏空其与活人和有限时间相关的保障机制后的逻辑产物。文章借助物化（reification）和倾斜（tilt）概念，指出冷冻信托之所以令人不安，恰恰是因为它毫不引人注目——现代王朝信托、资产保护信托和离岸信托共享同一架构，都将法律形式视为中性的"物"而非可争议的社会与分配选择。文章最后提出一系列改革方案，旨在在不牺牲信托法灵活性的前提下恢复时间和受益人限制。
AI.research_question: 冷冻信托（cryotrust）是如何成为信托法体系的一个符合逻辑的、教义上平凡的产物？这一现象揭示了信托法体系的哪些深层问题？
AI.motivation: 数千名美国人已被冷冻或安排死后冷冻以期未来复活，尽管复活在科学上仍不可能。冷冻信托将财富置于长期存储——100万美元投资、一个世纪不分配不缴税，可增值至20亿美元，等待一个可能永远不会回来的设立人。这一极端案例暴露了信托法体系中已被掏空的核心保障机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 物化（reification）概念——将法律形式视为中性"物"而非可争议的社会选择；倾斜（tilt）概念——分析法律规则如何偏向特定利益和结果。
AI.method: 以冷冻信托作为诊断性案例研究的法律分析，比较现代王朝信托、资产保护信托和离岸信托的共有架构，论证其共享同一法律逻辑。
AI.findings: 冷冻信托令人不安之处恰恰在于其"毫不引人注目"（unremarkable）：它与现代王朝信托、资产保护信托和离岸信托共享相同的架构基础，都依赖将法律形式物化为中性"物"而非可争议的社会选择。问题不在冷冻技术本身，而在于产生这一结果的信托法系统。
AI.theory_contributions: 将冷冻信托作为信托法体系的诊断性透镜，论证恰当的分析单位是产生该结果的整个信托法系统而非任何单一法规；揭示信托法通过物化机制对财产永续和受益人限制等传统保障的逐步消解。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出一套改革方案菜单，旨在恢复信托法的时间和受益人限制，同时保留信托法赖以为价值的灵活性；阐明对冷冻信托的关注不应简单化为对冷冻技术的监管呼吁。

title: Legal Risk Management in M&A Transactions
affiliations: O.P. Jindal Global University - Jindal Global Law School

detail.title: Legal Risk Management in M&A Transactions
detail.abstract: As modern economic complexity increases, effective risk management dictates the success of corporate restructuring. This dissertation examines critical legal risks encountered during the Mergers and Acquisitions (M&A) process and outlines strategic methods to mitigate or prevent them. It specifically addresses the rising threat of social media on transaction confidentiality, evaluating how well-crafted Non-Disclosure Agreements (NDAs) can control unauthorized diligence and public leaks. Furthermore, the study analyzes the legal and structural challenges associated with cross-border M&A deals under the Indian regulatory framework—including merger control thresholds and compliance liabilities—supported by practical insights from an in-house counsel interview and notable corporate case studies. Identifying and tracking these transaction vulnerabilities in a timely manner ultimately enables executives to execute robust corporate decisions and safeguard business assets.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨并购（M&A）过程中的关键法律风险，重点研究社交媒体对交易保密性的威胁、保密协议（NDA）的控制机制，以及印度跨境并购监管框架下的法律和结构性挑战，通过内部法律顾问访谈和著名企业案例研究提供实践洞见，帮助管理层及时识别和防范交易漏洞。
AI.research_question: 并购过程中存在哪些关键法律风险？如何通过战略性方法缓解或预防这些风险？特别是在社交媒体威胁交易保密性和印度跨境并购监管框架下，如何有效管理这些风险？
AI.motivation: 随着现代经济复杂性增加，有效的风险管理决定企业重组的成败。并购过程中的法律风险日益突出，尤其是社交媒体对交易保密性的威胁以及跨境并购面临的复杂监管环境，亟需系统性的研究和战略应对。
AI.theoretical_framework: 并购法律风险管理理论、保密协议（NDA）法律框架、印度跨境并购监管法规（包括并购控制门槛和合规责任）
AI.method: 采用规范分析与案例研究相结合的方法，包括内部法律顾问访谈、著名企业并购案例分析，以及对印度跨境并购监管框架的法律与结构性分析。
AI.findings: 精心设计的保密协议（NDA）能够有效控制未经授权的尽职调查和公众信息泄露，特别是针对社交媒体对交易保密性的威胁；跨境并购在印度监管框架下面临合并控制门槛和合规责任等法律与结构性挑战。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统梳理了并购过程中的关键法律风险类型，将社交媒体对交易保密性的新兴威胁纳入并购法律风险管理框架，并深化了对印度跨境并购监管环境下法律风险的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为高管提供了识别和追踪交易漏洞的实务指引，提出了通过NDA等工具缓解并购法律风险的战略方法，帮助企业管理者做出稳健的公司决策并保护商业资产。

title: AI Advice Suppresses People's Willingness to Say, "I Don't Know", Even When the Advice Is Wrong and Accuracy is Incentivized
affiliations: Sorbonne University - École Normale Supérieure, University of Rome Sapienza and Università degli Studi di Milano-Bicocca - Department of Psychology

detail.title: AI Advice Suppresses People's Willingness to Say, "I Don't Know", Even When the Advice Is Wrong and Accuracy is Incentivized

declarations.ethicsApproval: This work has been approved by the Committee for Research Evaluation (CRIP) of the University of Milan-Bicocca, Psychology Department.

detail.abstract: Knowing when to say "I don't know" is fundamental to human judgment, yet AI assistants offer a fluent answer to almost any question. In five experiments (N = 3,132; four preregistered, one direct replication), participants answered difficult questions and could always decline to respond. We engineered the questions so that AI advice was wrong, separating AI use from its accuracy. Merely having access to AI nearly eliminated participants' willingness to suspend judgment, and this held whether the advice was actively requested or simply displayed. Consequently, participants answered more questions but were correct about a third as often as when AI was unavailable-yet their confidence nearly doubled. Incentivizing accuracy and penalizing inaccuracy led participants to seek and follow AI advice less, answer more accurately, and suspend judgment more often, though still far less than when AI was unavailable. As AI suggestions grow ubiquitous and unsolicited, they may not simply affect answer accuracy; they may even alter the metacognitive threshold at which people decide whether they know enough to answer.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过五项实验（N=3,132）发现，仅仅拥有AI建议（即使是错误的）就会几乎完全消除人们在不确定时拒绝回答（暂停判断）的意愿。这导致参与者回答更多问题但正确率仅为无AI时的三分之一，而自信程度却几乎翻倍。即使通过激励措施鼓励准确性和惩罚错误，虽然能部分恢复暂停判断行为，但仍远不及无AI条件。研究表明AI建议可能改变人们决定"是否知道足够多可以回答"的元认知阈值。
AI.research_question: AI建议的可获得性是否会改变人们在不确定时暂停判断（说"我不知道"）的意愿，从而影响判断的元认知阈值？
AI.motivation: 人类判断中"知道何时说我不知道"是基本能力，但AI助手几乎对任何问题都能给出流畅回答。作者旨在探究AI建议（即使错误）是否会侵蚀人类暂停判断的能力，以及这种影响是否可以通过激励措施来缓解。
AI.theoretical_framework: 元认知理论（metacognition），涉及个体对自身知识状态的监控和判断，以及决定回答还是暂停判断的认知阈值。
AI.method: 五项实验（N=3,132），其中四项为预注册实验，一项为直接复制实验。参与者回答困难问题并可选择拒绝回答。实验设计确保AI建议是错误的，以分离AI使用与其准确性。操纵变量包括AI建议的有无、建议获取方式（主动请求vs被动展示）、以及激励措施（奖励准确/惩罚错误）。
AI.findings: （1）仅仅拥有AI访问权限就几乎完全消除了参与者在不确定时暂停判断的意愿；（2）这一效应在主动请求或被动展示AI建议时均成立；（3）参与者回答更多问题但正确率约为无AI时的三分之一，同时自信心几乎翻倍；（4）激励准确性并惩罚错误可以减少AI建议的寻求和遵循、提高准确性并增加暂停判断，但仍远低于无AI条件下的水平。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了AI建议不仅影响答案准确性，还可能改变个体决定"是否知道足够多可以回答"的元认知阈值，为理解AI对人类判断的深层认知影响提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 对AI助手的广泛部署和无处不在的自动化建议（包括非请求式建议）提出了重要警示，表明AI可能在不经意间削弱人类认知的自我监控能力，即使AI提供错误建议且用户被激励追求准确性也是如此。

title: Know the Economy, not the Data Lake: Country Structure and the Right Number of Indicators in a GDP Nowcast
affiliations: and

detail.title: Know the Economy, not the Data Lake: Country Structure and the Right Number of Indicators in a GDP Nowcast
detail.abstract: How many indicators should a GDP nowcast use, and how should that number be chosen? A common answer is to add every available series and let a factor model or a machine-learning method separate signal from noise. We argue that this misplaces the effort for most economies. The number of indicators that can help is bounded by how many distinct sources of cyclical signal an economy generates, which is a feature of its structure rather than of the available data. We write the choice as a bias-variance trade-off. The accuracy-maximising count k * rises with the sample length and with the number of orthogonal signal dimensions, and it falls with volatility, so less-diversified economies nowcast best with fewer indicators. We test this on twelve economies. Each faces the same harmonised menu of headline indicators, informed by the blocks that published flagship nowcasts use, over a common 2000 to 2026 out-of-sample window. The optimum is smaller in emerging economies (mean 3.2 against 6.4; p = 0.026), and it is explained by economic complexity (0.61) rather than income (0.35, not significant). Norway is the identifying case. It is rich but resource-concentrated, and its optimum sits with the emerging economies, where complexity predicts it and income does not.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨GDP即时预测（nowcast）中应使用多少指标的问题，提出指标数量应受经济结构产生的正交信号维度约束，而非数据可得性。通过偏差-方差权衡框架，作者推导出最优指标数量k*与样本长度和信号维度正相关，与波动性负相关。基于12个经济体2000-2026年共同时段、统一指标菜单的样本外测试，发现新兴经济体的最优指标数平均为3.2，发达经济体为6.4（p=0.026），且最优指标数由经济复杂度（相关性0.61）而非收入水平（0.35，不显著）解释。挪威作为识别案例，尽管富裕但资源集中，其最优指标数与新兴经济体接近。
AI.research_question: GDP即时预测应该使用多少个指标，以及如何选择这个数量？
AI.motivation: 现有文献普遍认为应纳入所有可得序列并让因子模型或机器学习方法从噪声中分离信号，但作者认为这种思路在许多经济体中放错了努力方向，因为能有效帮助预测的指标数量受经济体结构（正交信号维度）的限制而非数据丰富度。
AI.theoretical_framework: 偏差-方差权衡（bias-variance trade-off）框架；最优指标数量k*的理论推导。
AI.method: 理论推导最优指标数量k*的表达式；对12个经济体进行实证测试，使用统一的标准指标体系（参考已发布旗舰即时预测所用的模块），在2000-2026年共同样本外窗口中进行比较。
AI.findings: 新兴经济体最优指标数平均为3.2，发达经济体为6.4（p=0.026）；最优指标数可由经济复杂度解释（相关性0.61），而非收入水平（0.35，不显著）；挪威作为富裕但资源集中的经济体，其最优指标数落在新兴经济体区间。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出一次性设定即时预测中指标数量的理论框架，将指标数量选择形式化为偏差-方差权衡，并识别出经济结构（信号维度）而非数据可得性为指标数量的根本约束。
AI.practical_contributions: 为各国（特别是新兴经济体）的即时预测实践提供了指标数量选择的实用指导：经济复杂度低的资源型经济体或新兴经济体应使用更少的指标，而非贪多求全。

title: Dynamic Income-Oriented Pension Investment Model
affiliations: Comenius University - Faculty of Mathematics, Physics and Informatics; Department of Applied Mathematics and Statistics

detail.title: Dynamic Income-Oriented Pension Investment Model
detail.abstract: We present a stochastic dynamic model of retirement saving with maximization of the expected utility of pension income. In contrast to traditional models, we change the paradigm from value-oriented to income-oriented. The model uses SeLFIES (Standard-of-Living Forward-starting Income-only Securities) as risk-free assets. SeLFIES has a defined stream of payments starting at retirement for a defined period. Payments are indexed by consumption per capita or inflation from the time of issuance. The paradigm change from value-oriented to income-oriented causes a change in the risk ranking of assets. Government bonds with longer maturities are less risky assets compared to those with shorter maturities. We present the optimal level of savings in the form of a certainty equivalent and an internal rate of return of the certainty equivalent. In addition, we calculate the time evolution of the optimal allocation of investments into different types of assets. Optimal saving strategies deliver satisfactory replacement rates.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个退休储蓄的随机动态模型，以养老金收入的预期效用最大化为目标，与传统以价值为导向的模型不同，该模型转向以收入为导向的范式。模型采用SeLFIES（生活水平前瞻启动纯收入证券）作为无风险资产，该证券提供从退休开始的固定支付流。范式转变改变了资产风险排序，使长期政府债券比短期政府债券风险更低。文章给出了确定性等价的储蓄最优水平及其内部收益率，并计算了最优投资配置的时间演化。
AI.research_question: 如何建立一个以收入为导向（而非以价值为导向）的退休储蓄随机动态模型，并利用SeLFIES作为无风险资产来实现养老金收入预期效用的最大化？
AI.motivation: 传统退休储蓄模型以价值为导向，关注资产组合的市场价值最大化，但这与退休者实际关注养老金收入流的目标存在错配。作者试图通过收入导向的范式转变，更准确地反映退休储蓄的实际目标，并重新审视资产风险排序。
AI.theoretical_framework: 随机动态模型、预期效用理论、确定性等价（certainty equivalent）、内部收益率（IRR）
AI.method: 构建以养老金收入预期效用最大化为目标的随机动态最优控制模型，将SeLFIES作为无风险资产，推导最优储蓄水平（以确定性等价形式表示）和最优投资配置的时间演化路径。
AI.findings: （1）从价值导向转向收入导向的范式会改变资产的风险排序：长期政府债券比短期政府债券风险更低；（2）给出了确定性等价形式的最优储蓄水平及其内部收益率；（3）计算了最优投资配置的时间演化；（4）最优储蓄策略能实现令人满意的替代率。
AI.theory_contributions: （1）将退休储蓄模型从价值导向范式转变为收入导向范式，提供了新的理论视角；（2）引入SeLFIES作为无风险资产，重新定义了收入导向下的资产风险排序，挑战了传统观念中期限越长风险越高的假设；（3）以确定性等价和内部收益率形式给出了最优储蓄水平的理论表达。
AI.practical_contributions: （1）为退休储蓄者提供了以收入为导向的最优储蓄策略，能够实现满意的替代率；（2）为政策制定者和金融机构设计退休金融产品（如SeLFIES）提供了理论支持；（3）为投资者提供了重新评估政府债券风险与期限关系的新视角。

title: Does Inequality Reduce Native Bias? Evidence from a Survey Experiment
affiliations: CMCC - Centro Euro-Mediterraneo sui Cambiamenti Climatici, Università degli Studi di Milano, University of Pavia and University of Milan - University of Milan

detail.title: Does Inequality Reduce Native Bias? Evidence from a Survey Experiment

declarations.ethicsApproval: The study was approved by the Ethics Committee of the University of Milano (Parere 59/24).

detail.abstract: This paper experimentally examines whether native bias-the tendency to favor compatriots over foreigners-is affected by exposure to inequality. We study donation behavior in a representative sample of 2,382 Italian respondents who allocated part of their participation bonus to Italians and immigrants living in poverty in Italy. We vary (i) the size of the bonus, (ii) the rule used to assign the bonus to each participantrandom versus identity-based, and (iii) whether participants are informed about the bonuses received by others. We find a pronounced native bias in giving. However, making inequality salient by revealing unequal bonus allocations reduces this bias, but only among respondents who are disadvantaged by the allocation. We also find that the effect of being a victim of inequality does not depend on the source of the inequality.

AI.tldr: 本文通过实验研究不平等暴露是否影响本土偏见（偏好本国人而非外国人的倾向）。研究基于2,382名意大利受访者的捐赠行为，发现整体存在显著的本土偏见，但当不平等被凸显时（通过揭示不平等的奖金分配），处于不利地位的受访者会减少这种偏见，且该效应不取决于不平等的来源。
AI.research_question: 暴露于不平等是否会影响本土偏见（native bias），即人们倾向于帮助本国同胞而非外国人的行为倾向？
AI.motivation: 移民问题和不平等是当代社会的两大重要议题，但很少有研究探讨二者之间的交互作用。理解不平等如何影响人们对本国人与外国人的态度，对移民政策和社会公平议题具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 本土偏见理论（native bias）、不平等感知与亲社会行为理论
AI.method: 实验研究方法。样本为2,382名意大利受访者（具有代表性），参与者需将参与奖金的一部分捐赠给生活在意大利贫困中的意大利人和移民。实验操纵三个变量：（i）奖金规模；（ii）奖金分配规则（随机 vs 基于身份）；（iii）是否告知参与者其他人的奖金（即是否使不平等变得显著）。
AI.findings: 1）存在显著的本土偏见——人们更多捐赠给本国人而非移民。2）当通过揭示不平等的奖金分配使不平等变得显著时，本土偏见有所减少，但仅限于在分配中处于不利地位的受访者。3）成为不平等受害者的效应不取决于不平等的来源（随机或基于身份）。
AI.theory_contributions: 本文首次通过实验证据将不平等暴露与本土偏见联系起来，表明不平等感知可以调节群体间的亲社会行为偏好，且揭示这种调节作用仅对不平等的"受害者"有效，深化了对不平等如何影响群体态度的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 研究结果为政策制定提供启示：如果目标是减少对外国人的偏见和促进更公平的跨群体分配行为，提高社会不平等的可见性或增强人们对不平等处境的感知，可能有助于减少本土偏见，尤其在容易感知到自身处于不利地位的群体中。

title: Geopolitical Shocks and Aid Retrenchment in a Nascent State

detail.title: Geopolitical Shocks and Aid Retrenchment in a Nascent State
detail.abstract: Somalia entered 2026 under two compounding external shocks, a historic contraction in foreign assistance and the economic spillovers of intensifying geopolitical rivalry and regional conflict. This paper examines how these shocks are transmitted through a fragile, import-dependent economy and what they imply for fiscal space. United States disbursements fell to US$487.2 million in 2025, 42.3 per cent below the 2020-2024 annual average, within a wider decline in official development assistance. Regional conflict has simultaneously raised freight, insurance and energy costs along the Red Sea and Gulf corridors. Combined traffic at Somalia's four main ports fell 15.4 per cent below its prior-year benchmark in the first quarter of 2026, fuel prices in Mogadishu rose from about US$0.60 to US$1.50 per litre after the February 2026 escalation, and year-on-year inflation returned to an estimated 5.5-6.8 per cent. Scenario estimates indicate that aid shocks equivalent to 3.0-4.6 per cent of GDP could reduce growth by 0.8-1.4 percentage points and domestic revenue by US$8-14 million, while trade-linked taxes-56.5 per cent of tax collections in FY2025-remain directly exposed to shipping disruption. Revenue execution fell to 69.1 per cent of budget in FY2025 and adjustment was concentrated in social benefits and capital spending. The paper argues that geopolitical and aid shocks now constitute core fiscal risks and proposes a resilience agenda combining contingency budgeting, revenue diversification, protection of essential expenditure and systematic fiscal-risk monitoring.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了索马里在2026年面临的双重外部冲击——外国援助的历史性收缩与地缘政治冲突的经济溢出——如何通过脆弱的进口依赖型经济传导，并影响其财政空间。研究显示美国援助降至4.872亿美元（较2020-2024年均值下降42.3%），区域冲突推高航运、保险和能源成本，四大港口交通量下降15.4%，通胀回升至5.5-6.8%。情景估计表明，相当于GDP 3.0-4.6%的援助冲击可使增长放缓0.8-1.4个百分点，国内收入减少800-1400万美元。论文提出应将地缘政治与援助冲击视为核心财政风险，并建议构建包含应急预算、收入多元化、保护必要支出和系统性财政风险监测的韧性议程。
AI.research_question: 外部援助冲击和地缘政治冲突如何通过索马里脆弱的进口依赖型经济传导，这些冲击对财政空间有何影响，以及应采取何种应对策略？
AI.motivation: 索马里在2026年面临外国援助历史性收缩与区域冲突加剧的双重外部冲击，这些冲击对财政可持续性和经济发展构成重大威胁，亟需系统分析其传导机制和政策应对。
AI.theoretical_framework: 外部冲击传导理论、脆弱国家财政空间分析框架、进口依赖型经济的外部冲击传导机制
AI.method: 采用实证数据分析与情景估计方法，基于援助流量数据、港口交通量、燃料价格、通胀率和财政执行率等指标，构建援助冲击情景模型评估对经济增长和财政收入的影响。
AI.findings: 1) 美国对索马里援助在2025年降至4.872亿美元，较2020-2024年均值低42.3%；2) 区域冲突导致四大港口交通量下降15.4%，摩加迪沙燃料价格从0.60美元/升涨至1.50美元/升，通胀回升至5.5-6.8%；3) 相当于GDP 3.0-4.6%的援助冲击可使增长放缓0.8-1.4个百分点，国内收入减少800-1400万美元；4) 贸易相关税收占FY2025税收总额56.5%，直接暴露于航运中断风险；5) 财政执行率降至预算的69.1%，调整集中在社会福利和资本支出。
AI.theory_contributions: 将地缘政治与援助冲击正式纳入脆弱国家的核心财政风险框架，拓展了外部冲击传导理论在进口依赖型经济中的应用，提出了系统性财政风险监测的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为索马里及类似脆弱国家提供了包含应急预算、收入多元化、保护必要支出和系统性财政风险监测的可操作韧性议程，为国际援助机构和政策制定者提供了财政应对策略参考。

title: Divibility Criteria and the K-functions or Kamtchueng's Tables
affiliations: CTK corp

detail.title: Divibility Criteria and the K-functions or Kamtchueng's Tables
detail.abstract: Divisibility criteria are essential tools in number theory, offering efficient pathways for mental arithmetic, algorithmic design, and cryptographic applications. While classical criteria exist for small primes such as 2, 3, 5, and 11, larger primes like 13, 17, 19, and 23 often lack simple, memorable rules. This article introduces an unified framework based on the K-function and the Kamtchueng Tables, which generalize the divisibility test for any prime divisor through a systematic modular inversion of 10. We derive explicit criteria for 13, 17, 19, 23, and others, demonstrating their replicability, ease of use, and pedagogical value. The method reduces any integer to a smaller equivalent number in a finite number of steps, making it suitable for both classroom instruction and computational implementation. Beyond theoretical interest, this work is motivated by practical applications in cryptography, where prime numbers underpin secure communications, and in blockchain technology, where they remain central to mining puzzles. Additionally, the criteria are designed to support popularization efforts through educational games such as the Ishango cards game, aiming to enhance mental calculus skills among younger learners. By providing a coherent, accessible, and extendable approach to divisibility, this article contributes to both the teaching and the ongoing exploration of prime numbers-one of mathematics' most enduring and open-ended mysteries.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个基于K函数和Kamtchueng Tables的统一框架，通过系统化的模10求逆方法，将任何素数的整除性判定推广到13、17、19、23等大素数，这些判据具有可复制性、易用性和教学价值，并适用于课堂教学和计算实现。
AI.research_question: 如何为13、17、19、23等较大的素数建立简单、易记且统一的整除性判定标准？
AI.motivation: 经典整除判据仅覆盖2、3、5、11等小素数，而13、17、19、23等较大素数缺乏简单易记的判定规则。此外，素数在密码学、区块链等实际应用中至关重要，需要一种统一的、可推广的整除性判定方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于K函数和Kamtchueng Tables的统一框架，通过系统化的模10求逆来推广任意素数除数的整除性测试。
AI.method: 通过模10的系统化求逆方法，将任意整数在有限步骤内简化为更小的等价数，从而推导出13、17、19、23等素数的显式整除判据。
AI.findings: 成功推导出13、17、19、23等素数的显式整除判据，这些判据具有可复制性、易用性和教学价值，能在有限步骤内将任意整数约简为更小的等价数。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个统一的整除性判定框架，将此前零散的针对不同素数的整除判据纳入一个系统的理论体系，具有可扩展性。
AI.practical_contributions: 该方法适用于课堂教学和计算实现，支持密码学和区块链等实际应用领域，还可通过Ishango卡片游戏等教育工具推广，提升青少年的心算技能。

title: Retail Investments in Europe Wealth Allocation and ISA, ISK, PEA, PIR Role and Usage
affiliations: Bocconi University - Department of Finance and

detail.title: Retail Investments in Europe Wealth Allocation and ISA, ISK, PEA, PIR Role and Usage

publicationDetails.journalName: BAFFI Centre on Economics, Finance & Regulation Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: This report examines household wealth composition and the design of tax-advantaged retail investment accounts in four European economies over the period 1998 to 2024. Drawing on national balance sheet data from Istat, the Office for National Statistics, INSEE and Statistics Sweden, the first part documents the allocation of household wealth between financial and nonfinancial assets, the composition of financial portfolios, and equity market participation in Italy, the United Kingdom, France and Sweden. The second part compares four retail investment instruments, namely the Italian PIR, the French PEA and PEA-PME, the Swedish ISK and the United Kingdom ISA, along the dimensions of tax treatment, contribution limits, eligible assets, holding period requirements, distribution channels and market performance. The evidence indicates that fiscal generosity is a weak predictor of household adoption. The most generously taxed instrument in the sample, the Italian PIR, records the lowest penetration at 1.5 percent of adults and 0.5 percent of household financial wealth, whereas the Swedish ISK, whose flat annual levy on portfolio value is conceptually less favourable, reaches 52.3 percent penetration and 7.8 percent of financial wealth. Adoption correlates instead with the absence of holding period requirements, breadth of the eligible investment universe, simplicity of tax computation and stability of the regime over time. The report concludes by proposing an Italian adaptation of the Swedish model, the Conto di Investimento a Tassazione Forfettaria, which replaces realisation-based capital gains taxation with an annual presumptive levy on portfolio value calculated as the European Central Bank reference rate plus one percentage point, multiplied by 30 percent.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了1998-2024年间四个欧洲经济体（意大利、英国、法国、瑞典）的家庭财富构成及税收优惠型零售投资账户的设计。通过国家资产负债表数据分析家庭财富配置，并比较四种零售投资工具（意大利PIR、法国PEA/PEA-PME、瑞典ISK、英国ISA），发现税收慷慨程度对家庭采用率预测力较弱，瑞典ISK虽税收设计在概念上不太优惠，但采用率最高（52.3%）。采用率与无持有期要求、投资范围广度、税收计算简单性和制度稳定性相关。最后提出意大利版瑞典模式建议。
AI.research_question: 税收优惠型零售投资账户的设计特征如何影响家庭采用率？哪些因素真正驱动投资者对这类账户的接纳？
AI.motivation: 各国政府设计了不同税收优惠的投资账户以促进家庭储蓄和资本市场参与，但不同制度的采用率差异巨大。理解哪些设计维度真正影响家庭采用，对于政策制定和账户设计优化具有重要意义。特别是意大利PIR税收最为慷慨但采用率最低，而瑞典ISK税收在概念上较不利却采用率最高，这一悖论值得深入探讨。
AI.theoretical_framework: 家庭财富配置理论；税收行为经济学（投资者对税收复杂性和不确定性的规避）；制度设计理论（账户设计特征对行为的影响）
AI.method: 基于Istat、英国国家统计局、INSEE和瑞典统计局的国家资产负债表数据进行描述性统计分析，比较四个国家的家庭财富构成和金融投资组合；采用多维度框架系统比较四种零售投资工具（税收待遇、缴款限额、合格资产、持有期要求、分销渠道、市场表现）
AI.findings: 1. 税收慷慨程度是家庭采用率的弱预测因子：意大利PIR税收最优惠但渗透率仅1.5%，而瑞典ISK采用率高达52.3%。2. 采用率与以下因素正相关：无持有期要求、投资范围更广、税收计算简单、制度稳定性。3. 瑞典ISK的按年固定征收模式虽然概念上不太有利，但因其简单性和灵活性获得了最高的市场渗透。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了"税收优惠越多，采用率越高"的传统假设，揭示了税收简单性、灵活性和制度稳定性等非货币因素对家庭金融决策的重要影响，丰富了税收行为经济学和家庭资产配置理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了零售投资账户设计的最佳实践参考；提出了意大利版瑞典模式的"Conto di Investimento a Tassazione Forfettaria"具体方案，即以欧洲央行参考利率加1个百分点、乘以30%的年度推定税负，替代实现制资本利得税。

title: The Informational Content of Bank Risk Weights and the Role of Internal Ratings
affiliations: Bocconi University - Department of Finance, Bocconi University - Department of Finance,  and Audencia Business School

detail.title: The Informational Content of Bank Risk Weights and the Role of Internal Ratings

publicationDetails.journalName: BAFFI Centre on Economics, Finance & Regulation Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: We examine when a regulatory measure of bank asset risk, the ratio of risk-weighted assets to total assets (RWATA), aligns with a market-based measure of risk, namely the volatility of bank assets estimated using option-pricing techniques. We argue that the informational content of RWATA is conditional on the framework used to generate risk weights. Using a unique hand-collected dataset on the adoption and scope of internal ratings-based (IRB) models, we show that RWATA is unrelated to market-based asset risk on average, but becomes significantly associated with asset volatility among banks that use internal models. The relationship strengthens with the intensity of IRB adoption, particularly when advanced internal models are applied to corporate exposures, and persists among relatively weakly capitalized banks and during periods of financial stress.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了银行资产风险的监管衡量指标（风险加权资产与总资产之比，RWATA）与市场基础衡量指标（基于期权定价技术估计的银行资产波动性）之间的一致性。研究发现RWATA平均而言与市场基础风险无关，但在使用内部评级（IRB）模型的银行中显著相关，且这种关系随IRB采用强度增强而加强。
AI.research_question: 银行资产风险的监管衡量指标（RWATA）何时能反映市场基础的资产风险？
AI.motivation: 监管衡量指标（RWATA）与市场基础风险衡量指标之间的一致性关系并不明确，作者认为其信息含量取决于生成风险权重的框架（即是否使用内部评级模型）。
AI.theoretical_framework: 期权定价理论（用于估计资产波动性）与巴塞尔协议内部评级（IRB）框架。
AI.method: 手工收集银行采用内部评级（IRB）模型及范围的独特数据集，进行实证回归分析。
AI.findings: （1）RWATA平均而言与市场基础资产风险无关；（2）在使用内部模型的银行中，RWATA与资产波动性显著相关；（3）这种关系随IRB采用强度增强而加强，尤其是在对公风险敞口应用高级内部模型时；（4）该关系在资本较弱的银行和金融压力时期依然成立。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了监管风险衡量指标的信息含量取决于风险权重生成框架，对巴塞尔协议监管有效性和风险衡量理论提供了新的经验证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构和银行在评估风险衡量指标可靠性、理解IRB模型采用的影响方面提供了参考。

title: The Jerome Hall Lecture: Beyond Tit-For-Tat
affiliations: University of Chicago - Law School

detail.title: The Jerome Hall Lecture: Beyond Tit-For-Tat
detail.abstract: Constitutional law is about setting the rules of the game, naturally posing the question of what incentive parties have to obey these rules over time and what they should do if the other side does not. The "tit-for-tat" strategy, popularized from various game theoretic accounts, provides a powerful story of how targeted retaliation can promote long-term rule-following. But, alas, as things stand today, there are multiple reasons to think that in constitutional law a tit-for-tat strategy will not work.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了宪法博弈中的"以牙还牙"（tit-for-tat）策略在维护长期规则遵循方面的适用性。尽管该策略在博弈论中被广泛认为能促进合作与规则遵守，但本文指出在宪法领域存在多重原因导致该策略难以奏效。
AI.research_question: 在宪法博弈中，各参与方遵守宪法规则的激励是什么？当一方违反规则时，另一方应采取何种应对策略？"以牙还牙"策略在宪法语境下为何无法有效运作？
AI.motivation: 宪法作为"游戏规则"的设定者，天然关涉各方是否有动机长期遵守这些规则，以及在对方违约时的应对问题。虽然"以牙还牙"策略在博弈论中提供了定向报复促进长期规则遵循的有力叙事，但需要审视其在宪法领域是否真的适用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 博弈论（game theory），特别是"以牙还牙"（tit-for-tat）策略理论，以及宪政理论中关于规则遵守与执行的理论。
AI.method: 理论分析/概念分析：通过博弈论框架分析宪法规则遵守问题，识别"以牙还牙"策略在宪法领域失效的多重原因。
AI.findings: 在宪法领域存在多重原因导致"以牙还牙"策略无法有效运作，说明博弈论中的这一经典合作策略在宪法语境下面临独特的适用障碍。
AI.theory_contributions: 本文对博弈论中"以牙还牙"策略在宪法领域的适用边界进行了理论批判，揭示了该策略在宪法规则执行中的局限性，丰富了宪法博弈理论的研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 为宪法设计者和政策制定者提供了关于规则执行策略局限性的警示，有助于理解宪政实践中规则遵循面临的深层困境。

title: Library Card: A Transformative Artifact in the Landscape of Education

detail.title: Library Card: A Transformative Artifact in the Landscape of Education

detail.abstract: This article explores the multifaceted role of the library card as a transformative educational tool, transcending its modest appearance to embody ideals of equity, access, and collective responsibility. Tracing the historical evolution of libraries from exclusive institutions to more inclusive public resources, it examines how the library card serves as a symbol of educational opportunity, particularly for marginalized communities. The study incorporates perspectives from sociology, Indigenous studies, and environmental pedagogy, highlighting the card’s role in bridging socio-economic divides, fostering community learning, and promoting environmental stewardship. Ultimately, the library card emerges as a symbol of lifelong learning, community engagement, and shared cultural heritage, prompting a re-evaluation of educational values in the digital age.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了图书馆借书卡作为一种变革性教育工具的多元角色，追溯了图书馆从排他性机构向包容性公共资源的历史演变，并从社会学、原住民研究和环境教育学等视角论证了借书卡在弥合社会经济鸿沟、促进社区学习和推动环境管理方面的象征意义与教育价值。
AI.research_question: 图书馆借书卡如何作为一种变革性教育工具，体现公平、获取和集体责任的理想，并在数字时代重新定义教育价值？
AI.motivation: 借书卡看似普通，但其背后承载着教育机会均等、社会包容和集体责任的深远意义，尤其对边缘化社区而言。随着数字时代的到来，需要对教育价值观进行重新审视。
AI.theoretical_framework: 社会学视角、原住民研究（Indigenous studies）、环境教育学（environmental pedagogy）
AI.method: 历史追溯与多学科理论整合的定性分析/概念性研究
AI.findings: 借书卡是终身学习、社区参与和共享文化遗产的象征，能够弥合社会经济鸿沟，促进社区学习，并推动环境管理意识的培养，促使人们重新评估数字时代的教育价值。
AI.theory_contributions: 将图书馆借书卡从功能性工具提升为教育公平和社会责任的象征性概念，整合社会学、原住民研究和环境教育学的跨学科视角，拓展了对教育工具象征意义的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为图书馆政策制定者和教育工作者提供了重新认识借书卡价值的启示，有助于推动更包容的公共教育资源配置，并在数字时代重新定位图书馆作为社区教育资源的功能。

detail.abstract:
This paper argues that the American Revolution was not merely a political rejection of British rule, nor only a legal dispute over taxation, representation, imperial administration, or royal overreach. It was a directional inversion of sovereignty. The Revolution rejected the premise that lawful authority must descend from crown, lineage, dynasty, and inherited hierarchy, and replaced it with a constitutional model in which authority ascends from the people, is converted into lawful public power through the Constitution, and is delegated to temporary public officers bound by oath, jurisdiction, separation of powers, and legal restraint.

The paper introduces the Direction of Authority Model as a constitutional-theoretic framework for distinguishing monarchy and democratic republicanism not merely by institutional form, but by the source-channel through which legitimacy is understood to move. In traditional monarchy, authority descends: Crown → institutions → subjects. In the American constitutional republic, authority ascends: People → Constitution → institutions → officers. This model clarifies why the President is not an elected king, why citizenship differs structurally from subjecthood, why “We the People” is not ornamental constitutional language, and why constitutional literacy, civic education, representation, lawful immigration, public debate, and institutional restraint are core operating requirements of the American system.

The novelty of this paper lies in its reframing of the American founding as an authority architecture rather than merely a regime change, independence movement, or founding-era political settlement. It contributes a source-direction analysis to constitutional theory by showing that the American Republic’s deepest innovation was not simply the absence of monarchy, but the relocation of lawful authority from inherited sovereignty to constitutional peoplehood. The paper further extends this model into citizenship, immigration, public architecture, innovation, and republic-stability analysis, arguing that these domains are not peripheral but downstream expressions of how authority is organized.

AI.tldr: 本文认为美国革命本质上是主权方向的倒转：从"权力自上而下"的君主制模式（王冠→制度→臣民），转变为"权力自下而上"的宪政共和模式（人民→宪法→制度→官员）。作者提出"权威方向模型"（Direction of Authority Model）作为宪政理论框架，并论证这一方向性革命是美国共和体制最深层的创新，且延伸至公民身份、移民、公共建筑、创新与共和稳定性分析。
AI.research_question: 美国革命的根本性质是什么？其最深层创新是否不仅仅在于废除君主制，而在于重新定位合法权威的来源与流动方向（自上而下 vs. 自下而上）？
AI.motivation: 既有研究将美国革命视为政治反叛、税收与代表权之争或帝国治理纠纷，但未能充分揭示其在主权方向上的根本性倒转。本文旨在提出一个统一的宪政理论框架来重新理解美国建制的本质创新。
AI.theoretical_framework: 权威方向模型（Direction of Authority Model）：区分君主制（Crown→Institutions→Subjects）与民主共和制（People→Constitution→Institutions→Officers）的合法性流动方向，以此作为宪政理论的分析框架。
AI.method: 概念性/理论性分析，通过构建权威方向模型对宪法理论进行重构，并将其扩展到公民身份、移民、公共建筑、创新与共和稳定性等应用领域。
AI.findings: 美国革命的最深层创新是将合法权威从世袭主权重新定位到宪政人民主权；该模型解释了总统为何不是"选举产生的国王"、公民身份为何与臣民身份结构不同、"我们人民"并非装饰性宪法语言，以及宪政素养、公民教育、代表制、合法移民、公共讨论和制度约束为何是美国制度的核心运作要求。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"权威方向模型"作为区分君主制与民主共和制的新宪政理论框架；引入"来源-方向分析"方法，重新框定美国建国为"权威架构"而非仅仅是政权更迭或独立运动；证明美国共和体制最深层的创新在于主权方向的倒转而非君主制的单纯缺失；将该模型延伸至多个公共领域分析。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解美国总统制、公民身份、宪政素养与公民教育、移民政策、公共建筑象征、创新政策及共和体制稳定性提供统一的分析框架，阐明这些领域并非边缘问题，而是权威组织方式的下游表达。

title: Latent Dimensions of the Economic Impact of Industrial Park Development Projects in Ethiopia: Evidence from Exploratory Factor Analysis and Ordered Probit Models
affiliations: , Rift Valley University and Ethiopian Industrial Parks Development Corporation

detail.title: Latent Dimensions of the Economic Impact of Industrial Park Development Projects in Ethiopia: Evidence from Exploratory Factor Analysis and Ordered Probit Models

publicationDetails.detailsText: KDI School of Pub Policy & Management Paper Forthcoming
publicationDetails.journalName: KDI School of Public Policy & Management Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: Industrial Park development has become a strategic policy instrument for accelerating industrialization, attracting investment, creating employment opportunities, and promoting sustainable economic development in Ethiopia. However, empirical evidence on the multidimensional factors shaping the economic impact of industrial park development projects remains limited. This study examines the latent economic, social, political, technological, cultural, and environmental dimensions influencing the economic impact of industrial park development projects in Ethiopia. A mixed-methods research design was employed using survey data collected from employees, managers, administrators, and community representatives across Ethiopian industrial parks. Exploratory Factor Analysis (EFA) with Principal Component Analysis and Varimax rotation was used to identify the underlying latent dimensions, while Ordered Probit and Ordered Logit models were employed to estimate their effects on the indexed economic impact of industrial park development projects. The findings reveal that high community commitment, abundant non-financial resources, tangible government support, and strong social capital significantly enhance the economic impact of industrial park development projects. In contrast, unskilled labour supply, outdated technology, geographic concentration of industrial parks, and weak institutional capacity significantly constrain their economic contribution. The study concludes that maximizing the economic impact of industrial parks requires integrated policy interventions that strengthen institutional support, enhance workforce skills, promote technological upgrading, and encourage more balanced regional distribution of industrial parks. The findings contribute to the literature by providing a multidimensional empirical framework for understanding the determinants of industrial park performance and offer evidence-based policy recommendations for promoting sustainable industrial development in Ethiopia.

AI.tldr: 本研究采用混合方法设计，通过探索性因子分析和有序Probit/Logit模型，考察了埃塞俄比亚工业园区开发项目经济影响的多维潜在因素（经济、社会、政治、技术、文化和环境），发现社区承诺、非财务资源、政府支持和社会资本能显著提升经济影响，而低技能劳动力、过时技术、地理集中和制度能力薄弱则构成制约。
AI.research_question: 哪些多维潜在因素（经济、社会、政治、技术、文化和环境维度）影响埃塞俄比亚工业园区开发项目的经济影响？
AI.motivation: 工业园区开发已成为埃塞俄比亚加速工业化、吸引投资、创造就业和促进可持续发展的战略政策工具，但关于塑造其经济影响的多维因素的实证证据仍然有限，亟需系统性的实证研究加以补充。
AI.theoretical_framework: 研究从经济、社会、政治、技术、文化和环境六个潜在维度出发构建分析框架，关注社区承诺、社会资本、政府支持、非财务资源、劳动力技能、技术更新、地理分布和制度能力等关键理论构念。
AI.method: 采用混合方法研究设计：对工业园区员工、管理者、行政人员和社区代表进行问卷调查；运用探索性因子分析（EFA）结合主成分分析和Varimax旋转识别潜在维度；采用有序Probit和有序Logit模型估计各维度对经济影响指数的作用效应。
AI.findings: 高社区承诺、充裕的非财务资源、切实的政府支持和强大的社会资本显著提升工业园区开发项目的经济影响；相反，低技能劳动力供给、过时技术、工业园区地理集中和薄弱的制度能力显著制约其经济贡献。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了一个理解工业园区绩效决定因素的多维实证分析框架，补充了工业园区经济影响研究中关于潜在维度识别的理论文献。
AI.practical_contributions: 为埃塞俄比亚制定综合政策提供了循证建议：加强制度支持、提升劳动力技能、促进技术升级、鼓励工业园区的均衡区域分布，以促进可持续工业发展。

AI.tldr: 本研究分析了伊朗高中历史教科书（历史1、2、3及当代伊朗历史）的认知平衡性，发现文本参与指数极低（0.019），图像参与指数为零，远低于主动学习阈值0.4，96.7%的课程属于被动的"银行储蓄式教育"范畴。研究同时验证了比较裁决协议（CAP）在43名职前教师组成的15个独立研究团队中的可靠性，最终评分者间一致性达86.4%。研究强调在历史内容分析中实施"人在回路"（HITL）方法的必要性，并建议课程改革和培养职前教师的算法审计素养。
AI.research_question: 高中历史教科书的认知平衡性如何？比较裁决协议（CAP）在人类审计者网络中评估教科书认知平衡的有效性如何？
AI.motivation: 尽管理论家如Sam Wineburg强调发展历史思维，但中央集权教育体系中的历史教科书仍以死记硬背为主，对其认知平衡的系统性评估——尤其是高中阶段——长期被忽视。
AI.theoretical_framework: William Romey技术、比较裁决协议（CAP）、R2A-TACI-PACT概念框架、"人在回路"（HITL）方法、银行储蓄式教育（banking education）理论
AI.method: 采用William Romey技术与CAP协议，对4本教科书共61个独立课程进行分析。过程分四个阶段：能力建设、独立AI辅助审计、盲审同行审计和差异裁决。43名职前教师分为15个独立研究团队参与。
AI.findings: 文本参与指数极低（0.019），远低于0.4的主动学习阈值；96.7%课程属于被动的"银行储蓄式教育"类别。图像参与指数为零（0）。问题参与指数为1.29但分布极不均衡（范围从∞到0.06），显示被动文本内容与主动分析期望之间存在严重结构性差距。CAP协议实现了86.4%的最终评分者间一致性和12.5%的初始共识提升。主导差异模式为A与B（48.3%），表明区分"客观历史事实"与"作者解读"是人工编码者面临的主要分析挑战。
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了CAP协议在历史教科书认知平衡评估中的可靠性与有效性；将HITL方法系统性地引入历史内容分析领域；丰富了William Romey技术在高中历史教科书分析中的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 揭示了高中历史教科书认知结构的严重被动性，为课程改革提供实证依据；提出培养职前教师算法审计素养的建议；为中央集权教育体系中的教科书评估提供了可复制的协议框架。

title: Too Personal: Credit Scoring Under Information Withholding
affiliations: University of Economics in Bratislava, , Masaryk University - Department of finance, Masaryk University - Department of finance and Masaryk University

detail.title: Too Personal: Credit Scoring Under Information Withholding

declarations.declarationOfInterest: Authors declare no competing interests.
declarations.funderStatement: This research was supported by the Czech Science Foundation, nr. 22-35130K.

detail.abstract: Given the increasing value of private information, participants in lending markets face growing challenges in accurately predicting credit scores while simultaneously protecting borrowers' personal information. We examine the implications of information withholding for credit scoring using datasets from two P2P lending platforms: Lending Club and Prosper, from the perspectives of both the platform and the investor. The lending platform never observes interest rates. Both actors either have access to borrower characteristics or do not. We find that borrower characteristics improve the ability of credit scoring models to identify defaulted loans more accurately. The economic impact of withholding this information can be even more pronounced. In the case of the Lending Club marketplace, withholding borrower characteristics leads to a reduction in the Sharpe ratio of invested loans by up to 31%. When this information is withheld from the investor, her Sharpe ratio decreases by up to 8.3%. The Prosper marketplace is substantially riskier, and our findings suggest that interest rates are unlikely to serve as a reliable proxy for borrower characteristics. Overall, our results indicate that the value of information withholding is both model-and marketplace-specific, but can significantly disrupt the lending market environment.

AI.tldr: 本文利用Lending Club和Prosper两个P2P借贷平台的数据，从平台和投资者两个视角考察信息隐瞒（不披露借款人特征）对信用评分的影响。研究发现借款人特征能显著提升信用评分模型识别违约贷款的能力，且信息隐瞒的经济影响更为显著：在Lending Club平台上，隐瞒借款人特征导致投资贷款夏普比率下降高达31%；当信息对投资者隐瞒时，其夏普比率下降最高达8.3%。Prosper平台风险更高，利率难以作为借款人特征的可靠代理变量。整体结果表明，信息隐瞒的价值因模型和平台而异，但可能严重扰乱借贷市场环境。
AI.research_question: 在P2P借贷市场中，信息隐瞒（不披露借款人特征）对信用评分及贷款投资绩效有何影响？
AI.motivation: 随着私人信息价值的日益增加，借贷市场参与者在准确预测信用评分与保护借款人个人信息之间面临日益严峻的挑战，理解信息隐瞒的影响对平台和投资者均至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信息不对称理论、信用评分模型、投资组合绩效（夏普比率）分析框架
AI.method: 利用Lending Club和Prosper两个P2P平台的真实数据集，从平台与投资者双重视角，通过对比有无借款人特征的信用评分模型（包括识别违约能力及夏普比率变化）进行实证分析。
AI.findings: （1）借款人特征能显著提升信用评分模型识别违约贷款的准确性；（2）在Lending Club平台，隐瞒借款人特征使投资贷款夏普比率下降高达31%；当仅对投资者隐瞒时，其夏普比率下降最高达8.3%；（3）Prosper平台风险更高，利率不宜作为借款人特征的可靠代理变量；（4）信息隐瞒的影响因模型和平台而异，但总体会对借贷市场环境造成显著扰乱。
AI.theory_contributions: 将信息隐瞒与信用评分理论相结合，从平台和投资者双视角系统量化了信息不披露的经济后果，揭示了信息价值具有模型特异性和市场特异性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为P2P借贷平台在信息保护与信息披露之间的权衡决策提供实证依据，帮助投资者理解信息隐瞒对其投资组合绩效的具体影响，为平台监管设计提供参考。

title: Potential Impacts of an EU Methane Intensity Standard for Natural Gas
affiliations: SINTEF Technology and Society, Environmental Defense Fund, Environmental Defense Fund, World Bank Group and German Institute for Economic Research (DIW Berlin)

detail.title: Potential Impacts of an EU Methane Intensity Standard for Natural Gas
detail.abstract: Methane mitigation is increasingly recognized as a critical lever for achieving near-term climate goals. In August 2024, the European Union (EU) adopted the Methane Regulation (EUMR), the first comprehensive framework addressing methane emissions from both domestic fossil fuel operations and imports. A cornerstone of the regulation is the introduction of a methane intensity standard for fossil fuels (crude oil, natural gas, and coal) that will take effect on August 5, 2030 for supply contracts concluded or renewed after that date. This paper examines the implications of implementing the EU methane intensity standard for natural gas using the Global Gas Model-Methane, a partial equilibrium economic model. Our analysis finds that an EU methane intensity standard with a maximum intensity value of 0.2% for natural gas would reduce upstream methane emissions embedded in EU gas production and imports by approximately 40%. This is the net impact after considering emission leakage through trade diversion, which amounts to approximately 10% of the gross reduction in the EU upstream methane footprint. Globally, the EU intensity standard would lead to a 1.4% decrease in methane emissions from natural gas production. At the same time, the intensity standard would have negligible effects on EU gas prices and gas import volumes. These results underscore the potential of methane intensity standards as a cost-effective policy instrument for global methane mitigation, offering significant climate benefits without imposing substantial economic trade-offs.

AI.tldr: 本文利用全球天然气模型-甲烷（Global Gas Model-Methane）这一部分均衡经济模型，评估欧盟甲烷强度标准（对天然气设定0.2%的最大甲烷强度值）的实施影响。研究发现该标准可使欧盟上游天然气生产和进口中嵌入的甲烷排放减少约40%，需考虑约10%的贸易转移排放泄漏；全球范围内天然气生产甲烷排放将减少1.4%，同时对欧盟天然气价格和进口量的影响可忽略不计，表明甲烷强度标准是一种成本有效的全球甲烷减排政策工具。
AI.research_question: 欧盟实施天然气甲烷强度标准将如何影响欧盟上游甲烷排放足迹、全球天然气生产甲烷排放以及欧盟天然气价格和进口量？
AI.motivation: 甲烷减排被视为实现近期气候目标的关键杠杆，2024年8月欧盟通过了《甲烷法规》（EUMR），首次对国内外化石燃料运营中的甲烷排放建立综合监管框架，并引入了2030年8月5日生效的化石燃料甲烷强度标准。在此政策背景下，需要评估该标准的经济与环境影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 部分均衡经济模型（Partial Equilibrium Economic Model）——具体为Global Gas Model-Methane，用于分析天然气市场的供需均衡及甲烷排放影响。
AI.method: 使用Global Gas Model-Methane部分均衡模型进行シミュレーション分析，模拟欧盟对天然气实施0.2%最大甲烷强度标准的政策情景，量化其对欧盟上游甲烷足迹、全球排放、贸易流向、价格和进口量的影响，并区分总减排量与考虑贸易转移泄漏后的净减排量。
AI.findings: 1）欧盟甲烷强度标准（0.2%）将使欧盟天然气生产和进口中嵌入的上游甲烷排放减少约40%（净效应）；2）贸易转移导致的排放泄漏约占欧盟上游甲烷足迹总减排量的10%；3）全球范围内天然气生产甲烷排放将下降1.4%；4）对欧盟天然气价格和进口量的影响可忽略不计。
AI.theory_contributions: 为甲烷强度标准这一新兴政策工具提供了系统的经济模型分析框架，揭示了贸易转移导致的排放泄漏效应在甲烷政策评估中的重要性，拓展了部分均衡模型在能源政策与气候治理交叉领域的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为欧盟及全球政策制定者提供了甲烷强度标准的量化政策评估证据，表明该政策可实现显著气候收益且不带来重大经济代价，支持其作为成本有效的全球甲烷减排政策工具的推广应用。

title: Extended Dividends, Payouts, and Return Patterns
affiliations: University of California, Los Angeles (UCLA) and University of Lausanne

detail.title: Extended Dividends, Payouts, and Return Patterns
detail.abstract: A modified Campbell-Shiller identity decomposes dividend-price ratios exactly into future stock returns, dividend growth rates, and an adjusted dividend-price ratio. Unfortunately, we have only one history for the US stock market, where dividend-price ratios were limited in range from 1.1% to 8% (with a geometric mean of 3.3%). This paper explores portfolios (and stocks) with much higher dividendprice ratios from about 5% to 77% (geometric mean of 14%). At these much higher yields, portfolio dividend-price ratios predicted future dividend reductions rather than future stock returns. Broader payout ratios-dividends plus share repurchases-behaved similarly.

AI.tldr: 本文通过修改Campbell-Shiller恒等式，将股息价格比率分解为未来股票收益、股息增长率和调整后的股息价格比率。与以往美国股市样本（股息率范围1.1%-8%）不同，本文研究了股息率高达5%-77%（几何均值14%）的投资组合和股票，发现在这些高收益率水平下，股息价格比率预测的是未来股息削减而非未来股票收益。更广泛的派息比率（股息加股票回购）表现类似。
AI.research_question: 在股息价格比率远高于美国股市历史水平（如5%-77%）的情况下，股息价格比率是否仍能预测未来股票收益，还是转向预测未来股息变化？
AI.motivation: 传统的Campbell-Shiller分解研究发现，美国股市的股息价格比率主要预测未来股票收益而非股息增长率。但由于美国股市只有一个历史样本，且股息率范围有限（1.1%-8%），无法验证在高股息率水平下这种关系是否依然成立。因此需要探索高股息率组合来检验该关系的稳健性。
AI.theoretical_framework: Campbell-Shiller恒等式（股息价格比率的对数线性分解）；股息价格比率、未来收益与股息增长率之间的关系。
AI.method: 通过修改Campbell-Shiller恒等式将股息价格比率精确分解为未来股票收益、股息增长率和调整后的股息价格比率；构建股息率更高的投资组合和股票样本（5%-77%）进行实证分析。
AI.findings: 在高股息率水平（5%-77%）下，股息价格比率预测的是未来股息削减而非未来股票收益；更广泛的派息比率（股息加股票回购）行为类似。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了Campbell-Shiller分解框架在高股息率情形下的适用性，揭示了股息价格比率的预测作用取决于其水平范围——在低水平时预测收益，在极高水平时预测股息变化。
AI.practical_contributions: 对投资者的启示是：高股息率并不意味着高未来收益，反而可能预示未来股息削减的风险；在估值高股息策略时需谨慎，不能简单将高股息率视为超额收益的信号。

title: Payback Time: A Method to Develop an Indicative List of Financial Compensations for Illegal Damage to Nature
affiliations: Research Institute for Nature and Forest, Ghent University, Research Institute for Nature and Forest, Research Institute for Nature and Forest, Ghent University, KU Leuven - Brussels Campus, Research Institute for Nature and Forest and Research Institute for Nature and Forest

detail.title: Payback Time: A Method to Develop an Indicative List of Financial Compensations for Illegal Damage to Nature

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare no interests.
declarations.funderStatement: This research is part of the BIOVAL project, supported by DG Environment, European Commission.

detail.abstract: Worldwide, illegal wildlife killings and habitat destruction cause ecological damage, leading to substantial losses in biodiversity and ecosystem services, impacting both nature and people. Legal regulations mandate the restoration of damaged nature, yet restoration “in natura” is often impossible and determining fair compensation in court remains challenging due to a lack of standardized valuation methods for species and habitats, as well as clear and transparent guidelines for their application. This paper presents a research process where judges, legal experts, and ecologists collaborated to develop a practical and transparent method for calculating indicative financial compensation amounts for damage to vertebrate species, which was piloted in Flanders, Belgium. Our approach integrates the IPBES assessment on diverse values and valuation of nature, moving beyond purely instrumental or intrinsic values to encompass plural values that reflect the complex relationships between nature and people. The resulting “BIOVAL” method and indicative list of compensations provide a robust, science-based instrument for court rulings, helping to bridge the expertise gap faced by judges and enabling more efficient and equitable compensation claims. Developed through co-creative workshops with legal professionals, the BIOVAL method balances conceptual rigor with real-world applicability, aiming to ensure legitimacy and acceptance within the legal system. This innovative approach offers a replicable template for constructing compensation lists in other jurisdictions, promoting justice and ecosystem conservation based on recognition of the plural values of nature.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了在比利时法兰德斯地区开发的一套名为"BIOVAL"的实用透明方法，用于计算脊椎动物物种损害的经济赔偿金额。该方法由法官、法律专家和生态学家共同合作开发，整合了IPBES关于自然多元价值的评估框架，超越了纯粹的工具性或内在价值，为法院判决提供了科学依据，帮助弥合法官在生态学专业知识上的差距。
AI.research_question: 如何开发和实施一套标准化、透明且实用的方法，用于计算非法野生动物杀戮和栖息地破坏造成的脊椎动物物种损害的经济赔偿金额，以支持法院的司法裁决？
AI.motivation: 全球范围内非法野生动物杀戮和栖息地破坏造成严重的生态损害和生物多样性流失，但法律要求恢复受损自然时，"就地恢复"（in natura）往往不可行，而法院确定公平赔偿因缺乏标准化估值方法和透明指导方针而面临重大挑战。
AI.theoretical_framework: IPBES关于自然多元价值和估值（diverse values and valuation of nature）的评估框架，涵盖超越纯粹工具性或内在价值的多元价值（plural values），反映人与自然之间的复杂关系。
AI.method: 采用协同共创（co-creative workshops）研究流程，法官、法律专家和生态学家协作开发赔偿计算方法；在比利时法兰德斯地区进行试点实施，构建BIOVAL方法和指示性赔偿列表。
AI.findings: 开发出"BIOVAL"方法和指示性赔偿清单，提供一个稳健、基于科学证据的法院判决工具，弥合法官在生态专业知识上的差距，实现更高效和公平的赔偿诉求，并在法律体系中获得合法性认可和接受。
AI.theory_contributions: 将IPBES多元价值评估框架实际应用于法律赔偿计算中，推动了自然估值从单一价值维度向多元价值整合的理论落地，证明了多元价值框架在司法场景中的可操作性。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了一套可复制的模板，供其他司法管辖区构建赔偿清单使用；为法官提供了科学支撑的决策工具，在概念严谨性与现实适用性之间取得平衡；促进基于自然多元价值认知的司法公正和生态系统保护。

title: Healing Cycles in Therapeutic Landscapes for Well-being: A Causal Model of Urban Green Spaces for Promoting Physical, Mental, and Social Health
affiliations: Islamic Azad University (IAU) and University of District of Columbia

detail.title: Healing Cycles in Therapeutic Landscapes for Well-being: A Causal Model of Urban Green Spaces for Promoting Physical, Mental, and Social Health

declarations.declarationOfInterest: All authors certify that they have no affiliations with or involvement in any organization or entity with any financial interest or non-financial interest in the subject matter or materials discussed in this manuscript.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study involved voluntary participation by adult respondents through an anonymous questionnaire. Informed consent was obtained from all participants before data collection. Participation was entirely voluntary, and participants were free to withdraw at any time. All responses were anonymized and treated confidentially. No patients or clinical interventions were involved, and no formal ethics approval was obtained for this study.
declarations.funderStatement: No funds, grants, or other support were received.
declarations.clinicalTrialRegistration: This research is not a clinical trial and does not include any clinical intervention or trial registration.

detail.abstract: Urban residents increasingly face high levels of stress and limited access to natural environments, raising concerns about the impact on physical, mental, and social well-being. While the benefits of urban green spaces (UGSs) are widely acknowledged, the specific design elements that contribute to these benefits and their causal relationships remain unclear. This study proposes a causal model of therapeutic landscape design components in UGSs, focusing on the synergistic interactions that enhance residents' health. A mixed-methods approach was employed in three stages: a review of existing literature and expert interviews using the Delphi method to identify health-related design indicators; administration of a user survey assessing architectural qualities of UGSs; and factor analysis combined with covariance structural equation modeling (CSEM) to validate the proposed model.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出一个城市绿色空间（UGS）中治疗性景观设计要素的因果模型，通过混合方法（文献综述、德尔菲专家访谈、用户调查、因子分析与协方差结构方程建模）识别并验证能促进居民健康的具体设计指标及其协同关系。
AI.research_question: 城市绿色空间中的哪些具体设计要素能促进居民健康？这些设计要素之间是否存在协同的因果关系？
AI.motivation: 城市居民面临高压力且接触自然环境的机会有限，虽然城市绿色空间的健康益处已被广泛认可，但具体的设计要素及其因果机制尚不清晰。
AI.theoretical_framework: 治疗性景观理论（Therapeutic Landscape Theory）
AI.method: 采用三阶段混合方法：（1）文献综述与德尔菲法专家访谈识别健康相关设计指标；（2）用户调查评估城市绿色空间的建筑品质；（3）因子分析与协方差结构方程建模（CSEM）验证所提出的因果模型。
AI.findings: 未能从摘要中直接获取具体结果，但研究验证了城市绿色空间中治疗性景观设计要素的因果模型，证实设计要素之间存在协同交互作用，能够增强居民健康效益。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次提出并实证验证了城市绿色空间中治疗性景观设计要素的因果模型，揭示了设计要素之间的协同交互机制，填补了具体设计要素与健康结果之间因果关系的理论空白。
AI.practical_contributions: 为城市规划和景观设计师提供了一套经过验证的健康相关设计指标，可用于指导城市绿色空间的设计实践，以最大化对居民身心健康的积极影响。

title: The Strait of Hormuz and the Economics of Chokepoint Power

detail.title: The Strait of Hormuz and the Economics of Chokepoint Power

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is the founder of Hormuz Group, an independent market intelligence platform focused on Iran. No external organisation funded, commissioned, or influenced this research. The author declares no other financial or personal relationships that could have influenced the work.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This study relies exclusively on publicly available institutional, market, legal, and historical sources and does not involve human participants, personal data, clinical data, or animal subjects.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding and was conducted independently by the author.

detail.abstract: The Strait of Hormuz is usually described as a military chokepoint: a narrow passage that Iran can threaten and outside naval powers can attempt to keep open. That description is correct but incomplete. Commercial disruption can begin before the channel is physically closed and can persist after navigation formally resumes. The relevant variables include not only the number of vessels able to transit, but also the availability and price of war-risk insurance, trade finance, shipping capacity, schedule reliability, and confidence in the durability of security guarantees. This paper defines chokepoint power as the capacity to convert geographically concentrated trade into economic and political leverage, and develops a distinction between physical openness and commercial openness. It uses structured historical comparison-early-modern Hormuz, the Dardanelles campaign, the Suez Crisis, and the Iran-Iraq Tanker War-together with evidence from the 2026 disruption of Gulf shipping. Three patterns recur. Uncertainty can be introduced at substantially lower cost than commercial confidence can be restored. The state exercising coercive leverage is usually exposed to the same route it threatens. And repeated coercive use raises the expected return on military balancing, supply diversification, inventory accumulation, and bypass infrastructure. The paper calls this last mechanism the coercionsubstitution dilemma. It argues that Hormuz is most valuable to Iran when the route remains indispensable without becoming commercially intolerable. Durable influence therefore depends less on discretionary control over individual passages than on recognised participation in cooperative maritime governance consistent with non-discriminatory passage and predictable commercial operation.

AI.tldr: 本文重新定义霍尔木兹海峡的"咽喉要道"权力，提出"物理开放"与"商业开放"的区分，认为商业中断可以先于航道物理关闭发生，并持续至航行正式恢复之后。通过四个历史案例的结构化比较，识别出三种反复出现的模式，并提出"胁迫—替代困境"机制。
AI.research_question: 咽喉要道（chokepoint）的权力如何实现？其效力受哪些因素制约？霍尔木兹海峡对伊朗的胁迫价值在何种条件下最大化？
AI.motivation: 传统上将霍尔木兹海峡视为军事咽喉要道的描述虽然正确但不完整——商业中断可以早于物理关闭发生、并晚于航行恢复而持续存在。需要考虑运输能力以外的保险、贸易融资、运力、班期可靠性及安全保证信心等商业变量。
AI.theoretical_framework: 咽喉要道权力概念（将地理集中贸易转化为经济与政治杠杆的能力）；物理开放与商业开放的区分；胁迫—替代困境机制。
AI.method: 结构化历史比较法，涵盖近代早期霍尔木兹、达达尼尔海峡战役、苏伊士危机、两伊油轮战争四个案例，并结合2026年海湾航运中断的证据。
AI.findings: 三种反复出现的模式：（1）制造不确定性的成本远低于恢复商业信心的成本；（2）实施胁迫的国家通常暴露于其所威胁的同一航线；（3）反复的胁迫使用会提高军事平衡、供应多元化、库存积累和绕行基础设施的预期回报。由此形成"胁迫—替代困境"。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出咽喉要道权力与"物理/商业开放"的区分；识别"胁迫—替代困境"机制；论证持久的胁迫影响力不取决于对个别通行的酌处控制，而取决于在合作性海洋治理中的被认可参与。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解海峡安全、海上保险与贸易融资市场、供应链韧性建设及护航与威慑政策提供分析框架；阐明霍尔木兹海峡对伊朗价值最大化的条件——航线保持不可或缺但又不至于商业上不可容忍。

title: The Expected Number of Pairwise Stable Networks
affiliations: Tilburg University, Maastricht University - Department of Economics and Maastricht University

detail.title: The Expected Number of Pairwise Stable Networks
detail.abstract:
This paper studies probabilistic properties of pairwise stability for a network model where individual utilities are random variables. We study the probability that a given network is pairwise stable and the expected number of pairwise stable networks. We provide a closed-form solution for the latter number.

As the evaluation of the exact expression is computationally challenging for large populations, we provide tractable lower and upper bounds for this expression which allow us to pin down the asymptotic behavior of the expected number of pairwise stable networks up to a multiplicative constant. This asymptotic behavior is described by the number of networks $ 2^{n(n-1)/2} $ times $ (2/n+1)^{n} $, a sequence that tends to infinity fast. We normalize the number of pairwise stable networks by this sequence and show that the variance of the normalized number of pairwise stable networks converges to zero as n tends to infinity.

We conclude that almost surely the number of pairwise stable networks tends to infinity, while the fraction of pairwise stable networks tends to 0 as n goes to infinity.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了随机效用网络模型中成对稳定性（pairwise stability）的概率性质。作者推导了给定网络为成对稳定的概率以及成对稳定网络期望数量的闭式解，并提供了可计算的上下界以刻画大群体下的渐近行为。研究发现成对稳定网络的数量几乎必然趋于无穷，但其在所有可能网络中的占比趋近于零。
AI.research_question: 在个体效用为随机变量的网络模型中，成对稳定的网络数量具有怎样的概率性质？其期望值、方差及渐近行为如何？
AI.motivation: 成对稳定性是网络博弈中最常用的均衡概念之一，但其概率性质在随机效用设定下尚未被系统研究。特别是在大规模群体中，精确计算成对稳定网络的数量在计算上极为困难，因此需要找到可处理的近似方法来确定其渐近行为。
AI.theoretical_framework: 成对稳定性（pairwise stability）概念、随机效用模型、概率论与渐近分析。
AI.method: 推导给定网络为成对稳定的概率表达式，并给出成对稳定网络期望数量的闭式解；由于精确表达式的计算难题，构建可处理的上下界以刻画渐近行为；利用方差收敛到零的结果证明归一化数量的概率极限性质。
AI.findings: 成对稳定网络的期望数量渐近行为由 2^{n(n-1)/2} × (2/n+1)^n 描述，该序列快速趋于无穷。将成对稳定网络数量按此序列归一化后，其方差随n趋于无穷而收敛到零。因此，成对稳定网络的数量几乎必然趋于无穷，但成对稳定网络在所有网络中的占比几乎必然趋近于0。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统研究了随机效用网络模型中成对稳定性的概率性质，提供了期望数量的闭式解及精确渐近行为刻画，扩展了对网络博弈均衡集合规模的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为大规模网络博弈中成对稳定均衡的计数与预测提供了可计算的理论工具（上下界），有助于理解真实网络中稳定结构的丰富性及其相对稀缺性。

title: A Geometric Theory of Capacity in Variance Markets: Manifold Structure, Information Degeneration, and Boundary Scaling Laws

detail.title: A Geometric Theory of Capacity in Variance Markets: Manifold Structure, Information Degeneration, and Boundary Scaling Laws
detail.abstract:
The capacity of variance markets is conventionally modeled as a scalar capital threshold. We show that capacity is intrinsically geometric: on the participation state space of variance sellers and buyers, the vanishing locus of the variance risk premium forms a codimension-one manifold, and a participation-indexed Girsanov family of pricing measures is forced, by four measure-theoretic axioms alone, to factor through the premium, making the premium the sufficient statistic for crowding-induced pricing distortion.

The central consequence is an invisibility dichotomy: option prices carry a first-order signal of the approach to capacity if and only if a single leverage-weighted covariance is nonzero, so delta-hedged markets, the canonical regime of variance replication, are structurally blind to the very trajectory that generates systemic instability. We further prove a signature theorem for the information-capacity metric (Riemannian on one side of the manifold, Lorentzian on the other, degenerate on it); a stress-information reciprocity law with exponent -1/2, together with the square-root duality between boundary local time and positional concentration; and, for the coupled reflected boundary system, an averaging theorem for invariant measures that removes all tangential hypotheses. All scaling laws are two-sided with explicit constants; the exact heterogeneous reciprocity constant is stated as an open problem with a conjectured formula.

We then confront the framework's microstructural closures with S&P 500 index volatility data (2010-2023). The geometric layer is validated numerically at every exponent; the one independently testable transmission closure is rejected in unconditional form, with a sign-consistent trace surviving only in the deepest capacity approaches; the fragility index flags all three major stress episodes in advance but does not predict severity, an outcome the invisibility results permit; and the framework's own premium coordinate, the direct distance-to-manifold proxy, outperforms both a composite index and a volatility benchmark as a forward-looking flag. Negative-premium episodes cluster in exactly the systemic-stress years, with none in 2017 and the largest pre-2022 cluster immediately after.

AI.tldr: 本文证明方差市场容量本质上是几何的：方差风险溢价为零的轨迹在参与者状态空间中构成一个余一维流形，参与度索引的Girsanov定价测度族在四个测度论公理下被迫通过溢价因子化，使溢价成为拥挤导致的定价扭曲的充分统计量。核心后果是"不可见性二分法"：期权价格携带接近容量的一阶信号当且仅当某个杠杆加权协方差非零，因此delta对冲市场（方差复制的主流制度）对产生系统性不稳定的轨迹结构性失明。实证部分用S&P 500波动率数据（2010-2023）验证了所有缩放定律的指数，但拒绝了唯一的可独立检验的传导闭包的无条件形式，且脆弱性指数能提前预警三大压力事件但无法预测严重程度。
AI.research_question: 方差市场的容量如何被几何地建模？期权价格对接近容量是否携带可检测信号？信息-容量度量具有何种几何结构？
AI.motivation: 传统的方差市场容量被建模为标量资本阈值，但本文证明容量本质上具有几何结构，需要更精细的数学框架来理解拥挤如何导致定价扭曲和系统性不稳定。
AI.theoretical_framework: 四个方面：1）余一维流形上的方差风险溢价消失轨迹；2）参与度索引的Girsanov测度族与测度论公理；3）信息-容量度量（黎曼/洛伦兹/退化三态）；4）反射边界系统的不变测度平均定理。
AI.method: 理论层面：测度论公理化方法构造定价测度族，证明充分统计量定理、不可见性二分法、签名定理、应力-信息互易律、平方根对偶性和平均定理。实证层面：使用S&P 500指数波动率数据（2010-2023）验证各指数缩放定律、传导闭包、脆弱性指数和溢价坐标的预测表现。
AI.findings: 1）所有缩放定律的指数被数值验证；2）唯一直立的传导闭包在无条件形式下被拒绝，仅在最深容量接近时保留符号一致的痕迹；3）脆弱性指数提前标记所有三大压力事件但无法预测严重程度；4）框架的溢价坐标作为前瞻性指标优于复合指数和波动率基准；5）负溢价事件聚集在系统性压力年份，2017年无此事件，2022年前最大聚集紧随其后。
