detail.abstract: This report analyzes five machine-generated model AI policies for law school coursework and examinations, produced by Harvey AI, Grok, Claude, Gemini, and ChatGPT in response to a prompt asking each system to construct a policy from the standpoint of computational machine intelligence, and compares them against Backer's related empirical study of twelve U.S. law school AI policies, "Structure, Opacity, and Convergence". The analysis summarizes each system's reasoning and resulting policy text, compares their structural choices along default polarity, drafting style, and autonomy architecture, and categorizes the five outputs by these dimensions. It gives particular attention to the functional divergence between Gemini's tool-based tiering (classifying software by computational architecture) and ChatGPT's task-based categorization (classifying assignments by information dependence), and assesses the practical feasibility of the versioning and archiving practices several systems propose. The analysis further considers, against the underlying Report's documented findings on axis independence, institutional opacity, template convergence, and faculty autonomy, the extent to which these machine-generated models affect the scope of human agency in law and their consequential implications for law's character as a human inter-operative system-finding that several systems' proceduralized verification requirements shift the evidentiary basis of agency toward documentation compliance, and that much of the systems' apparent computational originality derives from pre-existing human regulatory-design scholarship. Finally, the report documents a self-audit correcting citation-indexing errors and a mischaracterization suggesting Gemini underwent a shown revision process comparable to Harvey's and ChatGPT's, which the retrieved text does not support. Divided into an introduction and ten (10 substantive parts, this document captures a multi-stage experiment by Professor Larry Catá Backer, who asked five leading AI systems-Harvey AI, Grok, Claude, Gemini, and ChatGPT-to each construct, from "the basis of computational machine intelligence" and without endorsing any human position, a model AI policy for law school coursework and exams, and then pushed each system with a follow-up challenge to expose the value judgments hidden in its own language.

AI.tldr: 本报告分析了五个AI系统（Harvey AI、Grok、Claude、Gemini和ChatGPT）为法学院课程和考试生成的政策模型，并与Backer关于十二所美国法学院AI政策的实证研究进行了比较。分析聚焦于各系统的推理逻辑、政策文本结构、默认极性、起草风格和自主性架构，特别关注Gemini基于工具的分层与ChatGPT基于任务的分类之间的功能差异，并评估了多系统提出的版本管理和归档实践的实际可行性。
AI.research_question: 机器生成的AI政策模型在多大程度上影响了法律中的人类能动性范围，以及这对法律作为人类互动系统的性质有何影响？具体而言，五个AI系统生成的法学院AI政策与人类起草的政策在结构、逻辑和实际可行性上有何异同？
AI.motivation: 随着AI工具在法学院中的广泛使用，需要理解机器本身如何构想和构建AI使用政策。通过让AI系统从"计算机器智能的立场"而不是人类立场来起草政策，可以揭示AI系统自身的价值判断、结构偏好以及其"原创性"的真实来源，同时评估这些机器生成模型对人类在法律领域能动性的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 以Backer的"Structure, Opacity, and Convergence"实证研究为基准框架，涉及轴独立性（axis independence）、制度不透明性（institutional opacity）、模板趋同性（template convergence）和教师自主性（faculty autonomy）等理论维度。同时引入法律作为"人类互动系统"（human inter-operative system）的理论视角。
AI.method: 比较分析方法：1）要求五个AI系统从计算机器智能立场起草法学院AI政策；2）通过跟进挑战性提示暴露各系统语言中隐藏的价值判断；3）对五个输出进行结构和功能分类（默认极性、起草风格、自主性架构）；4）与Backer对十二所美国法学院AI政策的实证研究进行对比；5）特别比较Gemini基于计算架构的工具分层与ChatGPT基于信息依赖的任务分类。6）进行自审计纠正引文索引错误。
AI.findings: 研究发现：1）Gemini采用基于工具的分层（按软件计算架构分类），ChatGPT采用基于任务的分类（按作业信息依赖程度分类），二者存在功能性分歧；2）多个系统提出的程序化验证要求将能动性的证据基础从实质性判断转向文档合规；3）各系统表面上展现的计算"原创性"大部分源自已有的人类监管设计学术研究；4）自审计发现并纠正了引文索引错误以及对Gemini修订过程的错误描述。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）揭示了机器生成的AI政策模型如何将法律中的人类能动性范围从实质性判断转移向程序性文档合规，挑战了法律作为纯粹人类互动系统的传统理解；2）通过区分工具分层与任务分类两种政策架构逻辑，丰富了AI政策设计理论；3）确认了AI系统的"原创性"在很大程度上依赖于已有的人类学术研究，为理解"计算原创性"的本质提供了理论洞见。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为法学院制定AI使用政策提供了五个AI系统生成的参考模型及其比较分析，帮助决策者理解不同政策架构的利弊；2）指出多个系统提出的版本管理和归档实践的实际可行性问题，为政策实施提供了务实建议；3）通过自审计展示了学术研究中验证AI输出准确性和可靠性的重要性。

title: Asymmetric Analysis of Okun's Law: The Case for Turkey
affiliations: Marmara University - Department of Economics and Bahcesehir University

detail.title: Asymmetric Analysis of Okun's Law: The Case for Turkey
detail.abstract: This paper revisits Okun's law under an asymmetric approach for Turkey applying structural threshold regression model that allows for endogeneity of the threshold variable that separates the dataset into low and high regime periods according to economic growth. Moreover, the theory is investigated taking subcategories of unemployment rate into account, such as age, education and gender. Empirical findings suggest that only the overall unemployment rate and female unemployment rate reflect significantly negative impacts in both periods. During deep recessions, unemployment rates are more responsive to economic growth.

AI.tldr: 本文采用允许阈值变量内生性的结构门槛回归模型，在非对称框架下重新检验土耳其的奥肯定律，并将失业率按年龄、教育和性别进行细分。研究发现只有总体失业率和女性失业率在两个时期均呈现显著负向影响，且在深度衰退期间失业率对经济增长的响应更为敏感。
AI.research_question: 在非对称框架下，土耳其的奥肯定律是否成立？不同失业率子类别（按年龄、教育和性别划分）对经济增长的响应是否存在非对称性？
AI.motivation: 传统奥肯定律研究通常假设失业率与经济增长之间存在对称的线性关系，忽略了经济周期不同阶段（如衰退与扩张期）的非对称效应。此外，以往研究多使用总体失业率，未充分考虑不同人口群体（年龄、教育、性别）的异质性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 奥肯定律（Okun's Law），非对称效应理论，结构门槛回归模型（Structural Threshold Regression）
AI.method: 采用允许阈值变量内生性的结构门槛回归模型，以经济增长作为阈值变量将样本划分为低增长和高增长两个机制时期，并对失业率按年龄、教育和性别进行分类分析。
AI.findings: （1）只有总体失业率和女性失业率在两个时期均呈现显著的负向影响，与经济增长之间存在显著的负相关关系；（2）在深度经济衰退期间，各类失业率对经济增长的响应更为敏感，表明奥肯定律存在明显的非对称性。
AI.theory_contributions: （1）将非对称性引入奥肯定律的检验框架，拓展了传统线性模型的局限；（2）使用内生阈值变量的结构门槛回归方法，增强了阈值效应估计的可靠性；（3）将奥肯定律分析细化为人口子群体层面，丰富了该理论在劳动力市场异质性方面的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: （1）为土耳其的政策制定者提供了奥肯定律非对称性的经验证据，有助于在经济衰退时期制定更有针对性的就业刺激政策；（2）揭示了女性失业率对经济增长的高度敏感性，提示政策应特别关注女性劳动力市场的就业支持；（3）为新兴市场经济体的宏观经济政策调控提供了参考依据。

title: The Gate and the Playground: Age Attestation, Exclusion, and the Architecture of Verified Peer Space

detail.title: The Gate and the Playground: Age Attestation, Exclusion, and the Architecture of Verified Peer Space

declarations.declarationOfInterest: None to declare.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable
declarations.funderStatement: No funding.

detail.abstract: The age assurance debate has settled into a standoff between child safety and privacy in which each side concedes the other has a real interest and neither produces an architecture that serves both. This paper argues that the framing is wrong. The binding constraint on age assurance is neither safety nor privacy. It is exclusion, and exclusion is a distribution problem rather than a cryptographic one. The cryptography required to prove that a person is over a given age without disclosing the person's name, birthday, face, or any other attribute has existed since 1983, and the hardware required to bind a credential to the human presenting it is a deployed W3C standard. What does not exist is a credential that reaches everyone. Every scheme now on the table requires the subject to apply, to pay, to travel, to produce documents, or to own a device manufactured by one of the two companies the scheme is meant to regulate, and each of those requirements falls on the same populations: the poor, the undocumented, and the disabled. This paper proposes the distributive inversion. A boolean age predicate, blind signed by the issuing state, delivered on free standalone hardware, issued at birth alongside the identifiers a government already assigns, and entitled rather than applied for. It further argues that age assurance requires two credentials and not one, because a binary attestation that a holder is over eighteen forces responsible guardians to make platforms blind to the children they are trying to protect, and that the correct deliverable of the architecture is composition rather than exclusion: a space in which every occupant is a verified peer, every occupant's guardian has consented, and intensive supervision therefore raises no adult privacy objection because there is no adult inside to raise one. It argues that supervision is not an addition to the gate but the only mechanism that detects a compromised credential, which converts the rule against treating a gate as a discharge from a policy preference into an architectural necessity. It rejects the zero retention instinct on the ground that a child groomed at thirteen and disclosing at sixteen needs the record to exist, and proposes instead that the objection to retention was never duration but custody and purpose, resolved by escrow. The paper closes by identifying what the architecture does not solve, including the guardian who is himself the threat, the impossibility of binding an infant, the severing of relationships at band boundaries, and the bystander, who never approaches a gate at all and for whom no credential architecture can substitute for a rule keyed to the data subject.

AI.tldr: 本文提出年龄保证（age assurance）争论的框架是错误的：核心约束既不是儿童安全也不是隐私，而是排斥（exclusion）问题——即缺乏一种覆盖所有人的年龄凭证分发架构。作者提出"分配性反转"（distributive inversion）方案：由国家签发的布尔年龄谓词凭证，在出生时免费发放，并主张需要双重凭证（年龄证明+监护同意）以实现"组合而非排斥"的空间，同时通过托管（escrow）解决数据保留争议。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一种年龄保证架构，使其既能保护儿童安全，又能兼顾隐私，同时避免对贫困、无证者和残障人群的系统性排斥？
AI.motivation: 现有年龄保证争论在儿童安全与隐私之间陷入僵局，双方都承认对方利益但都无法提供兼顾两者的架构。作者指出真正的约束是排斥——所有现有方案都要求主体申请、付费、出行、提交文件或拥有特定设备，而这些要求不成比例地落在贫困、无证和残障人群身上。
AI.theoretical_framework: 论文基于以下理论视角：1）年龄保证的约束问题是分配（distribution）问题而非密码学（cryptographic）问题（密码学基础已自1983年存在）；2）排斥理论——凭证覆盖率（credential reach）而非技术能力是根本限制；3）架构必要性与政策偏好的区分——监督机制从可选变为架构必需；4）数据保留问题的重新框定：问题不在时长（duration）而在监护（custody）与目的（purpose）。
AI.method: 这是一篇法律与政策导向的规范论证论文（normative/argumentative paper），通过逻辑推理和架构分析展开论证，而非实证研究。作者通过重构问题框架、审视现有方案的排除性结构、提出替代架构设计，并对架构无法解决的边界案例进行系统分析。
AI.findings: 1）年龄保证的核心约束是排斥而非安全或隐私；2）密码学工具（1983年的零知识证明）和硬件标准（W3C）均已存在，缺席的是覆盖所有人的凭证分发体系；3）提出"分配性反转"——布尔年龄谓词凭证由国家盲签、免费硬件分发、出生时发放、默示授予而非申请获得；4）需要双重凭证（二进制的18岁以上证明+监护同意）而非单一凭证；5）监督（supervision）是检测被攻破凭证的唯一机制，因此是架构必需品；6）反对零保留原则，主张以托管解决数据保留问题；7）架构存在无法解决的边界问题：监护人本身是威胁、婴儿无法绑定、边界处的割裂、以及旁观的非门禁主体。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）重新框定年龄保证争论：从"安全vs隐私"的二元对立转向"排除vs包容"的分配问题；2）将政策偏好（gate不作为免责机制）转化为架构必要性论证；3）重新定义数据保留问题的分析维度：从时长转向监护与目的；4）提出"组合而非排斥"的空间概念，以双重凭证架构调和安全与隐私的张力。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）提出可操作的分发架构：国家出生登记时免费发放布尔年龄凭证；2）设计双重凭证架构，使平台既能验证年龄又不失监看儿童的能力；3）提出托管方案解决保留争议；4）明确指出架构边界（监护人威胁、婴儿绑定、旁观者问题），为政策制定者提供现实的预期管理；5）为监管机构提供超越现有平台自我认证和第三方验证方案的替代路线。

title: Urban-Rural Integration and Industrial Structural Transformation: Evidence from a Comprehensive Panel Analysis of Chinese Provinces

detail.title: Urban-Rural Integration and Industrial Structural Transformation: Evidence from a Comprehensive Panel Analysis of Chinese Provinces
detail.abstract: Urban-rural integration has become an important institutional approach to easing structural distortions and promoting balanced development, yet its implications for industrial transformation remain insufficiently understood. Drawing on provincial panel data for China, this study investigates whether and how urban-rural integration affects both the upgrading and rationalization of the industrial structure. An integrated empirical framework is employed, combining two-way fixed-effects estimation, policy evaluation, heterogeneity analysis, mediation modeling, and threshold testing. The results show that a higher level of urban-rural integration is significantly associated with improvements in both industrial upgrading and structural rationalization, indicating that spatial and institutional integration can promote a more advanced and more efficiently coordinated industrial system. Reform-oriented integration policies further reinforce these effects. At the same time, the impact of integration is heterogeneous across regions, with stronger effects observed in non-resource-oriented provinces and in regions with higher innovation capacity. The development of technology markets functions as an important transmission mechanism linking integration to structural transformation. The analysis also suggests that the structural effects of urban-rural integration are influenced by the broader distributional context of development, and tend to be stronger when the benefits of economic development are shared more evenly between urban and rural residents. These findings underscore the importance of institutional integration, market development, and inclusive development in facilitating structural transformation, while offering policy insights for economies seeking to reduce urban-rural segmentation and foster high-quality industrial development.

AI.tldr: 本文利用中国省级面板数据，研究了城乡融合对产业结构升级和合理化的影响。研究发现，城乡融合水平的提高显著促进产业升级和结构合理化，改革导向的融合政策进一步强化了这一效应；该效应在非资源型省份和创新能力较强的地区更为显著；技术市场发展是重要的传导机制；城乡收入分配更均衡时，融合对产业结构的积极效应更强。
AI.research_question: 城乡融合是否以及如何影响产业结构的升级与合理化？
AI.motivation: 城乡融合已成为缓解结构扭曲、促进均衡发展的重要制度路径，但其对产业转型的影响尚未得到充分理解。
AI.theoretical_framework: 城乡融合理论、产业结构转型升级理论、制度经济学理论
AI.method: 基于省级面板数据，采用双向固定效应估计、政策评估、异质性分析、中介效应模型和门槛效应检验的综合实证框架。
AI.findings: （1）城乡融合水平与产业升级和结构合理化显著正相关；（2）改革导向的融合政策强化该效应；（3）效应在非资源型省份和创新能力较强地区更显著；（4）技术市场发展是重要传导机制；（5）城乡收入分配越均衡，融合的产业结构效应越强。
AI.theory_contributions: 将城乡融合研究拓展至产业结构转型领域，揭示制度融合、市场发展与包容性发展对结构转型的作用机制，为理解城乡融合的产业经济学后果提供了系统的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为寻求减少城乡分割、促进高质量产业发展的经济体提供政策启示，强调制度融合、市场培育和包容性发展在促进结构转型中的重要性。

title: Patriarchal Systems and the Reproduction of Gender Inequality in South Asia: A Structural Analysis of Child Marriage, Education, and Social Norms
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Patriarchal Systems and the Reproduction of Gender Inequality in South Asia: A Structural Analysis of Child Marriage, Education, and Social Norms
detail.abstract: Gender inequality in South Asia remains a persistent social issue despite improvements in education, legal frameworks, and development indicators. This paper examines how patriarchal systems contribute to the continuation of gender inequality through interconnected structures, with a particular focus on child marriage, education, and social norms. Using a qualitative secondary research approach, this study analyzes feminist theory, academic research, and reports from international organizations to explore how family structures, cultural expectations, economic systems, and institutional practices shape the experiences of girls and women. Drawing on Sylvia Walby's theory of patriarchy and Kalwant Bhopal's intersectional perspective, this paper argues that gender inequality is not produced by a single factor but through overlapping systems that reinforce unequal gender relations. The analysis demonstrates that child marriage is sustained through social expectations surrounding family honor, sexuality, economic insecurity, and women's traditional roles. Furthermore, educational progress alone does not eliminate inequality when broader social and economic structures continue to restrict female autonomy. The study concludes that addressing gender inequality requires structural transformation rather than isolated interventions, as lasting change depends on challenging the systems that define girls' opportunities and social value.

AI.tldr: 本文通过定性二手研究，运用Sylvia Walby的父权制理论和Kalwant Bhopal的交叉性视角，分析了南亚地区父权制度如何通过童婚、教育和社会规范等相互关联的结构持续维持性别不平等，并主张解决这一问题需要结构性变革而非孤立干预。
AI.research_question: 南亚地区的父权制度如何通过相互关联的结构（童婚、教育、社会规范）持续维持性别不平等？
AI.motivation: 尽管南亚地区在教育、法律框架和发展指标方面有所改善，但性别不平等仍是持续存在的社会问题，需要深入理解其背后的结构性成因。
AI.theoretical_framework: Sylvia Walby的父权制理论（六种相互作用的父权结构）以及Kalwant Bhopal的交叉性视角
AI.method: 定性二手研究法，分析女性主义理论、学术研究及国际组织报告
AI.findings: 童婚通过家庭荣誉、性观念、经济不安全和女性传统角色的社会期望得以维持；教育进步本身并不能消除不平等，因为更广泛的社会经济结构仍限制女性自主权。
AI.theory_contributions: 论证性别不平等并非由单一因素产生，而是通过重叠的父权系统交叉强化不平等性别关系，丰富了父权制理论和交叉性理论在南亚语境下的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 指出解决性别不平等需要结构性变革而非孤立干预，为政策制定者和实践者提供了重要的干预方向启示。

title: Planning Parkour Parks as Public Physical Activity Environments in Finland: Practitioner Expertise and Participation
affiliations: University of Helsinki, Helsinki University and

detail.title: Planning Parkour Parks as Public Physical Activity Environments in Finland: Practitioner Expertise and Participation

declarations.declarationOfInterest: None
declarations.funderStatement: None

detail.abstract: Parkour parks translate the creative use of non-dedicated urban environments into purposebuilt physical activity environments. This article examines that transformation through four Finnish cases: Valkola in Laukaa, Kaleva Central Park in Tampere, Lippumäki in Kuopio, and Namika Areena in Helsinki. The study draws on interviews with four key planning and implementation actors and six parkour practitioner experts, supported by site photographs and contextual documents. The analysis compared project pathways, actor roles, practitioner expertise, and material design. The findings show that the parks were justified mainly through local demand, children's and young people's activity, neighbourhood recreation, and sport service provision. Practitioner expertise had the strongest influence when it entered early enough to shape equipment selection, layout, or site-specific design. Practitioner experts considered all four parks usable for some forms of movement but raised concerns about modular repetition, obstacle spacing, surface materials, slipperiness, limited run-up or landing space, and the capacity of standardized parks to support diverse parkour styles. The article argues that parkour parks should be understood not only as sport facilities but as public physical activity environments whose usability depends on translating embodied movement expertise into material design. It contributes to public space scholarship by showing how practice-based expertise shapes specialized recreational environments through its timing and role in planning and procurement.

AI.tldr: 本文通过芬兰四个跑酷公园案例（Laukaa的Valkola、Tampere的Kaleva中心公园、Kuopio的Lippumäki和Helsinki的Namika Areena），探讨非专用城市环境如何转化为专用体育活动环境。研究发现公园的正当性主要基于本地需求、儿童青少年活动、社区休闲和体育服务供给；实践者专业知识进入规划越早，对设备选择、布局和场地设计的影响越大。文章主张跑酷公园不仅是体育设施，更是公共体育活动环境，其可用性取决于将身体运动专业知识转化为物质设计的能力。
AI.research_question: 非专用城市环境如何转化为专用的跑酷体育活动环境？实践者的专业知识如何在规划与实施过程中影响跑酷公园的设计与可用性？
AI.motivation: 跑酷公园作为将城市非专用环境创意性使用转化为专用体育活动环境的典型案例，但其规划过程和实践者专业知识的作用尚未得到充分研究，需要理解这种转化机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 公共空间研究、实践导向的专业知识（embodied movement expertise）理论、体育活动环境设计理论
AI.method: 多案例比较研究：对四个芬兰跑酷公园的四个关键规划实施行动者和六位跑酷实践者专家进行访谈，辅以场地照片和背景文件分析，比较项目路径、行动者角色、实践者专业知识和物质设计。
AI.findings: 1) 公园的正当性主要基于本地需求、儿童青少年活动、社区休闲和体育服务供给；2) 实践者专业知识进入规划越早影响力越强，可影响设备选择、布局和场地特定设计；3) 实践者专家认为四个公园均可用于某种形式的运动，但对模块化重复、障碍间距、表面材料、湿滑性、有限的助跑或落地空间以及标准化公园支持多样化跑酷风格的能力表示担忧。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了公共空间研究，展示了基于实践的专业知识如何通过其在规划和采购中的时机与角色，塑造专门化的休闲运动环境。
AI.practical_contributions: 为跑酷公园规划者和设计者提供实践指导：应尽早引入实践者专业知识以确保公园设计能真正支持多样化的跑酷运动需求，避免标准化设计带来的局限性。

title: Existence and Convergence of Discrete-Time Kyle Models with Multiple Insiders
affiliations: Ulsan National Institute of Science and Technology (UNIST) and Rutgers, The State University of New Jersey

detail.title: Existence and Convergence of Discrete-Time Kyle Models with Multiple Insiders
detail.abstract: Foster and Viswanathan (1996) extend the discrete-time setting of Kyle (1985) to multiple informed traders who have partial information about the stock's terminal dividend. We resolve two long-standing open problems in this literature. First, we prove that an equilibrium exists in the setting of Foster and Viswanathan (1996). Second, as the number of trading times goes to infinity, we prove that the discrete-time equilibrium converges to the continuous-time equilibrium already proven to exist in Back, Cao, and Willard (2000).

AI.tldr: 本文解决了Foster和Viswanathan（1996）扩展Kyle（1985）多知情交易者模型中两个长期悬而未决的问题：一是证明了该离散时间设定下均衡的存在性；二是证明了当交易次数趋于无穷时，离散时间均衡收敛到Back、Cao和Willard（2000）已证明存在的连续时间均衡。
AI.research_question: 在Foster和Viswanathan（1996）的多知情交易者部分信息离散时间模型中，均衡是否存在？离散时间均衡是否收敛到连续时间均衡？
AI.motivation: Foster和Viswanathan（1996）将Kyle（1985）的离散时间模型扩展至多个具有部分终端股利信息的知情交易者，但该模型中均衡的存在性一直是未解决的开放问题，且离散时间与连续时间均衡之间的收敛关系也未被证明。
AI.theoretical_framework: Kyle（1985）的市场微观结构知情交易模型；Foster和Viswanathan（1996）的多知情交易者部分信息离散时间扩展框架；Back、Cao和Willard（2000）的连续时间均衡框架。
AI.method: 数学证明方法：通过严格的均衡存在性证明技术，并结合极限分析论证离散时间均衡向连续时间均衡的收敛性。
AI.findings: 第一，在Foster和Viswanathan（1996）的设定下证明了均衡的存在性；第二，当交易次数趋于无穷时，离散时间均衡收敛到Back、Cao和Willard（2000）的连续时间均衡。
AI.theory_contributions: 填补了多知情交易者部分信息模型中均衡存在性证明的理论空白；建立了离散时间与连续时间模型之间的严格收敛性桥梁，统一了该分支文献的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为市场微观结构理论提供了更坚实的理论基础，有助于理解多知情交易者在部分信息条件下的交易行为和市场价格发现过程，并对市场设计的理论依据提供支持。

title: Emerging Perspectives of Intra-Industry Trade in India’s Manufacturing Sector
affiliations: Dibrugarh University

detail.title: Emerging Perspectives of Intra-Industry Trade in India’s Manufacturing Sector

declarations.declarationOfInterest: No Conflict of Interest.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Does not arise
declarations.funderStatement: Nil

detail.abstract: This study explored India’s multilateral intra-industry trade trends, noting a substantial rise, especially since 2000s. A focused examination within specific industries identifies electronic and transportation commodity groups as the principal drivers of this escalating trend. The analysis centered on factors influencing India’s intra-industry trade (IIT), emphasizing on revealed comparative advantage (RCA) and an outward-oriented trade policy. The RCA-IIT relationship unveils an inverted U-shaped curve. Significantly, a positive relationship emerges between IIT and an outward-oriented trade policy, highlighting the impact of trade liberalization on enhancing IIT. These findings hold crucial policy implications, indicating the role of trade liberalization initiatives in increasing IIT in India.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了印度多边产业内贸易（IIT）趋势，发现自2000年代以来显著上升，电子和运输商品是主要驱动力。分析聚焦于显性比较优势（RCA）和对外开放贸易政策对印度IIT的影响，发现RCA与IIT呈倒U型关系，对外开放贸易政策与IIT呈正相关关系。
AI.research_question: 哪些因素影响印度的产业内贸易（IIT）？特别是显性比较优势（RCA）和对外开放贸易政策如何影响印度的产业内贸易？
AI.motivation: 印度自2000年代以来产业内贸易大幅增长，但对其驱动因素的系统性分析不足，尤其是RCA与贸易政策对IIT的影响机制尚待阐明。
AI.theoretical_framework: 产业内贸易理论（IIT）、显性比较优势理论（RCA）、贸易自由化与对外开放政策理论
AI.method: 对印度多边产业内贸易趋势进行统计分析，聚焦电子和运输商品等特定行业，并构建计量模型检验RCA与对外开放贸易政策对IIT的影响，揭示RCA-IIT的倒U型关系以及贸易政策与IIT的正向关系。
AI.findings: 1）印度产业内贸易自2000年代以来显著上升，电子和运输商品是主要驱动行业；2）RCA与IIT呈倒U型关系；3）对外开放贸易政策与IIT呈正相关关系，表明贸易自由化能提升产业内贸易。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了RCA与IIT之间呈倒U型曲线的非线性关系，丰富了产业内贸易决定因素的理论认识；同时证实了对外开放贸易政策对产业内贸易的促进作用，为贸易自由化与IIT关系提供了实证证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为印度及类似发展中国家提供了政策启示，表明贸易自由化举措能够有效提升产业内贸易水平，对制定对外贸易政策具有重要参考价值。

title: How Do Ecological Restoration Programs Shape Grain Production? Evidence from China's Three-North Shelter Forest Program
affiliations: Beijing Forestry University, Beijing Forestry University and Beijing Forestry University

detail.title: How Do Ecological Restoration Programs Shape Grain Production? Evidence from China's Three-North Shelter Forest Program
detail.abstract: Balancing ecological restoration and grain production is a core challenge for land management in arid and semi-arid regions. Large-scale ecological engineering programs are often assumed to constrain agricultural output through land-use competition, yet rigorous causal evidence on their long-term effects and underlying mechanisms remains scarce. This study investigates whether and how China's Three-North Shelter Forest Program (TNSFP) affects grain production. Guided by the social-ecological systems framework and ecosystem services theory, we hypothesize that large-scale ecological restoration can enhance agricultural output through improvements in ecosystem services rather than crowding out cropland. Using county-level panel data from China covering 2000-2022, we estimate the causal impact of TNSFP on grain production employing a two-way fixed effects model, complemented by the Callaway and Sant'Anna difference-indifferences approach (CSDID), event-study analysis, placebo tests, and multiple robustness checks. Grain production data are combined with satellite-derived vegetation indices, air quality indicators, and ecosystem quality measures to identify mechanism pathways. The results show that TNSFP significantly increases county-level grain production, with baseline estimates indicating an average rise of approximately 3.4 units and larger effects after controlling for agricultural inputs, climate, and socioeconomic conditions. CSDID estimates confirm robust positive effects,. Event-study results reveal negligible pre-treatment trends and gradually accumulating post-treatment effects. Mechanism analysis demonstrates that improved vegetation cover, enhanced air quality, and overall ecosystem quality jointly promote grain production, with ecosystem quality playing a dominant role. Significant regional and land endowment heterogeneity is observed, with stronger effects in cropland-abundant counties and limited impacts in Northwest China. These findings provide new causal evidence that ecological restoration can generate synergistic benefits for land restoration and food production, offering important implications for sustainable land management in dryland regions.

AI.tldr: 本文利用中国2000-2022年县级面板数据，采用双向固定效应模型和CSDID方法，实证检验了三北防护林工程（TNSFP）对粮食生产的因果影响。研究发现TNSFP显著提升了县级粮食产量，其机制在于改善植被覆盖、空气质量和整体生态系统质量，而非挤占耕地，为生态修复与粮食生产的协同效益提供了新证据。
AI.research_question: 中国三北防护林工程（TNSFP）是否以及如何影响粮食生产？大规模生态修复工程对农业产出是产生挤出效应还是促进作用？
AI.motivation: 在干旱和半干旱地区，平衡生态修复与粮食生产是土地管理的核心挑战。大规模生态工程通常被认为会通过土地竞争限制农业产出，但缺乏严格的因果证据来验证其长期效应和潜在机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 社会-生态系统框架（Social-Ecological Systems Framework）和生态系统服务理论（Ecosystem Services Theory）
AI.method: 采用双向固定效应模型（TWFE）估计TNSFP对粮食生产的因果影响，辅以Callaway和Sant'Anna双重差分法（CSDID）进行稳健性验证，并结合事件研究分析、安慰剂检验及多项稳健性检验。粮食生产数据与卫星植被指数、空气质量指标和生态系统质量指标相结合以识别机制路径。
AI.findings: （1）TNSFP显著增加县级粮食产量，基线估计显示平均增长约3.4个单位，控制农业投入、气候和社会经济条件后效应更大；（2）CSDID估计确认了稳健的正向效应；（3）事件研究显示处理前趋势不显著，处理后效应逐渐累积；（4）机制分析表明植被覆盖改善、空气质量提升和生态系统质量改善共同促进粮食生产，其中生态系统质量起主导作用；（5）存在显著的地区和土地禀赋异质性，耕地充裕县份效应更强，西北地区影响有限。
AI.theory_contributions: 为"生态修复通过改善生态系统服务促进农业产出"这一假设提供了严格的因果证据，挑战了生态工程必然挤占耕地的传统假设，拓展了社会-生态系统框架在生态工程评估中的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为干旱半干旱地区的可持续土地管理提供政策启示，表明生态修复与粮食生产可以实现协同效益，为未来生态工程的设计和评价提供了实证依据。

title: "Sanctions and the Uneven Reorganisation of Labour Regimes in Iran"
affiliations: State University of New York (SUNY) - Stony Brook, Students

detail.title: "Sanctions and the Uneven Reorganisation of Labour Regimes in Iran"

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing interests.
declarations.ethicsApproval: The study did not involve any participants or human subjects. The research methodology is mainly document analysis and did not require any ethics review or approval.
declarations.funderStatement: No funding was received for this research.

detail.abstract: In what ways do sanctions transform labour regimes within sanctioned economies? Existing research has shown that sanctions generate macroeconomic disruption, including inflation, fiscal pressure, currency instability, welfare erosion, and employment loss. Less attention has been given to how these pressures are translated into labour control and social reproduction. This article develops a labour-regime approach to sanctions by analysing them as a restriction on the monetary, material, and infrastructural circulation required for industrial accumulation. Drawing on a comparative process tracing across five Iranian industrial sites, it argues that sanctions reorganise labour through uneven forms of incorporation rather than a uniform labour-market shock. In strategic sectors, state support helps sustain production, while workers are incorporated through subcontracting, segmented benefits and weakened claims on the main employer. In declining sectors, workers are attached to eroded production through wage arrears, legal claims, and demands for state intervention. The article contributes to labour-regime theory by showing how geopolitical coercion is absorbed into industrial organisation through protected production, managed decline, and the displacement of reproductive costs onto workers and households.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种"劳动体制"（labour-regime）视角来分析制裁如何转变受制裁经济体内的劳动安排。通过对伊朗五个工业场址的比较过程追踪，文章发现制裁并非造成统一的劳动力市场冲击，而是通过"不平等的整合形式"重组劳动：在战略产业中，工人经由分包、分割化福利和弱化的雇主诉求被整合；在衰退产业中，工人通过欠薪、法律诉求和对国家干预的呼吁被附着于萎缩的生产。制裁的成本最终被转嫁给工人和家庭。
AI.research_question: 制裁以何种方式转变受制裁经济体中的劳动体制？
AI.motivation: 现有研究关注制裁带来的宏观经济破坏（通胀、财政压力、货币不稳定、福利侵蚀、就业损失），但较少关注这些压力如何转化为劳动控制和社会再生产层面的影响。作者旨在填补这一空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 劳动体制理论（labour-regime theory）；将制裁视为对工业积累所需的货币、物质和基础设施流通的限制。
AI.method: 比较过程追踪（comparative process tracing），基于伊朗五个工业场址的研究。
AI.findings: 制裁通过不平等的整合形式重组劳动，而非统一的劳动力市场冲击。在战略部门，国家支持维持生产，工人通过分包、分割化福利和弱化的雇主诉求被整合；在衰退部门，工人通过欠薪、法律诉求和要求国家干预被附着于萎缩的生产。
AI.theory_contributions: 对劳动体制理论的贡献在于展示地缘政治强制如何通过受保护的生产、有管理的衰退以及将再生产成本转嫁给工人和家庭，被吸收进工业组织之中。
AI.practical_contributions: 揭示制裁背景下劳动安排的异质性，有助于理解受制裁经济体中工人处境的分化以及制裁政策的社会成本。

title: When Prices Cannot Fall: Asymmetric Price Limits and the Information Content of Trading Volume
affiliations: and Universiti Malaysia Terengganu (UMT)

detail.title: When Prices Cannot Fall: Asymmetric Price Limits and the Information Content of Trading Volume
detail.abstract: Between 20 July 2020 and 31 May 2021, Bursa Malaysia halved the daily limit on how far every stock could fall while leaving the limit on gains untouched. Regime changes studied to date have moved both limits together or applied only to distressed firms; this one moved one side of an entire market for ten months and then moved it back. We use the episode, together with the rule driven cross section of band widths that Malaysia's sen denominated limits create, to measure how constraints on price discovery reshape the information in trading volume. In a survivorship free panel of 902 firms over 2016 to 2025, surprise volume forecasts next day volatility twice as strongly as expected volume, and this informativeness rises with the mechanical tightness of a firm's band even in the ordinary regime. Inside the window, floor touches multiply nearly forty-fold and the falling day volume signal triples. Exposure based difference in differences separates rule from episode: the informativeness surge is market wide, not concentrated in the firms the new floor could reach, while the mechanical costs, more frequent hits and elevated next day volatility, land on exactly those firms. In the upper tail of the volatility distribution, where risk models are judged, surprise volume speaks nearly four times as loudly as in calm states while predictable volume inverts into a dampener. Volume is a policy contingent signal. Regulators who compress price discovery should expect information to migrate into trading activity, and risk systems should read it there.

AI.tldr: 本文利用马来西亚证券交易所（Bursa Malaysia）在2020年7月至2021年5月期间实施的"不对称涨跌幅限制"政策（仅将跌幅限制减半、涨幅限制不变）作为天然实验，研究了价格发现约束如何重塑交易量中的信息含量。研究发现：意外交易量对次日波动率的预测能力是预期交易量的两倍，且这种信息含量随涨跌幅带宽的机械收紧而上升；在政策窗口期内，触及跌停次数增加近40倍，下跌日交易量信号增至三倍；基于暴露程度的双重差分显示，信息激增是市场范围的，而机械成本（更频繁的触及限制和更高的次日波动率）则集中在受新跌停限制影响的个股上。在波动率分布的极端上尾，意外交易量的信息含量是平静状态的四倍，而可预测交易量则反向转为抑制因素。研究揭示交易量是政策权变信号，监管者压缩价格发现时，信息会迁移到交易活动中。
AI.research_question: 当监管政策压缩价格发现空间（如单边收紧涨跌幅限制）时，交易量中的信息含量如何发生变化？具体而言：（1）意外交易量与预期交易量对次日波动率的预测能力有何差异？（2）机械性收紧迫涨跌幅带宽如何影响交易量的信息含量？（3）政策冲击的影响是市场范围性的还是集中在特定个股上？
AI.motivation: 以往关于涨跌幅限制的实证研究要么同时移动涨跌幅上下限，要么仅针对陷入困境的公司，无法干净识别单边限制对价格发现的影响。马来西亚此事件提供了独特机遇：整个市场单边限制持续十个月后又恢复，配合马币分（sen）计价产生的规则驱动的横截面带宽差异，使得研究者能够识别价格发现约束如何重塑交易量中的信息。
AI.theoretical_framework: 价格发现理论、信息不对称理论、市场微观结构理论、交易量的信息含量理论（信息迁移理论）
AI.method: 使用2016至2025年902家公司的无幸存者偏差面板数据，结合以下方法：（1）回归分析比较意外交易量与预期交易量对次日波动率的预测能力；（2）利用政策窗口期的准自然实验设计；（3）基于暴露程度的双重差分（Difference-in-Differences）方法区分规则效应与事件效应；（4）分析波动率分布的不同尾部状态下的异质性效应。
AI.findings: （1）意外交易量对次日波动率的预测能力是预期交易量的两倍；（2）交易量信息含量随涨跌幅带宽的机械收紧而上升，即使在正常制度下也成立；（3）政策窗口期内，触及跌停次数增加近40倍，下跌日交易量信号增至三倍；（4）信息激增是市场范围的，而非仅集中于受新跌停限制的个股；但机械成本（更频繁触及限制、更高的次日波动率）恰恰集中在受影响的个股上；（5）在波动率分布的上尾（极端状态下），意外交易量的信息含量是平静状态的近四倍，而可预测交易量反而逆转为抑制因素。
AI.theory_contributions: （1）首次识别单边涨跌幅限制对交易量信息含量的因果效应；（2）提出并验证"交易量是政策权变信号"的理论观点，即当价格发现被压缩时，信息会迁移到交易活动中；（3）将规则效应与事件效应分离，揭示市场微观结构约束与信息效率之间的理论机制；（4）揭示了意外交易量与预期交易量在不同波动率状态下信息含量的非对称性，丰富了信息交易理论。
AI.practical_contributions: （1）为监管者提供警示：压缩价格发现（如收紧跌停限制）会导致信息向交易量迁移，监管者应预期并关注这一现象；（2）为风险管理系统提供指导：在波动率极端状态下应更多依赖意外交易量信号，同时注意可预测交易量可能产生反向抑制作用；（3）为交易所评估涨跌幅限制政策的效果提供了新的评估维度和方法论参考。

title: Agentic AI, Price Discovery, and Endogenous Human Innovation in Finance
affiliations: HEC Montreal

detail.title: Agentic AI, Price Discovery, and Endogenous Human Innovation in Finance

declarations.declarationOfInterest: N/A
declarations.ethicsApproval: N/A
declarations.funderStatement: N/A

detail.abstract: Research in intelligent finance shows that agentic AI improves portfolio construction, default prediction, fraud detection, and network-risk identification by separating payoff-relevant signal from noisy data. This article models the economic and social impact of that improvement once the signal enters human decision-making and market prices. Let θₜ denote the pre-decision state, sₖ,ₜ an increasingly precise agentic signal, and pₖ,ₜ=E[vₜ|Fᵐₜ,sₖ,ₜ,oₜ] a price formed from public information, the agentic signal, and order flow. Blackwell improvement lowers current-state pricing error and can reduce informational asymmetry, improve allocation, and widen access to information. The same gain expands human search. Economic agents update beliefs, revise timing, recombine instruments, and create actions absent from the original model; these responses form part of θₜ₊₁. A projection result establishes improved price informativeness for the current state. A second result shows that information-induced innovation can coexist with that improvement while preventing mean-square convergence of successor state to a deterministic fixed point. Nonstationarity is not evidence that agentic AI failed. It may be the measurable consequence of information provision and human innovation. Economic and social impact should be evaluated through price discovery, decision quality, endogenous option creation, distribution, and dynamic welfare.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了智能金融中代理型AI如何通过Blackwell改进提升价格信息效率，同时揭示了信息引发的内生创新（如人类搜索行为改变、工具重组）可能导致后继状态无法收敛到确定性固定点，从而论证非平稳性并非AI失败的证据，而可能是信息供给与人类创新的可测量结果。
AI.research_question: 代理型AI提升的信号质量进入人类决策和市场价格后，其经济和社会影响是什么？信息改进与内生创新如何共同塑造动态均衡？
AI.motivation: 现有智能金融研究多聚焦于代理型AI在投资组合构建、违约预测、欺诈检测等任务中的直接改进，但缺乏对这些改进进入人类决策与市场价格后的经济和社会影响的系统建模。
AI.theoretical_framework: Blackwell信息改进理论、理性预期定价模型、信息经济学、内生创新理论
AI.method: 理论建模：构建包含前决策状态θₜ、代理型信号sₖ,ₜ和价格pₖ,ₜ的动态模型；通过投影结果证明当前状态价格信息效率的改进；通过第二个结果证明信息引致创新与价格改进可以共存但阻止均方收敛。
AI.findings: （1）Blackwell改进可降低当前状态定价误差、减少信息不对称、改善资源配置并扩大信息获取；（2）信息增益会扩展人类搜索，经济主体更新信念、调整时机、重组工具并创造新行动，这些反应构成后继状态的一部分；（3）投影结果表明当前状态价格信息效率提高；（4）信息引致创新可在价格改进的同时阻止后继状态向确定性固定点的均方收敛。
AI.theory_contributions: 将Blackwell信息改进理论从静态决策框架扩展到包含人类内生反应的动态经济系统；提出"非平稳性可能反映信息供给下的创新而非AI失败"的新理论视角；建立信息效率、内生创新与非收敛之间的形式化关系。
AI.practical_contributions: 为评估代理型AI的经济和社会影响提供了多维框架（价格发现、决策质量、内生期权创造、分配和动态福利）；指导实践者在非平稳环境中正确解读AI效果，避免将创新驱动的非平稳性误判为AI失败。

title: "Sanctions, Value-Chain Rupture, and the Recomposition of Labour Bargaining Power in Iran"
affiliations: State University of New York (SUNY) - Stony Brook, Students

detail.title: "Sanctions, Value-Chain Rupture, and the Recomposition of Labour Bargaining Power in Iran"

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing interests.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This research involved no human subjects or participants. The research is mainly done by document and secondary analysis.
declarations.funderStatement: No funding was received for this research.

detail.abstract: This article argues that economic sanctions recompose labour bargaining power in Iran by producing value-chain rupture, understood as sanctions-driven disruption of settlement and procurement that makes production and revenue realisation intermittent and uncertain. Sanctions constrain payment, foreign-exchange access, and compliance-dependent trade infrastructures, and firms respond through wage delay, selective operation, and employment fragmentation. The article analyses these dynamics through three levers of labour power, marketplace, workplace, and associational, by tracing how sanctions alter the conditions under which exit, disruption, and organisation translate into outcomes. Drawing on a sectoral comparison of HEPCO in importexposed manufacturing and Campaign 1400 in the energy sector, the analysis shows how uneven exposure and buffering capacity generate distinct bargaining environments. In import-dependent manufacturing, procurement ruptures and liquidity crises compress outside options and reduce the efficacy of work stoppage, often rerouting claims into state-mediated channels. In strategic energy nodes, coordinated disruption can impose costs more directly, but fireability, settlement constraints, and fragmented employment limit gains and shorten organisational time horizons. The article specifies how uneven value-chain rupture shapes bargaining outcomes and constrains the durability of collective organisation in sanctioned economies.

AI.tldr: 本文论证经济制裁通过造成价值链断裂（制裁驱动的结算与采购中断，使生产和收入实现变得间歇性和不确定）来重塑伊朗的劳工议价能力。通过市场、工作场所和联合三个劳工权力杠杆的分析框架，结合HEPCO（进口依赖型制造业）和Campaign 1400（能源部门）的部门比较，揭示不均衡的制裁暴露与缓冲能力如何产生不同的议价环境。
AI.research_question: 经济制裁如何通过价值链断裂重塑被制裁经济体中劳工的议价能力？制裁对不同部门的劳工—资本关系产生了哪些差异化影响？
AI.motivation: 现有文献对经济制裁的经济后果已有大量研究，但对制裁如何影响劳工权力和劳资议价动态的关注不足。制裁造成的生产中断、支付限制等机制如何重构工人与雇主的权力关系，是一个重要的未充分研究问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 劳工权力三杠杆框架：市场权力（marketplace）、工作场所权力（workplace）和联合权力（associational）；结合价值链断裂（value-chain rupture）概念，分析退出、中断和组织三种机制在制裁条件下的转化条件。
AI.method: 部门比较研究（sectoral comparison）：对比进口暴露型制造业（HEPCO）与能源部门（Campaign 1400）两个案例，追踪制裁如何通过不同暴露程度和缓冲能力塑造议价环境。
AI.findings: （1）在进口依赖型制造业中，采购断裂和流动性危机压缩了工人的外部选择（outside options），降低了停工行动的有效性，迫使诉求转向国家中介渠道；（2）在战略能源节点中，协调性中断能更直接地施加成本，但可解雇性、结算制约和碎片化就业限制了收益并缩短了组织时间视野。
AI.theory_contributions: 将价值链断裂概念引入劳工权力分析，阐明了制裁条件下劳工议价能力如何被结构性重构；细化了不同部门暴露程度和缓冲能力如何产生异质性议价环境，深化了对制裁经济体中集体组织持久性约束机制的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解制裁条件下工人抗争的有效性条件提供了经验证据；揭示了进口依赖型制造业与战略能源部门工人面临的不同约束与策略空间，对劳工组织和政策制定者具有参考意义。

title: The Microstructure of European Electricity Markets: A Review of Nord Pool, EPEX SPOT, XBID/SIDC, and the Consolidated Order Book
affiliations: Imperial College London - Department of Mathematics, Imperial College London and Imperial College London

detail.title: The Microstructure of European Electricity Markets: A Review of Nord Pool, EPEX SPOT, XBID/SIDC, and the Consolidated Order Book
detail.abstract: Short-term electricity markets in Europe have evolved from national pools into a tightly coupled, pan-European market architecture comprising a single day-ahead coupling (SDAC), a single intraday coupling (SIDC, formerly the XBID project) built around a consolidated shared order book, complementary intraday auctions (IDAs), and harmonised balancing platforms. This review surveys the institutional design and the market microstructure of these markets, with particular attention to Nord Pool, EPEX SPOT, the XBID/SIDC continuous trading solution, and the economics of order-book consolidation across exchanges and borders. We cover the mechanics of the day-ahead auction and the EUPHEMIA algorithm, the contract and order-type taxonomy of the continuous intraday market, gate-closure conventions, tick sizes and price bounds, and the transition to fifteen-minute market time units completed in 2025. We then review the empirical microstructure literature: liquidity and bid-ask spread dynamics, the concentration of trading activity near gate closure, fundamental price formation, self-exciting order-flow models based on Hawkes processes, market impact and liquidity costs, very-short-term price forecasting, and optimal trading and reinforcement-learning approaches. We discuss the interaction between intraday trading and imbalance settlement, the continuous-versusauction market-design debate, competition among nominated electricity market operators sharing a single order book, and open research problems including the microstructure of intraday auctions, flow-based intraday capacity allocation, and the latency arms race in algorithmic power trading.

AI.tldr: 本文综述了欧洲短期电力市场从国家性市场池向紧密耦合的泛欧洲市场架构演进的制度设计与微观结构，涵盖SDAC单一日前耦合、SIDC/XBID单一日内耦合、补充性日内拍卖（IDA）及协调平衡平台，并系统回顾了日内市场的实证微观结构文献与开放研究问题。
AI.research_question: 欧洲短期电力市场的制度设计及其市场微观结构如何演进？日内连续交易市场的微观结构实证研究现状与开放问题是什么？
AI.motivation: 欧洲短期电力市场经历了从国家性市场到泛欧洲一体化市场的重大制度转型，但缺乏对此类市场架构及其微观结构的系统性综述；同时，日内连续交易市场的实证微观结构研究分散，需要整合梳理以指引未来研究方向。
AI.theoretical_framework: 市场微观结构理论，包括流动性理论、买卖价差动态、Hawkes过程自激订单流模型、市场冲击与流动性成本理论、最优交易与强化学习框架。
AI.method: 系统性文献综述方法，对制度机制（如EUPHEMIA算法、订单类型分类、闸门关闭惯例、tick尺寸与价格界限、15分钟市场时间单元）及实证微观结构文献（流动性、价差、订单流、价格预测、最优交易）进行综合评述。
AI.findings: 1. 欧洲短期电力市场已形成由SDAC、SIDC/XBID、IDA和平衡平台构成的一体化架构；2. 日内市场交易活动高度集中于闸门关闭前后；3. 盘口合并带来流动性效益但引发NEMO间竞争与延迟军备竞赛等问题；4. 存在连续交易与拍卖两种市场设计的持续争论；5. 日内拍卖微观结构、基于流量的日内容量分配等仍为开放问题。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将欧洲短期电力市场的制度设计（SDAC/SIDC/IDA）与日内连续交易市场的实证微观结构研究进行系统性整合综述，为电力市场微观结构领域提供了统一的分析框架和知识图谱。
AI.practical_contributions: 为电力市场运营商（如Nord Pool、EPEX SPOT）、监管机构与政策制定者提供了关于市场设计选择（连续vs拍卖）、订单簿合并的经济效应、以及算法交易监管方向的系统性参考，有助于优化欧洲电力市场运行效率。

title: A Different Perspective on the Keynes Model: Is Keynes a Demand-Side Economist?
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: A Different Perspective on the Keynes Model: Is Keynes a Demand-Side Economist?
detail.abstract: Since the publication of The General Theory of Employment, Interest and Money, Keynes has remained one of the most influential figures in modern economics. Keynesian economics, through its various theoretical adaptations, continues to serve as a fundamental reference framework for macroeconomic policy design and analysis in both developed and developing countries. This paper challenges the widely accepted view in contemporary macroeconomics that Keynes was a demand-side economist. Drawing on the General Theory, together with the relevant literature, we argue that I ≡ Sbased models are insufficient to represent the supply-side effects of investment and contain analytical and mathematical inconsistencies. To address these limitations, we develop a new theoretical macroeconomic model within the aggregate supply-aggregate demand (AS-AD) framework that incorporates the effects of investment expenditures on both aggregate demand and aggregate supply, thereby offering an alternative to conventional one-sided approaches. We also develop a new microeconomic model within the framework of perfectly competitive supply-demand analysis that incorporates the demand effects arising from changes in the number of firms. Furthermore, building on the interaction between supply and demand-a methodological approach adopted by Keynes himselfwe propose an integrated graphical representation of Keynes's theory of employment within the AS-AD framework. Taken together, the analytical results obtained from the original models and representations developed in this study, together with the comparisons with the existing literature and the examination of Keynes's original text, suggest that Keynes's analytical framework incorporates a significant supply-side dimension that is compatible with the basic logic of Say's Law and therefore cannot be adequately characterized as an exclusively demand-side approach.

AI.tldr: 本文挑战当代宏观经济学中认为凯恩斯是纯需求侧经济学家的主流观点。基于《通论》文本及相关文献，论证I≡S模型不足以代表投资的供给侧效应且存在分析性和数学上的不一致。作者在AS-AD框架下发展新的宏观理论模型，同时纳入投资支出对总需求和总供给的双重影响；并在完全竞争供需分析框架下发展包含企业数量变化所产生的需求效应的微观模型。基于凯恩斯本人采用的供需相互作用方法论，在AS-AD框架下提出凯恩斯就业理论的综合图形表示。分析结果表明凯恩斯的分析框架包含显著的供给侧维度，与萨伊定律的基本逻辑相容，不能仅被定性为纯需求侧方法。
AI.research_question: 凯恩斯的经济学分析框架是否真的是纯需求侧的？即凯恩斯理论是否包含与萨伊定律逻辑相容的供给侧维度？
AI.motivation: 当代宏观经济学普遍将凯恩斯视为需求侧经济学家，这一广泛接受的观点可能误解了凯恩斯《通论》的真实分析框架。现有I≡S模型无法充分代表投资的供给侧效应，并含有分析性和数学上的不一致，因此需要重新审视凯恩斯理论的供需双侧维度。
AI.theoretical_framework: 凯恩斯《就业、利息和货币通论》中的就业理论；总供给—总需求（AS-AD）框架；完全竞争供需分析框架；萨伊定律；凯恩斯自身所采用的供给与需求相互作用的方法论。
AI.method: 理论建模方法：在AS-AD框架下构建新的宏观经济模型，纳入投资支出对总需求和总供给的双重影响；在完全竞争供需分析框架下构建包含企业数量变化的微观模型；结合凯恩斯原文文本分析与现有文献比较，提出AS-AD框架下的就业理论综合图形表示。
AI.findings: 凯恩斯的分析框架包含显著的供给侧维度，其与萨伊定律的基本逻辑相容；基于I≡S的模型不足以充分代表投资的供给侧效应且存在分析性和数学上的不一致；新开发的宏观模型和微观模型以及综合图形表示能够更全面地呈现凯恩斯的就业理论。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战并修正了当代宏观经济学将凯恩斯视为纯需求侧经济学家的主流观点；发展出同时纳入投资供给侧和需求侧效应的新宏观理论模型；构建了包含企业数量变化需求效应的新微观模型；在AS-AD框架下提出了凯恩斯就业理论的综合图形表示，为理解凯恩斯理论提供了供需双侧的新视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为宏观经济政策设计与分析提供了重新理解凯恩斯理论供给侧含义的理论基础，有助于政策制定者在制定宏观经济政策时同时考虑投资对总需求和总供给的双重效应，避免单纯依赖需求侧政策思路的局限性。

title: Are LLMs Reliable Coders of Communication Content in Economic Experiments?
affiliations: , Division of Social Science & Center for Behavioral Institutional Design, NYU Abu Dha and New York University of Abu Dhabi

detail.title: Are LLMs Reliable Coders of Communication Content in Economic Experiments?
detail.abstract: Analysis of free-form communication from experiments has largely relied on manual coding by research assistants (RAs), a costly and time-consuming process. We outline an easily implemented method for coding communication data using large language models (LLMs) and propose a novel standard for evaluating the performance of LLM-based coding ("reliability"). Using data from three published articles, we find that LLM-based coding meets our two reliability conditions: (1) differences between LLM-based and RA-based coding are no larger than differences between the RA-based and original coding and (2) the LLM-based coding largely replicates qualitative conclusions from the original papers. That said, there are cases where the LLM-based coding agrees poorly with the RA-based coding or fails to replicate statistical results from the original papers. We demonstrate that these problems can be ameliorated with better prompt design. We conclude that use of LLMs can reduce research costs and time without sacrificing reliability, making content analysis a more accessible tool for experimental economists. However, only with a combination of test coding by RAs and prompt design by researchers can we avoid significant problems with LLM-based coding, highlighting the continued importance of human input.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种使用大语言模型（LLM）对实验中的自由形式沟通数据进行编码的方法，并提出了评估LLM编码性能的新标准（"可靠性"）。基于三篇已发表文章的数据，作者发现LLM编码满足两个可靠性条件：与人工编码（RA）的差异不超过原始编码与RA编码的差异，且能基本复现原文的定性结论。但在某些情况下LLM编码与RA编码一致性较差或无法复现统计结果，这些问题可通过改进提示词设计来缓解。作者认为LLM可以降低研究成本和时间且不牺牲可靠性，但需要结合RA测试编码和研究者的提示词设计，人类投入仍然重要。
AI.research_question: 如何利用大语言模型（LLM）对实验中的自由形式沟通数据进行编码，并确保其可靠性和有效性？
AI.motivation: 传统上，实验中的自由形式沟通数据分析依赖研究助理（RAs）进行人工编码，这一过程成本高昂且耗时。需要一种更高效的方法来编码沟通数据，同时保证编码质量。
AI.theoretical_framework: 提出了一个新的评估标准——"可靠性"（reliability），包含两个条件：（1）LLM编码与RA编码之间的差异不超过RA编码与原始编码之间的差异；（2）LLM编码能基本复现原始论文的定性结论。
AI.method: 使用三篇已发表文章的数据，采用LLM（大语言模型）对自由形式沟通数据进行编码，并与传统RA人工编码进行比较，评估两类编码在一致性和结论复现方面的表现，同时测试通过改进提示词设计来提升编码质量。
AI.findings: （1）LLM编码满足两个可靠性条件：与RA编码的差异不超过RA与原始编码的差异，且能基本复现原文定性结论；（2）但在部分案例中LLM编码与RA编码一致性较差或无法复现统计结果；（3）通过更好的提示词设计可以缓解这些问题；（4）LLM可以降低研究成本和时间，但不牺牲可靠性。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个用于评估LLM编码性能的新标准（"可靠性"），为内容分析方法的自动化提供了方法论框架，丰富了实验经济学中内容分析工具的理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为实验经济学家提供了一种易于实施的低成本、高效率的沟通数据编码方法，使内容分析工具更易获取。同时强调需要结合RA测试编码和研究者的提示词设计，突出了人类投入在LLM编码过程中的持续重要性。

title: Project POLARIS: The Arctic AI Infrastructure Initiative - A National Strategy for Energy-Secure, Water-Responsible, and Resilient Artificial Intelligence Infrastructure

detail.title: Project POLARIS: The Arctic AI Infrastructure Initiative - A National Strategy for Energy-Secure, Water-Responsible, and Resilient Artificial Intelligence Infrastructure

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is an elected municipal official in Texas and is employed in the energy sector. This paper was prepared independently on personal time, without employer, governmental, or vendor sponsorship. The paper is vendor-neutral, and the author declares no financial interest in any company or technology discussed. AI use disclosure: The author used an AI assistant (Anthropic's Claude) in drafting, research aggregation, and document preparation. The concept, system architecture, and all editorial decisions are the author's own, and the author takes full responsibility for the content.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. It was prepared and self-funded by the author.

detail.abstract: America's AI build-out is running into three walls: electricity, cooling, and water. Data centers already use about 4 percent of U.S. electricity and could use up to 12 percent by 2028, and most new campuses are being built in water-stressed regions where evaporative cooling consumes millions of cubic meters of freshwater a year. Project POLARIS proposes building the next generation of AI campuses on cold northern coastlines, designed as integrated energy systems: small modular reactors and hydropower supply carbon-free electricity; the ocean's deep, cold water absorbs waste heat through sealed closed-loop heat exchangers, consuming no freshwater; and before reaching the ocean, that heat warms homes, greenhouses, and fish farms. Every component operates commercially today - deep-water district cooling in Toronto since 2004, fjord-cooled data centers in Norway, Arctic renewable data centers in Iceland, small modular reactors under construction in North America. The paper develops the reference architecture and thermal-electrical balances for a 500 MW campus, proposes a U.S.-Denmark-Greenland flagship demonstration aligned with the three governments' active 2026 economic discussions, and a domestic companion track under the U.S. Department of Energy's AI-infrastructure-on-federal-lands program. The recommended first step is a joint feasibility study and twelve months of oceanographic data at candidate sites. Also published as DOI 10.5281/zenodo.21366524.

AI.tldr: 本文提出POLARIS项目，主张在寒冷北部海岸线建设下一代AI数据中心园区，将其设计为集成能源系统：利用小型模块化反应堆和水电提供无碳电力，通过密封闭环换热器利用海洋深层冷水吸收废热（不消耗淡水），并在热量到达海洋前用于供暖住宅、温室和养鱼场。论文为500兆瓦园区开发了参考架构和热-电平衡，并提出美-丹-格陵兰旗舰示范项目及美国能源部国内配套项目。
AI.research_question: 如何设计下一代AI数据中心园区，以同时解决电力、冷却和用水三大瓶颈，建设在寒冷北部海岸线的集成能源系统是否可行的方案？
AI.motivation: 美国AI基础设施建设正遭遇电力、冷却和水资源三大瓶颈：数据中心已消耗美国约4%的电力，到2028年可能达12%；且多数新园区建在水资源紧张地区，蒸发冷却每年消耗数百万立方米淡水。需要寻找可持续的替代方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 集成能源系统理论、海水深冷冷却（深海区域供冷）技术框架、封闭循环换热理论、小型模块化反应堆与可再生能源互补供电的能源架构理论。
AI.method: 参考架构设计与热-电平衡建模（针对500 MW园区）；基于现有商业化技术的案例分析（多伦多深水区域供冷、挪威峡湾冷却数据中心、冰岛北极可再生能源数据中心、北美在建小型模块化反应堆）；政策与示范项目设计（美-丹-格陵兰三方旗舰示范、美国能源部联邦土地AI基础设施项目）。
AI.findings: POLARIS方案的所有组成技术均已商业化运行；500 MW园区的热-电平衡在技术上是可行的；通过余热梯级利用（供暖温室、养鱼场等）可实现从成本中心到价值创造的转变；建议第一步进行联合可行性研究和12个月的候选站点海洋学数据采集。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了将AI数据中心园区设计为集成能源系统（能源生产-冷却-余热利用三位一体）的参考架构，扩展了数据中心可持续性的理论框架，将地理选址理论与能源系统设计理论相结合。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了美-丹-格陵兰三方示范项目和国际合作的实施路径；为美国能源部提供了联邦土地AI基础设施项目的国内配套方案；为行业提供了全方位解决电力、冷却、用水三大瓶颈的工程可行蓝本。

title: Bend the Form, Preserve the Will: The Contract as Bamboo in Modern Cross-Border Business

detail.title: Bend the Form, Preserve the Will: The Contract as Bamboo in Modern Cross-Border Business
detail.abstract: Most contracts are engineered to survive: force majeure, severability, carefully chosen governing law, calibrated indemnities. This defensive architecture answers binary questions in a regulatory environment that no longer produces binary events. Drawing on the allegory of the oak and the bamboo, this essay argues that survival and flexion are distinct design objectives: a contract that survives remains valid while the regulatory ground moves; a contract that flexes remains operational. The argument rests on a conceptual claim, that the contract is an expression of will rather than a rulebook, and on a structural one, that in cross-border transactions the contract does not document the business but constitutes its architecture, since no shared institutional infrastructure exists to fill its gaps. Successive regulatory waves (GDPR, the AI Act, the Data Act) have exposed the cost of rigidity: instruments that remained valid yet required wholesale renegotiation. The essay proposes three design principles for adaptive contractual architecture: declaring an immovable core and flexible instrumental layers; converting regulatory change from contingency into routine through pre-agreed adaptation mechanisms; and designing for divergence between jurisdictions. Survival, it concludes, is the floor. Flexion is the competitive edge.

AI.tldr: 本文以"橡树与竹子"为喻，论证合同的设计目标应区分为"生存"（保持有效）与"屈曲"（保持可操作）。主张合同是意志的表达而非规则手册，在跨境交易中合同构成交易的架构。基于GDPR、AI法案、数据法案等监管浪潮暴露僵化成本，提出三个自适应合同设计原则：声明不可动摇的核心与灵活工具层、将监管变化从偶然转化为常规、设计跨司法管辖区的分歧应对。
AI.research_question: 在监管环境不再产生二元事件（即监管不断变化的背景下），合同应如何设计以适应监管波动？生存与屈曲作为两种不同的设计目标应如何区分与实现？
AI.motivation: 传统合同的防御性架构（不可抗力、可分割性、精心选择的准据法、校准的赔偿条款）回应的是二元问题，但当前监管环境已不产生二元事件。GDPR、AI法案、数据法案等连续监管浪潮使合同虽然保持有效（survive）却需要全面重新谈判，暴露了僵化的成本。
AI.theoretical_framework: 概念性主张：合同是意志的表达而非规则手册；结构性主张：跨境交易中合同不记录业务而是构成其架构（因不存在共享制度基础设施来填补合同空白）。
AI.method: 概念论证与规范性分析（essay），运用橡树与竹子的寓言作为分析框架，并通过GDPR、AI Act、Data Act等监管实例进行论证。
AI.findings: 生存是地板（最低要求），屈曲是竞争优势。提出三个设计原则：1）宣布不可动摇的核心与灵活的工具层；2）通过预先约定的适应机制将监管变化从偶然转化为常规；3）设计跨管辖区分歧的应对方案。
AI.theory_contributions: 区分"合同生存"与"合同屈曲"为两个截然不同的设计目标；提出合同作为意志表达非规则手册的重新概念化；确立跨境交易中合同作为架构构成而非文档记录的理论主张。
AI.practical_contributions: 为跨境合同起草提出三个可操作的设计原则，帮助企业在监管波动环境中降低重新谈判成本，从被动防御转向主动适应，获得竞争优势。

title: Ambiguity, Cash Management, Investment and Financing Structure
affiliations: Hunan University and Hunan University - School of Finance and Statistics

detail.title: Ambiguity, Cash Management, Investment and Financing Structure
detail.abstract: We develop a dynamic continuous-time growth-option model in which ambiguity-averse shareholders face financing constraints. The firm is initially financed with legacy debt and equity, and investment can be funded with internal liquidity, external equity, and newly issued debt. Shareholders jointly choose cash retention, payout, investment timing, and financing. We provide closed-form solutions for equity and debt values before and after investment, together with the associated corporate policies. Furthermore, we highlight the implications of ambiguity and derive the following novel results. First, we demonstrate that ambiguity aversion only leads shareholders to have risk-taking incentives and generates shareholder-debtholder agency conflicts near liquidity default. Second, we find that ambiguity aversion makes shareholders prefer the barrier strategy to the band strategy for payout policies before investment. Third, when the amount of legacy debt is low, ambiguity aversion leads shareholders to issue more new debt, decrease the internal funding for investment, and accelerate investment. In contrast, the results are reversed when the amount of legacy debt is high.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个动态连续时间增长期权模型，其中模糊厌恶的股东面临融资约束。企业初始由存量债务和权益融资，投资可通过内部流动性、外部权益和新发债务来融资。股东联合选择现金留存、派息、投资时机和融资方式。本文提供了投资前后股权和债务价值的闭式解，并揭示了模糊厌恶的影响：模糊厌恶仅在接近流动性违约时引发股东风险承担激励和股东-债权人代理冲突；模糊厌恶使股东在投资前偏好屏障策略而非带状策略；在存量债务较低时，模糊厌恶促使股东发行更多新债、减少内部融资并加速投资，而存量债务较高时结果相反。
AI.research_question: 在模糊厌恶股东面临融资约束的动态增长期权模型中，模糊厌恶如何影响企业的投融资决策、代理冲突以及股东的风险承担激励？
AI.motivation: 现有文献大多在风险（而非模糊）框架下分析企业投融资决策与代理冲突，未充分考虑股东对不确定性（模糊）的态度。本文旨在弥补这一空白，考察模糊厌恶如何改变股东在企业投资时机、融资结构、派息政策及与债权人之间的代理冲突中的行为。
AI.theoretical_framework: 动态连续时间增长期权模型；模糊厌恶理论（ambiguity aversion）；代理理论（股东-债权人冲突）；融资约束理论；最优投资时机与最优资本结构理论
AI.method: 采用动态连续时间建模方法，构建包含存量债务、内部流动性、外部权益和新发债务的融资框架，求解投资前后股权和债务价值的闭式解，并比较不同模糊厌恶水平下的企业政策。
AI.findings: 第一，模糊厌恶仅在接近流动性违约时引发股东风险承担激励，并产生股东-债权人代理冲突。第二，模糊厌恶使股东在投资前偏好屏障策略（barrier strategy）而非带状策略（band strategy）作为派息政策。第三，当存量债务较低时，模糊厌恶导致股东发行更多新债、减少内部融资用于投资并加速投资；当存量债务较高时，上述结果发生逆转。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次在增长期权框架中系统地整合模糊厌恶与融资约束，揭示了模糊厌恶对股东风险承担激励、股东-债权人代理冲突、派息策略选择以及债务水平影响作用的条件依赖性（取决于存量债务水平），丰富了模糊决策理论与公司金融代理理论的交叉研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业股东在不确定性环境下制定投资时机、融资结构和派息政策提供了理论指导；揭示了存量债务水平对企业融资决策的影响方向依赖模糊态度，有助于管理层和债权人理解在不同债务水平下的利益冲突与风险行为，对债务契约设计和风险管控具有参考价值。

title: Identifying Daily Oil Market Shocks: Evidence from the Hormuz Crisis
affiliations: Polytechnic University of Milan - Department of Management, Economics and Industrial Engineering, Fondazione Eni Enrico Mattei (FEEM), University of Milan-Bicocca, Italy - Department of Economics, Management and Statistics (DEMS) and Fondazione Eni Enrico Mattei (FEEM)

detail.title: Identifying Daily Oil Market Shocks: Evidence from the Hormuz Crisis
detail.abstract: This paper develops a daily Bayesian structural VAR model of the global crude oil market that decomposes the real price of oil into three fundamental drivers: shocks to global real economic activity, shocks to oil price expectations and shocks to physical oil supply. We combine a daily signrestriction identification strategy with a posterior filtering step based on monthly physical oil market data, which sharpens the economic interpretation of the estimated daily shocks. We apply the model to provide a real-time interpretation of the main drivers behind the 2026 Strait of Hormuz crisis, one of the largest and most abrupt oil price shocks of recent years. Our results show that oil supply shocks account for the bulk of the initial price surge following the closure of the Strait, aggregate demand shocks become increasingly important in sustaining elevated prices over the following weeks and expectational shocks act in the direction of mitigating the oil price surge. We further validate the model against four major historical episodes-the 2003-08 oil price boom, the Global Financial Crisis, the 2014-15 oil price collapse, and the COVID-19 pandemic-showing that the daily decomposition is consistent with the prevailing narrative of these events. The framework offers policymakers a timely tool for monitoring the structural sources of oil price fluctuations as they unfold.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个全球原油市场的日度贝叶斯结构VAR模型，将实际油价分解为三个基本驱动因素：全球实际经济活动冲击、油价预期冲击和实物石油供给冲击。结合日度符号约束识别策略与基于月度实物石油市场数据的后验过滤步骤，提升日度冲击的经济解释力。应用该模型实时解读2026年霍尔木兹海峡危机，发现供给冲击主导了初始价格飙升，需求冲击在后续数周维持高位价格中作用增大，预期冲击则起到缓解作用。模型在四个历史时期（2003-08油价繁荣、全球金融危机、2014-15油价暴跌、新冠疫情）均验证有效。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个日度频率的贝叶斯结构VAR模型来分解全球原油价格波动中的三大结构性驱动因素（供给冲击、需求冲击、预期冲击），并实时识别其对各重大油价事件（尤其是2026年霍尔木兹海峡危机）的贡献？
AI.motivation: 传统油价分解模型多为月度或更低频率，难以捕捉突发性油价冲击（如地缘政治危机）的日度动态特征。现有日度模型又常缺乏经济可解释性。因此需要一个既能高频捕捉油价波动、又能保持经济含义清晰的分析框架，以支持政策制定者的实时监测需求。
AI.theoretical_framework: 贝叶斯结构VAR模型；日度符号约束识别策略；后验过滤步骤（基于月度实物石油市场数据）；三种基本冲击分类框架（供给冲击、需求冲击、预期冲击）
AI.method: 构建日度贝叶斯结构VAR模型，采用符号约束识别策略区分三种结构性冲击（实物供给、实际经济活动、价格预期），并引入月度实物石油市场数据作为后验过滤步骤以改善日度冲击的经济解释力。模型应用于2026年霍尔木兹海峡危机的实时解读，并在四个历史事件中进行验证。
AI.findings: (1) 2026年霍尔木兹海峡危机中，供给冲击驱动了初始价格飙升的大部分； (2) 综合需求冲击在随后数周维持高油价中作用渐增； (3) 预期冲击在危机期间起到缓解油价上涨的作用； (4) 模型在2003-08油价繁荣、全球金融危机、2014-15油价暴跌和新冠疫情四个历史事件中的日度分解与公认叙事一致。
AI.theory_contributions: (1) 将贝叶斯结构VAR框架从传统的月度/低频扩展至日度，填补了高频油价分解方法论空白； (2) 创新性地结合日度符号约束与月度实物数据后验过滤，提升了日度冲击识别的经济解释力； (3) 为全球原油市场中供给、需求、预期三类冲击提供了统一的日度分解框架。
AI.practical_contributions: (1) 为政策制定者提供了实时监测油价波动结构性来源的工具，可用于危机期间的及时干预决策； (2) 通过多历史事件验证，增强了模型作为油价监测和预警工具的可靠性； (3) 为理解地缘政治危机（如霍尔木兹海峡关闭）期间的油价动态提供了清晰的因果分解。

title: Comparative Analysis of Patents on Hydrogen Technologies in Selected Latin American Countries:  Argentina, Brazil, Chile, Colombia and Mexico
affiliations: Max Planck Institute for Innovation and Competition

detail.title: Comparative Analysis of Patents on Hydrogen Technologies in Selected Latin American Countries:  Argentina, Brazil, Chile, Colombia and Mexico

publicationDetails.detailsText: Max Planck Institute for Innovation & Competition Research Paper No. 26-09
publicationDetails.journalName: Max Planck Institute for Innovation & Competition Research Paper Series

detail.abstract:
This study provides a comparative analysis of patent activity related to hydrogen technologies in Argentina, Brazil, Chile, Colombia and Mexico, with a focus on hydrogen production, storage and end-use applications. Based on an initial dataset of 495 patent applications, the study examines the legal status, technological scope and ownership structure of hydrogen-related patents in the selected jurisdictions. 

The findings show that patenting activity in the region is highly concentrated in foreign companies, with limited participation by local firms, universities and research institutions. While Latin America has significant potential to become a major producer of green hydrogen, the patent landscape suggests the region currently plays a more limited role in developing and owning the key technologies that will shape the hydrogen economy.

AI.tldr: 本研究对阿根廷、巴西、智利、哥伦比亚和墨西哥五个拉美国家的氢能技术专利活动进行了比较分析，涵盖氢能生产、储存和终端应用。基于495项专利申请的数据集，研究发现该地区专利活动高度集中于外国公司，本地企业、大学和研究机构参与有限，表明拉美虽具有绿色氢能生产潜力，但在塑造氢能经济的关键技术开发与所有权方面扮演的角色仍然有限。
AI.research_question: 拉丁美洲主要国家（阿根廷、巴西、智利、哥伦比亚和墨西哥）在氢能技术领域的专利活动现状如何？包括专利的法律状态、技术范围和所有权结构特征。
AI.motivation: 拉美地区具有成为绿色氢能主要生产国的巨大潜力，但需要了解该地区在氢能关键技术的开发与所有权方面的实际参与程度，以评估其在全球氢能经济中的战略地位。
AI.theoretical_framework: 专利分析框架，涉及氢能技术分类（生产、储存、终端应用）、专利法律状态评估与国家间比较分析方法。
AI.method: 比较分析方法，基于495项氢能相关专利申请的数据集，对五个拉美国家的专利法律状态、技术范围及所有权结构进行系统分析。
AI.findings: （1）该地区氢能专利活动高度集中于外国公司；（2）本地企业、大学和研究机构参与有限；（3）拉美虽然在绿色氢能生产上有显著潜力，但在关键技术的开发与所有权方面作用有限。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了拉美地区在全球氢能技术专利版图中的位置，为理解发展中地区在清洁能源技术自主创新中的挑战提供了实证证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为拉美国家制定氢能技术创新政策提供依据，提示各国需要加强本土研发能力和专利布局，以避免在全球氢能经济中被边缘化。

title: Salamanca and Philadelphia: A Convergent Genealogy of Popular Sovereignty and Institutional Resistance

detail.title: Salamanca and Philadelphia: A Convergent Genealogy of Popular Sovereignty and Institutional Resistance

contentType.other: Paper submitted to 10th Annual Madrid Conference on Austrian Economics

detail.abstract: The confluence of the 500th anniversary of the School of Salamanca (1526) and the 250th anniversary of the United States Declaration of Independence (1776) in 2026 provides a critical opportunity to re-evaluate the history of early modern legal and economic thought. The present article posits that the relationship between these two intellectual traditions is best understood through a model of convergent parallelism-a mediated, trans-confessional transmission rooted in a shared Western legal heritage, rather than direct, unverified attribution. The Late Scholastic political theology of Francisco de Vitoria and Francisco Suárez developed a systematic doctrine of subjective natural rights (iura), popular sovereignty, and fiduciary constraints on state coercion that structurally mirrors the core political architecture of the 1776 Declaration. Moving beyond self-contained Whig and civic-republican historiographies, this study demonstrates how Salamanca's innovations anticipated modern constitutional rights frameworks. It traces the trans-confessional migration of these scholastic taxonomies as they were secularised by Protestant natural-law jurists-most notably Hugo Grotius, Samuel von Pufendorf, and Johannes Althusius-and documents their concrete integration into the colonial British American higher education curriculum under John Witherspoon at Princeton. Finally, the article provides a metahistorical account of the subsequent Anglo-American silence regarding this lineage. Rather than a simple accidental oversight, this absence was sustained by the early republic's self-definition within an exclusively Anglo-Whig narrative of liberty, deeply conditioned by inherited Black Legend cultural biases and ongoing geopolitical rivalries with the Spanish Empire. By evaluating these structural dynamics, the article restores a marginalised, Late Scholastic root to the global genealogy of constitutional liberty.

AI.tldr: 本文在萨拉曼卡学派500周年与美国《独立宣言》250周年交汇之际，提出"趋同并行"模型重新审视两者关系，论证晚近经院哲学的维托里亚和苏亚雷斯所发展的主观自然权利、人民主权及对强制权力的受托人约束理论，在结构上镜像了1776年《独立宣言》的政治架构，并追溯其经由新教自然法学家（格劳秀斯、普芬道夫、阿尔图修斯）的世俗化转译及在普林斯顿大学约翰·威瑟斯庞主持下的殖民地高等教育中的具体整合，同时从元历史角度解释这一谱系此后在英美叙事中保持沉默的原因——这种沉默由早期共和国以盎格鲁-辉格自由叙事自我定义、黑人传奇（Black Legend）文化偏见及与西班牙帝国的地缘政治竞争共同维系。
AI.research_question: 萨拉曼卡学派的晚近经院政治神学与1776年美国《独立宣言》之间是否存在实质性的思想关联？如果存在，这种关联的本质是什么，以及为何这一谱系在后来的英美史学中被系统性地遗忘？
AI.motivation: 2026年恰逢萨拉曼卡学派500周年与美国《独立宣言》250周年两大纪念交汇，为重新评估早期现代法律与经济思想史提供了关键契机。既有研究要么将《独立宣言》限定在辉格史观或公民共和主义史观的自足叙事中，要么缺乏对两大思想传统间关系的确证，本文试图超越这些局限，恢复一个被边缘化的晚近经院哲学根源在全球宪政自由谱系中的地位。
AI.theoretical_framework: "趋同并行"（convergent parallelism）模型——强调经由共享的西方法律遗产为中介的、跨教派的传播机制，而非直接文献归因；同时整合晚近经院政治神学、新教自然法理论、元历史（metahistorical）叙事分析等理论资源。
AI.method: 本文采用思想史与概念史研究方法，通过文本比较分析追踪主观自然权利、人民主权、受托人约束等概念从萨拉曼卡学派到新教自然法学家再到殖民地美国教育体系的迁移路径，并结合元历史分析考察该谱系被英美叙事边缘化的结构性原因。
AI.findings: 研究发现：1）维托里亚与苏亚雷斯的晚近经院理论在核心政治架构上与《独立宣言》存在结构性镜像关系；2）萨拉曼卡的创新经由格劳秀斯、普芬道夫、阿尔图修斯等新教自然法学家的世俗化转译，实现了跨教派的思想迁移；3）这些思想通过约翰·威瑟斯庞在普林斯顿的教学被具体整合进殖民地美国的高等教育课程；4）此后的英美沉默并非偶然疏忽，而是由盎格鲁-辉格自我定义、黑人传奇偏见和地缘政治竞争共同维持的叙事选择。
AI.theory_contributions: 本文的理论贡献在于：提出"趋同并行"模型替代简单的直接归因论，为思想传播研究提供了更精细的分析框架；突破自足的辉格史观和公民共和主义史观，将萨拉曼卡学派纳入全球宪政自由的谱系之中，重构了早期现代法律与经济思想的跨国、跨教派传播图景。
AI.practical_contributions: 本文的实践贡献在于：在两大历史纪念交汇的2026年，为重新审视宪政自由的思想谱系提供了学术基础；通过揭示英美叙事中的结构性遗忘机制，有助于推动跨文化、跨教派的思想对话，挑战单一民族叙事对全球思想遗产的垄断。

detail.abstract: Handwritten medicine-name recognition remains a challenging problem in medical informatics,particularly in low-resource healthcare settings such as Bangladesh, where handwritten prescriptionsare still widely used. This study presents a comparative evaluation of deep learning architectures forisolated handwritten medicine-name recognition using a newly constructed balanced Bangladeshihandwritten medicine-name dataset developed for this study, containing 22,190 images from 317medicine classes. Seven models were evaluated under a unified training and preprocessing protocol:five CNN-based baselines, namely VGG16, VGG19, DenseNet121, MobileNetV2, and EfficientNet-B0, along with two hybrid fusion models, CNN-BiLSTM and CNN-Attention. In the in-domain testsetting, all models achieved Top-1 accuracies above 97%, indicating strong recognition capabilityunder the training-data distribution. DenseNet121 obtained the highest Top-1 accuracy of 98.85%,while CNN-BiLSTM achieved the highest Top-5 accuracy of 99.85% and the highest Macro F1-score of 0.987. Since the in-domain performance differences among several models were small,the results are interpreted as comparative rather than statistically conclusive superiority claims. Toexamine robustness beyond the primary dataset, an additional evaluation was designed using anindependently sourced Bangladeshi prescription dataset with 25 overlapping medicine classes. Thisexternal evaluation analyzes how model performance changes when exposed to handwriting samplesfrom a different data source. Overall, this work provides a structured comparative analysis of CNN-based, feature-fusion, attention-based, and BiLSTM-based models for handwritten medicine-namerecognition.

AI.tldr: 本研究构建了一个包含22,190张图像、317个类别的新型孟加拉语手写药品名称数据集，并在统一训练协议下系统比较了七种深度学习架构（五种CNN基线和两种混合融合模型）的手写药品名称识别性能。域内测试中所有模型Top-1准确率均超过97%，DenseNet121达到最高98.85%的Top-1准确率，CNN-BiLSTM取得最高Top-5准确率（99.85%）和Macro F1分数（0.987）。此外设计了一项外部数据集评估以检验模型的跨数据源鲁棒性。
AI.research_question: 在低资源医疗场景（如孟加拉国）中，不同深度学习架构对手写药品名称识别的性能表现如何？特别是在域内测试和跨数据源外部测试两种场景下的比较评估。
AI.motivation: 孟加拉国等低资源医疗环境中仍广泛使用手写处方，手写药品名称识别是医疗信息学中的挑战性问题，但缺乏系统的深度学习模型比较评估，且缺乏针对孟加拉语手写药品名称的专属数据集。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于深度学习的图像识别理论，涵盖CNN架构（VGG16、VGG19、DenseNet121、MobileNetV2、EfficientNet-B0）以及混合架构（CNN-BiLSTM和CNN-Attention）的特征提取与融合机制。
AI.method: 构建包含22,190张图像、317个类别的平衡孟加拉语手写药品名称数据集；在统一训练与预处理协议下评估七种模型（五种CNN基线和两种混合融合模型）；进行域内测试和基于独立来源孟加拉语处方数据集的25个重叠类别的外部验证。
AI.findings: 域内测试中所有模型Top-1准确率均超过97%；DenseNet121获得最高Top-1准确率（98.85%）；CNN-BiLSTM获得最高Top-5准确率（99.85%）和最高Macro F1分数（0.987）。但由于多个模型间差异较小，结果被解读为比较性结论而非统计上确凿的优势声明。外部评估进一步分析了模型面对不同数据源手写样本时的性能变化。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了CNN基线与特征融合、注意力机制、BiLSTM等混合架构在手写药品名称识别任务上的系统性比较分析框架；通过外部数据集验证补充了跨数据源鲁棒性评估的理论证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 构建了首个大型平衡孟加拉语手写药品名称公开数据集（22,190张图像、317个类别），为低资源医疗环境中的手写处方数字化提供了有价值的基准和模型选择依据。

This is a comprehensive introduction and teaching tool for digital-markets antitrust, updated through Summer 2026. For licensing information and the rest of the book, see www.antitrustcasebook.org.

AI.tldr: 本文是《反垄断法：原则、案例与材料》（第4版，2026年）第十四章的内容，系统介绍了数字市场反垄断法的基本原理与案例，更新至2026年夏季，作为课堂教学工具使用。
AI.research_question: 数字市场中的反垄断法律原则、判例与材料如何系统梳理与教学呈现？
AI.motivation: 随着数字平台经济的快速发展，传统反垄断框架面临新的挑战，需要综合性的教学材料帮助学生与从业者理解数字市场的反垄断规则。
AI.theoretical_framework: 反垄断法理论框架，包括市场界定、市场支配地位认定、竞争损害理论等核心概念在数字市场语境下的适用。
AI.method: 教材编写方法，系统梳理相关法律原则、典型案例与教学材料，并综合最新判例与法规进展。
AI.findings: 该章提供了数字市场反垄断的全面教学框架，涵盖截至2026年夏季的最新法律发展。
AI.theory_contributions: 为数字市场反垄断教学提供了系统化的理论与案例整合框架，将传统反垄断理论与数字平台经济特征相结合。
AI.practical_contributions: 作为高等教育教材，为法学院学生、律师及反垄断从业者提供了实用的数字市场反垄断学习资源，并配套在线开放获取平台。

title: Nowcasting GDP with Digital Payments: Evidence from Uganda
affiliations: Bocconi University, , , Bank of Uganda, Bank of Uganda, Bank of Uganda,  and Bank of Uganda

detail.title: Nowcasting GDP with Digital Payments: Evidence from Uganda

publicationDetails.journalName: BAFFI Centre on Economics, Finance & Regulation Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: In developing economies, output statistics arrive with long lags and omit a large informal sector, while digital payment systems record a growing share of transactions in near real time. We assess whether these records improve GDP nowcasts in Uganda, exploiting two national systems that observe complementary segments of the economy: Mobile Money, covering retail and informal transactions, and real-time gross settlement (RTGS), covering large-value formal payments. Within a pseudo-real-time design respecting each series’ publication lag, we augment a conventional macroeconomic panel with payment data across linear and machinelearning models. Payment data cut forecast errors by up to 16 percent and rank among the most informative predictors, with up to over three times the weight of a typical macroeconomic indicator. The improvement delivered by payment data is robust to macroeconomic disturbances, such as the COVID-19 contraction. Placebo tests attribute these gains to economic content, not added predictors. Already held by central banks, payment data offer a timely, low-cost input for surveillance where conventional statistics are weakest.

AI.tldr: 本文利用乌干达的移动支付（Mobile Money）和实时全额结算系统（RTGS）两类数字支付数据，在伪实时框架下结合传统宏观经济变量进行GDP即时预测（nowcasting）。研究发现，支付数据可将预测误差降低最多16%，且其信息权重是典型宏观指标的3倍以上，在新冠疫情等宏观经济冲击下依然稳健。该研究表明，央行已掌握的支付数据为传统统计薄弱的发展中经济体提供了及时、低成本的GDP监测工具。
AI.research_question: 发展中经济体的数字支付记录能否改善GDP即时预测（nowcasting）的准确性？具体而言，移动支付和RTGS数据在乌干达的GDP预测中相对于传统宏观指标能提供多少增量信息？
AI.motivation: 发展中经济体的产出统计数据存在发布滞后长、覆盖面窄（遗漏大量非正规部门）等问题，而数字支付系统记录了日益增长的交易份额且近乎实时可得。这为弥补传统统计缺陷、提升GDP监测时效性提供了新的数据机会。
AI.theoretical_framework: GDP即时预测（nowcasting）方法；利用高频/实时数据进行短期经济监测的分析框架；伪实时（pseudo-real-time）预测设计原则。
AI.method: 采用伪实时（pseudo-real-time）设计，尊重各序列的发布滞后；在传统宏观经济面板数据基础上加入支付数据（移动支付覆盖零售与非正规交易，RTGS覆盖大额正规支付）；运用线性和机器学习模型进行对比预测。
AI.findings: （1）支付数据可将GDP预测误差降低最多16%；（2）支付数据在所有预测变量中信息量排名靠前，其权重是典型宏观经济指标的3倍以上；（3）在COVID-19经济收缩等宏观扰动下，预测改善依然稳健；（4）安慰剂检验表明预测提升源于支付数据的经济内容，而非单纯增加预测变量数量所致。
AI.theory_contributions: 为利用新型数字支付数据改进GDP即时预测提供了实证证据；建立了伪实时框架下评估高频数据预测价值的分析方法；区分了不同支付系统（零售/非正规 vs. 大额/正规）在预测中的互补作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 向政策制定者和中央银行展示了支付数据作为经济监测工具的巨大价值——这些数据已由央行掌握、低成本且及时，可在传统统计数据最为薄弱的领域中发挥补充作用，为发展中经济体的经济政策监测提供新手段。

title: The Financial Anatomy of a Development Trap: External-liability Servicing, Commodity Dependence, and Stalled Structural Transformation in Middle-income Economies (2000-2022)
affiliations: and Universidade Estadual de Campinas (UNICAMP) - Instituto de Economia

detail.title: The Financial Anatomy of a Development Trap: External-liability Servicing, Commodity Dependence, and Stalled Structural Transformation in Middle-income Economies (2000-2022)

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare that they have no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.funderStatement: This research did not receive any specific grant from funding agencies in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: Why do many middle-income economies stall in their structural transformation, deindustrialising and reprimarising before they reach high income? Explanations usually turn on productive capabilities, the exchange rate, the commercial Dutch disease, or position in global value chains. This article adds a financial dimension that cuts across them, rooted in the most neglected part of the balance of payments-the income account. Using an annual panel of thirty-seven middle-income economies for 2000-2022, and externalliability positions measured at market value from the External Wealth of Nations database, it shows that the accumulated stock of external liabilities robustly raises the outflow of primary income (profits, dividends and interest), and that this drain anchors dependence on commodity exports. A structural typology recovers a transregional "commodity-financialised" route-most of Latin America alongside resource exporters in Eurasia, the Middle East and Africa-that carries, on average, a markedly higher income drain and commodity share and a lower manufacturing share than a manufacturing-integrated or an industrialising East Asian route. A shift-share instrument based on global financial conditions offers suggestive but not decisive evidence of a causal channel within the exposed route-the least robust of our findings, and treated as such. The commodity-financialised route remitted a net US$3.8 trillion in primary income over the period, a financial counterpart to ecologically unequal exchange, and it runs external deficits that the drain more than explains-a foreign-exchange servitude. Reindustrialisation therefore requires managing the external liability position alongside exchange-rate and industrial policy.

AI.tldr: 本文从国际收支平衡表中常被忽视的"收入账户"出发，提出一个金融维度来解释中等收入经济体在结构转型中停滞的现象。通过对37个中等收入经济体2000-2022年的面板数据分析，发现外部负债存量会显著提高初级收入（利润、股息和利息）的外流，这种"收入外流"强化了对大宗商品出口的依赖，形成"商品-金融化"的发展路径，导致去工业化和再初级化。
AI.research_question: 为什么许多中等收入经济体在达到高收入水平之前就在结构转型中停滞，出现去工业化和再初级化（重新转向初级产品生产）？
AI.motivation: 现有解释通常聚焦于生产能力、汇率、商业荷兰病或全球价值链位置，但忽略了国际收支平衡表中最被忽视的组成部分——收入账户（income account），本文旨在补充这一金融维度。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于国际收支平衡表的收入账户分析，结合外部负债存量与初级收入外流的关系，提出"商品-金融化"路径的理论框架，并与生态不平等交换理论相关联。
AI.method: 使用37个中等收入经济体2000-2022年的年度面板数据，外部负债头寸采用市场价值（来自External Wealth of Nations数据库）；构建结构性类型学；使用基于全球金融条件的shift-share工具变量进行因果推断。
AI.findings: （1）外部负债存量显著提高初级收入（利润、股息和利息）的外流；（2）这种收入外流强化了对大宗商品出口的依赖；（3）存在跨区域的"商品-金融化"路径（拉美多数国家及欧亚、中东和非洲的资源出口国），其收入外流和商品份额显著更高、制造业份额更低；（4）该路径在样本期内净汇出3.8万亿美元初级收入，形成"外汇奴役"；（5）shift-share工具变量的因果证据仅是启发性而非决定性的。
AI.theory_contributions: （1）将金融维度（收入账户）纳入中等收入陷阱和结构转型的解释框架，补充了仅关注生产能力、汇率等的传统理论；（2）提出"商品-金融化"路径的跨区域类型学，揭示了不同于东亚制造业一体化路径的另一条发展轨迹；（3）将初级收入外流与生态不平等交换理论联系起来，提供了金融层面的对应物。
AI.practical_contributions: （1）政策含义在于：再工业化不仅需要汇率政策和产业政策，还须管理外部负债头寸；（2）揭示了"外汇奴役"机制，提示发展中经济体在吸引外资时需警惕收入外流对结构转型的负面影响。

title: Pricing Heat: A Parametric Risk-Transfer Model for MSME Production Loss in Delhi-NCR

detail.title: Pricing Heat: A Parametric Risk-Transfer Model for MSME Production Loss in Delhi-NCR

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflict of interest. This research was conducted independently and has no financial or professional relationship with SIDBI, Swiss Re, ICICI Lombard, Mahila Housing Trust, the Self-Employed Women’s Association, or any other institution named in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This paper relies entirely on publicly available secondary data (India Meteorological Department records, published research literature, and public reporting) and does not involve primary data collection from human participants.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. It was conducted independently by the author.

detail.abstract: In 2026, India's parametric heat insurance pilots reached Delhi and Faridabad for the first time, extending automatic weather-triggered payouts to nearly 8,500 informal women workers in the National Capital Region. These pilots, along with the earlier Women's Climate Shock initiative operating across Rajasthan, Gujarat, and Maharashtra, compensate individual wage loss when consecutive days of extreme heat cross a defined temperature threshold. The design leaves a distinct exposure unpriced. A factory does not stop producing because one worker's wages have been protected; it stops producing when heat halts the line itself. This paper develops a parametric pricing framework for enterprise-level production loss among Delhi-NCR's micro and small manufacturers, using India Meteorological Department temperature records to model trigger frequency, and international labour-productivity elasticity estimates, tested across a sensitivity range, to approximate output loss per heat-exceedance day. A breakeven premium is derived under three candidate trigger designs and compared against the wage-loss benchmark already operating in the region. The paper does not propose a new institution. It tests whether the underwriting logic already deployed in Delhi-NCR can be extended, and at what price, to cover the enterprise rather than only the individual within it. The findings are offered as a starting point for insurers and development-finance institutions weighing how climate risk transfer might reach India's MSME sector, which employs an estimated 110 million people and remains largely uninsured against a heat exposure it already absorbs.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨将印度德里国家首都区已运行的基于参数的个人工资损失高温保险逻辑，扩展至覆盖微型和小型制造企业的生产损失。作者利用印度气象局温度数据和国际劳动生产弹性估计，建立企业级参数化定价框架，在三种触发设计下推导盈亏平衡保费，并与现有工资损失基准比较。
AI.research_question: 在德里国家首都区已运行的参数化高温保险承保逻辑能否扩展至覆盖微型和小型制造企业的生产损失？如果可以，相应的保费定价是多少？
AI.motivation: 现有参数化高温保险仅补偿个体工人的工资损失，但企业生产损失未被定价——工厂不会因单个工人工资得到保障而停止运转，只有热浪导致生产线停摆时才会停产。印度MSME部门雇佣约1.1亿人，且对已承受的高温风险基本处于未投保状态。
AI.theoretical_framework: 参数化保险定价框架；国际劳动生产率弹性估计；触发机制设计（三种候选触发方案）
AI.method: 使用印度气象局温度记录建模触发频率，采用国际劳动生产率弹性估计（在敏感性范围内测试）来近似每次高温超限日的产出损失，在三种候选触发设计下推导盈亏平衡保费，并与现有工资损失基准比较。
AI.findings: 论文为德里NCR地区微型和小型制造企业推导了企业级生产损失的参数化定价框架，提供了三种触发设计下的盈亏平衡保费，并与该地区已运行的工资损失基准进行了对比。
AI.theory_contributions: 将参数化高温保险的承保逻辑从个体工人扩展至企业层面，填补了企业级生产损失定价的理论空白。
AI.practical_contributions: 为保险公司和发展金融机构提供将气候风险转移覆盖至印度MSME部门（约1.1亿就业人口）的定价起点和可操作方案。

title: The Life Cycle of Monetary Anchors: Credibility Accumulation, Erosion, and Recasting, 1871-2007

detail.title: The Life Cycle of Monetary Anchors: Credibility Accumulation, Erosion, and Recasting, 1871-2007
detail.abstract: Why do monetary anchors live and die? This paper reframes the rules-versus-discretion debate as a question of institutional life cycles rather than institutional types. Using recomputed monthly equity returns (Shiller S&P Composite total returns, 1871–2007), I show that anchor type—mechanical versus reputation-based—does not map onto volatility level: the classical gold standard (R2, 1879–1913) and the Great Moderation (R9, 1983–2007) produced nearly identical monthly standard deviations (3.26% vs. 3.32%; difference statistically indistinguishable from zero under block bootstrap), while the interwar gold standard (R5, 1925–1933), also a mechanical anchor, produced the highest volatility in the sample (8.89%). What distinguishes regimes is instead the state of their credibility capital—a stock that is accumulated through costly commitments, eroded through support-structure decay (mechanical anchors) or moral-hazard accumulation (reputation-based anchors), and occasionally recast after collapse. Anchor type does shape the form of fragility: at nearly identical variance, the reputation-based R9 exhibits a significantly fatter tail than the mechanical R2 (excess kurtosis 2.43 vs. 0.45, block-bootstrap 95% CI for the difference [0.56, 3.45]; the 5% most extreme months account for 42.8% vs. 31.9% of total variance, CI [2.7, 19.1] points), concentrated in rescue-adjacent episodes. A data-driven structural-break analysis (Bai–Perron) detects essentially one dominant volatility episode in 137 years—October 1929 to mid-1933—and no variance break at any other institutional boundary, corroborating both the uniqueness of the interwar failure and the proposition that mechanical-anchor erosion is statistically invisible until collapse. A sixteen-country panel (JST Macrohistory Database, 1870–1939) confirms the level proposition out of sample: pegged years display 7.8 percentage points lower equity volatility (clustered t = −4.1), but the interwar interaction fully reverses the discount (+11.7 points, t = +3.4). The framework's central construct is then measured independently of equity markets: a CPI-only pilot fails and is reported as such, but two domain-correct components—gold cover ratios for the metallic era (rising from 22.8% in mid-1878 to 56% by 1912, with the 1893–96 silver-crisis dip and the 1920 squeeze visible) and survey-expectation anchoring for the reputation era (Livingston forecasts: R7 +0.17, R8 −0.86, R9 +0.23, with the 1980 de-anchoring trough at 11.9% expected inflation)—track the framework's credibility-state ordering.A pilot credibility index built solely from price-level data yields a null result, reported as such; the measurement requirements it reveals define the framework's forward agenda.
