Three transition episodes—the wartime fracture of 1914–1917, the exhaustion of Bretton Woods, and the Volcker recasting—illustrate an evolutionary dynamic in which crisis-born institutional variations are selected and retained as new anchoring routines. Market prices corroborate the distributional evidence: corporate-credit spreads (Baa–AAA) were systematically compressed under mature anchors—0.67 points under Bretton Woods and 0.90 points even in 2006–mid-2007, on the eve of collapse—while regime-level equity premia turn negative precisely when credibility is in transition. The framework yields an asymmetry proposition: mechanical anchors generate reform pressures when their constraints bind, while reputation-based anchors generate moral hazard when their flexibility is exploited—a pattern consistent with the subsequent 2008 crisis.

AI.tldr: 本文重构了"规则vs.自由裁量"的货币制度辩论，提出货币锚（monetary anchors）的存亡取决于其"可信度资本"（credibility capital）的生命周期状态，而非锚的类型本身。通过对1871-2007年美股月度收益的重新计算，作者发现机械性锚（如古典金本位）与声誉型锚（如大稳健时期）的波动率水平几乎相同，真正区分各制度的是其可信度资本是积累还是侵蚀的状态。基于Bai-Perron结构断点分析、16国面板数据和多个可信度代理指标，本文揭示机械性锚的侵蚀在崩溃前统计上不可见，而声誉型锚的脆弱性表现为肥尾风险集中在救助相关事件附近。
AI.research_question: 货币锚（monetary anchors）为什么会有生命周期的兴衰？锚的类型（机械性vs.声誉型）是否决定了其稳定性，还是另有更根本的驱动因素？
AI.motivation: 传统的"规则vs.自由裁量"辩论将货币制度视为静态类型，无法解释同一类锚（如金本位）在不同时期表现截然不同（古典金本位低波动 vs. 战间期金本位极端波动）。作者提出需要从制度生命周期视角重新审视这一问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 可信度资本（credibility capital）理论：锚的稳定性取决于其累积的可信度资本存量——通过高成本承诺累积，通过支撑结构衰败（机械性锚）或道德风险累积（声誉型锚）而侵蚀，并在崩溃后被重新塑造。
AI.method: 基于Shiller S&P综合指数重算的1871-2007年月度收益数据，使用块自助法（block bootstrap）检验方差差异；Bai-Perron结构性断点分析检测方差突变；16国面板（JST Macrohistory Database，1870-1939）进行样本外验证；构建金覆盖率（gold cover ratio）和调查预期锚定（Livingston forecasts）等可信度代理指标。
AI.findings: （1）锚类型不决定波动率水平：古典金本位（3.26%）与大稳健（3.32%）方差几乎相同，战间期金本位波动率最高（8.89%）；（2）声誉型锚R9的尾部显著更肥（超额峰度2.43 vs. 0.45），且集中于救助相关事件；（3）137年中仅检测到一个主导性波动事件（1929年10月至1933年中），制度边界处无方差断点；（4）16国面板证实钉住汇率制降低波动率7.8个百分点，但战间期交互项完全逆转该效应（+11.7）；（5）可信度代理指标（金覆盖率、调查预期）排序与理论预测一致；（6）危机催生的制度变异被选择保留，形成演化动态。
AI.theory_contributions: 将"规则vs.自由裁量"辩论从制度类型比较转向制度生命周期分析；提出可信度资本作为制度的存量状态变量；揭示机械性锚的侵蚀"在统计上不可见直至崩溃"，而声誉型锚的脆弱性以肥尾风险形态呈现；提出不对称性命题：机械性锚约束施加改革压力，声誉型锚灵活性滋生道德风险。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解2008年金融危机提供制度演化视角（声誉型锚的道德风险累积）；为货币制度设计提供预警信号（如金覆盖率、预期锚定指标的追踪）；说明单靠价格数据构建可信度指数不足以测度制度状态，需结合领域特定的代理指标。

title: Tax and the Law of Market Cycles
affiliations: Vanderbilt University - Vanderbilt Law School

detail.title: Tax and the Law of Market Cycles
detail.abstract:
The signature development in financial regulation over the past two decades has been the macroprudential turn: the recognition that healthy financial conditions sow the seeds of the next crash, and that risks tolerable in one firm become systemic when many firms take them simultaneously. This Article argues that the same logic pervades the “real” economy. In oil, shipping, mining, farming, real estate, and other capital-intensive industries, boom times encourage firms to expand production, but when many firms expand at once, prices crash, firms go under, and production contracts—eventually creating scarcity that sets off the next cycle. These market cycles harm consumers, workers, and investors. In response, the Article proposes the first comprehensive countercyclical regulatory regime for industry-specific cycles. 

Tax law should be the main tool for moderating market cycles. At present, tax makes market cycles worse: depreciation incentives are procyclical. Beyond reversing that bias, the Article proposes an excise tax on investments in new production capacity made when prices and investment exceed their long-run trends, and a subsidy for investments in new capacity made when prices and investment fall below their trends. Most of the administrative machinery this regime requires is already present in the Internal Revenue Code. The uniform capitalization rules measure capacity investments, beginning-of-construction rules distinguish investments made before and after the tax is triggered, and excise-tax and quick-refund procedures move fast enough to intervene in volatile market cycles. The Article argues that this approach is better targeted to the precise causes of market cycles than alternatives like cartels, production quotas, buffer stocks, and windfall profit taxes. Over- and undercapacity are inherent to markets, but law can stabilize the extremes.

AI.tldr: 本文论证宏观审慎逻辑同样适用于实体经济，并提出首个针对行业特定周期的反周期监管制度——通过税法工具（对高周期阶段的新增产能投资征收消费税，对低周期阶段给予补贴）来平抑市场周期，利用现有国内税收法典的管理机制实现。
AI.research_question: 如何在实体经济中实施与宏观审慎监管相对应的反周期制度，以平抑资本密集型行业的市场周期？
AI.motivation: 金融监管的宏观审慎转向表明稳健的金融状况可能埋下崩盘种子，个体可承受的风险在众多企业同时承担时可能演变为系统性风险。本文认为同样的逻辑也存在于实体经济（石油、航运、采矿、农业、房地产等资本密集型行业）中，这些行业的集体性扩张导致价格崩溃、企业倒闭和生产收缩，形成周期性波动，损害消费者、工人和投资者的利益。
AI.theoretical_framework: 宏观审慎监管理论（系统性风险与集体行动问题）；市场周期理论（繁荣-萧条循环）；税法与经济周期关系理论（税收政策顺周期性分析）；产能投资与价格趋势的均衡分析框架。
AI.method: 规范性法律分析：通过类比宏观审慎监管逻辑，提出税法改革方案；利用现行《国内税收法典》中已有的行政管理机制（统一资本化规则、开工开始规则、消费税和快速退税程序）来论证制度的可行性。
AI.findings: （1）宏观审慎逻辑适用于实体经济，集体性的产能扩张导致市场周期波动；（2）现行税法中的折旧激励具有顺周期性，加剧了市场周期；（3）提出反周期税务制度：在价格和投资超过长期趋势时对新增产能投资征收消费税，在低于趋势时提供补贴；（4）现行税法已有足够的行政机制支持该制度的实施；（5）该方法比卡特尔、生产配额、缓冲库存和暴利税等替代方案更具针对性。
AI.theory_contributions: 将宏观审慎监管的理论逻辑从金融领域延伸到"实体"经济，拓展了系统性风险理论的适用范围；提出首个针对行业特定周期的全面反周期监管框架，为法律与经济周期关系提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出一套可操作的税法改革方案，利用现有行政机制（统一资本化规则、开工开始规则、消费税和快速退税程序）实现了低实施成本；为政策制定者提供了替代卡特尔、配额等传统手段的更精确的政策工具，以稳定资本密集型行业的产能周期。

title: Spectral Risk Parity
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN and Abu Dhabi Investment Authority, Cornell University - Operations Research & Industrial Engineering

detail.title: Spectral Risk Parity

keywords: Portfolio Construction JEL classification codes: G0

detail.abstract: Utilizing concepts from random matrix theory (RMT), we propose a spectral approach to constructing risk parity portfolios. This portfolio tracks the principal component portfolio while explicitly penalizing the exposure to noise. The principal components and noisy components are identified using the Marˇcenko-Pastur distribution associated with the covariance (correlation) matrix. Such portfolios are robust to noise by construction. We provide empirical evidence to show the out-performance over the equal-risk-contribution (ERC) and minimum variance (MinVar) portfolios.

AI.tldr: 本文利用随机矩阵理论（RMT），提出一种谱方法来构建风险平价投资组合。该组合跟踪主成分组合，同时明确惩罚噪声暴露，通过Marchenko-Pastur分布识别主成分和噪声成分，从而构建对噪声稳健的投资组合，并实证证明其优于等风险贡献（ERC）和最小方差（MinVar）组合。
AI.research_question: 如何利用随机矩阵理论构建对噪声稳健的风险平价投资组合，并使其表现优于传统的风险平价（ERC）和最小方差（MinVar）组合？
AI.motivation: 传统的风险平价组合（如ERC）和最小方差组合对协方差矩阵中的噪声估计较为敏感，噪声可能导致组合权重扭曲和表现不佳。随机矩阵理论能够有效区分协方差矩阵中的信号与噪声成分，因此可用于构建更稳健的投资组合。
AI.theoretical_framework: 随机矩阵理论（RMT），Marchenko-Pastur分布，主成分分析（PCA），风险平价框架
AI.method: 基于随机矩阵理论构建谱方法：利用Marchenko-Pastur分布识别协方差（相关）矩阵中的主成分与噪声成分，构建跟踪主成分组合的同时明确惩罚噪声暴露的风险平价投资组合，并进行实证比较分析。
AI.findings: 实证结果表明，该谱方法构建的风险平价组合在样本外表现优于等风险贡献（ERC）和最小方差（MinVar）组合。
AI.theory_contributions: 将随机矩阵理论引入风险平价组合的构建中，提出了一个将谱方法与风险平价原则相结合的新框架，为处理协方差矩阵中的噪声问题提供了理论依据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为资产配置实践提供了一种对噪声稳健的风险平价组合构建方法，实证证明其优于传统ERC和MinVar组合，具有实际投资应用价值。

title: Towards a Digital Twin for Healthier Indoor Environments Using Cellular Discrete Event Specification and Genetic Algorithms
affiliations: Carleton University and Carleton University

detail.title: Towards a Digital Twin for Healthier Indoor Environments Using Cellular Discrete Event Specification and Genetic Algorithms
detail.abstract: Experts use modeling and simulation to aid decision making to improve air quality, particularly during airborne virus outbreaks, when carbon dioxide levels can indicate infection risk. This manuscript provides a novel Digital Twin framework that uses physical space properties and Internet of Things data to create carbon dioxide dispersion models of closed spaces. The framework combines simulation models with genetic algorithms to identify optimal indoor settings for healthier environments. First, the framework creates a conceptual model representing the physical space and its key properties. Next, we develop a Cellular Discrete Event Simulation model that includes space dimensions, carbon dioxide sinks and sources, impermeable structures, breathing occupants’ data, and carbon dioxide dispersion logic. We then simulate the model and validate it against real data. We integrate genetic algorithms with our simulation engine to iteratively refine the validated simulation model and converge towards a simulation scenario representing optimal indoor settings for healthier air. The resulting model can be used to modify the real physical space to enhance air quality. Our framework and the use of genetic algorithms for indoor air quality optimization are novel contributions to the field. We use two case studies to demonstrate the framework's effectiveness, showing how the framework recommendations can be applied to physical spaces while avoiding costly and unattainable experimentation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新颖的数字孪生框架，利用物理空间属性和物联网数据创建封闭空间的二氧化碳扩散模型。该框架将仿真模型与遗传算法相结合，以确定更健康室内环境的最佳设置，并通过两个案例研究验证了其有效性。
AI.research_question: 如何利用数字孪生框架结合物理空间属性和物联网数据，构建二氧化碳扩散模型并优化室内空气质量设置？
AI.motivation: 在空气传播病毒爆发期间，二氧化碳水平可指示感染风险，专家需要借助建模与仿真来辅助决策以改善空气质量。然而，直接在真实空间中进行实验往往成本高昂且难以实现，因此需要一种可在虚拟环境中优化室内设置的方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 数字孪生（Digital Twin）框架、元胞离散事件仿真（Cellular Discrete Event Simulation）模型、遗传算法（Genetic Algorithms）优化理论。
AI.method: 首先构建代表物理空间及其关键属性的概念模型；然后开发包含空间维度、二氧化碳源与汇、不可渗透结构、人员呼吸数据及二氧化碳扩散逻辑的元胞离散事件仿真模型；接着将模型与真实数据进行验证；最后将遗传算法与仿真引擎集成，迭代细化仿真模型以收敛至最优室内设置方案。
AI.findings: 通过两个案例研究证明了框架的有效性，框架建议可应用于物理空间，同时避免了昂贵且难以实现的实验。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一种将数字孪生框架与遗传算法相结合用于室内空气质量优化的新颖方法，为数字孪生在环境健康领域的应用提供了新的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了一种可操作的框架，能够在避免高昂实验成本的前提下，通过仿真优化指导物理空间的改造，从而提升室内空气质量，尤其在病毒爆发期间降低感染风险。

title: Digital Work, Earnings Premiums, and the Gender Gap: Evidence from Pakistan's Labour Force Survey 2024-25
affiliations: and Lahore University of Management Sciences (LUMS)

detail.title: Digital Work, Earnings Premiums, and the Gender Gap: Evidence from Pakistan's Labour Force Survey 2024-25
detail.abstract: Digital labor platforms and online work are rapidly growing in Pakistan, yet rigorous empirical evidence on the effect of this growth on Wages is very scarce. This paper uses the Labor Force Survey 2024-2025 based in Pakistan, transitioned to the global 19th ICLS standards by the Pakistan Bureau of Statistics, to examine three related questions: whether digital work generates a wage premium over traditional employment, whether this premium differs by gender, and the characteristics of individuals to predict entry into digital work. Using Mincer's equation, OLS regression on a restricted sample of 24406 workers, this research estimates a premium for digital work while controlling for age, gender, education, and job characteristics. The findings reveal that the conditional earnings premium is a 6.97%. Heterogeneity analysis across gender shows that digital work does not bridge the gender wage gap, as women face 22.5% earning penalty in both digital and physical work. Platform analysis also shows differences in premiums for different kinds of jobs. The probit model shows that people with higher education, especially those with higher computer qualifications and living in urban areas, have a significant increase in probability of entering and participating in the digital labor market. The results confirm that online/digital work provides a 7% earning premium but fails to reduce the gender wage gap, with returns varying across different platforms.

AI.tldr: 本文利用巴基斯坦2024-2025年劳动力调查数据（采用第19届ICLS国际标准），基于Mincer方程和OLS回归分析24406名工人样本，发现数字化工作相比传统就业存在6.97%的工资溢价，但未能缩小性别工资差距（女性在数字化和传统工作中均面临22.5%的收入惩罚），且不同平台工资回报存在差异。Probit模型进一步表明，高教育程度、拥有计算机资质及居住在城市的人群进入数字劳动力市场的概率显著更高。
AI.research_question: 本文探讨三个相关问题：（1）数字化工作是否比传统就业带来工资溢价？（2）这一溢价是否存在性别差异？（3）哪些个体特征能够预测进入数字化工作的概率？
AI.motivation: 巴基斯坦的数字劳动力平台和在线工作正在快速增长，但关于这一增长对工资影响的严格实证证据非常匮乏，亟需填补该领域的研究空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 本文基于Mincer人力资本工资方程作为理论基础，将工资视为教育、经验等人力资本特征的函数，并结合性别差异和平台异质性进行分析。
AI.method: 使用巴基斯坦统计局2024-2025年劳动力调查数据（按全球第19届ICLS标准转换），对24406名工人的限制样本进行OLS回归估计数字工作的工资溢价（控制年龄、性别、教育和职业特征），运用Probit模型预测个体进入数字工作的概率，并进行跨性别和跨平台的异质性分析。
AI.findings: （1）数字化工作的条件收入溢价为6.97%；（2）数字化工作未能弥合性别工资差距，女性在数字化和传统工作中均面临22.5%的收入惩罚；（3）不同平台类型的工资溢价存在差异；（4）教育程度更高、拥有计算机资质以及居住在城市的人群进入数字劳动力市场的概率显著更高。
AI.theory_contributions: 本文为数字劳动平台与工资关系的实证文献提供了来自发展中经济体（巴基斯坦）的证据，扩展了Mincer方程在数字工作情境下的应用，并揭示了数字工作在性别工资不平等方面未能发挥预期改善作用的重要理论发现。
AI.practical_contributions: 研究结果为政策制定者提供了重要参考：数字工作虽能带来工资溢价，但政策干预仍需针对性别工资差距问题专门设计；同时，提升教育水平和数字技能培训、改善城市基础设施有助于促进个体参与数字劳动力市场。

title: Value Coverage: A Measurement Framework for Technology Investment Booms, with a Live Application to the AI Capital Build-out

detail.title: Value Coverage: A Measurement Framework for Technology Investment Booms, with a Live Application to the AI Capital Build-out

declarations.declarationOfInterest: This is an independent research purely.
declarations.funderStatement: Personal research - only personal funding

detail.abstract: Is the AI technology boom a bubble? The question is being argued almost entirely by anecdote, one side pointing to the technology potential and the other to the spending. This paper offers a way to keep appropriate accounts rather than a direct answer to the question. It proposes that any technology investment boom can be described by three quantities, each measurable from public data. The first is private coverage (Cp): the earnings the capital throws off, set against the annual cost of owning it. The second is social coverage (Cs): the value the technology creates for the wider economy, net of its harms, against the same cost. The third is financing fragility (F ): how much of the build is paid for with outside money, and where in the structure that borrowing sits. The paper defines the three, sets out two hypotheses, one for the probability of a correction and one for its cost, in a form that can be estimated, places past booms on a simple map, and reports a live, open implementation for the AI build-out. On data to mid-2026 the headline (capital-holder) readings are Cp ≈ 0.31, Cs ≈ 0.68 at a ten-year horizon and ≈ 1.13 at thirty, and F ≈ 0.72, in the speculative range; a second, ecosystem-wide coverage line reads ≈ 0.54, a wedge of ≈ 0.23 above the capital-holders. What is offered is a measurement programme with a working instrument, and a not-yet-tested theory of bubbles. Two steps would make the central claim testable: an expectations benchmark that says what coverage the market is pricing in, and a historical backtest against the price-based crash predictor of Greenwood, Shleifer and You. Both are specified. The paper is equally clear about what such measurement cannot do. It can deliver consistency rather than accuracy, and a characterized boom rather than a prophecy.

AI.tldr: 本文不直接回答"AI技术繁荣是否为泡沫"的争议，而是提出一个可测量的分析框架，用三个可公开数据计算的量——私人覆盖率(Cp)、社会覆盖率(Cs)和融资脆弱性(F)——来描述任何技术投资繁荣。论文定义了这三个量，提出两个可估计的假设（关于修正的概率和成本），将过去的繁荣事件放在一张简单地图上，并报告了对AI建设的实时开放实现。截至2026年中，数据读数显示Cp≈0.31，Cs在十年期为0.68、三十年期为1.13，F≈0.72处于投机区间。
AI.research_question: AI技术繁荣是否构成泡沫？更具体地说，如何用可测量、可检验的方式描述和评估技术投资繁荣的程度与风险？
AI.motivation: 关于AI泡沫的争论几乎完全依赖轶事证据：一方强调技术潜力，另一方强调支出规模。缺乏一种系统化、基于公开数据的量化方法来评估技术投资繁荣的状态和风险。
AI.theoretical_framework: 该论文提出一个三量框架：(1) 私人覆盖率(Cp)——资本产生的收益相对于年度拥有成本之比；(2) 社会覆盖率(Cs)——技术为更广泛经济创造的价值（扣除危害后）相对于同一成本之比；(3) 融资脆弱性(F)——外部资金在建设中占比及其在结构中的位置。此外借鉴Greenwood、Shleifer和You基于价格崩溃预测器的思想进行历史回测。
AI.method: 提出可测量的三量框架（Cp、Cs、F），每个量均可从公开数据计算；设定两个可估计的假设（分别关于修正的概率和成本）；将过去的技术繁荣置于一个简单地图上进行比较；并报告一个针对AI建设的实时、开放的实证实现，同时给出预期基准和历史回测两项检验设计。
AI.findings: 截至2026年中数据：Cp≈0.31；Cs在十年期为0.68、三十年期为1.13；F≈0.72（处于投机区间）；生态系统范围的覆盖率读数约为0.54，比资本持有者视角高出约0.23的楔形差距。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出一个尚未经验证但可检验的泡沫理论框架，将泡沫描述为三个可测量量（Cp、Cs、F）的函数；给出两个在形式上可估计的假设（修正概率与修正成本）；并明确了使其核心主张可检验的两个步骤（预期基准与历史回测）。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供一个可操作的测量工具和公开实现，使政策制定者、投资者和研究者可以用一致而非准确的方式刻画技术繁荣的状态；明确说明该测量能做到什么（一致性、特征刻画）和不能做到什么（预测准确性）。

title: When do Macroeconomic Policies Work? Global Value Chains and Industrial Performance in Low-and Middle-income Countries
affiliations: and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: When do Macroeconomic Policies Work? Global Value Chains and Industrial Performance in Low-and Middle-income Countries

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare that they have no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.funderStatement: This research did not receive any specific grant from funding agencies in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: Does the effectiveness of macroeconomic policy for industrial performance depend on a country's structural position in global value chains (GVCs)? We propose a conditional macro-structural framework in which macroeconomic policy and value-chain position jointly determine industrial performance, and test it for low-and middle-income countries. Using a balanced panel of 23 such countries over 2005-2020, with GVC positioning measured from the OECD TiVA database and structural sophistication from product-complexity data, we adopt a two-level design. At the broad level, the manufacturing share of GDP is robustly depressed by commodity-export concentration and manufacturing import penetration, and supported by trade openness, backward GVC participation and export sophistication. At the conditional level, the industrial effectiveness of two macroeconomic levers depends on value-chain position: the exchange rate's effect declines with commodity dependence (sharply in Latin America), and investment's effect declines with domestic-value-added intensity. The commodity result holds across three measures of industrial performance-the manufacturing share, value-added growth and industrial employment. A mediation analysis shows the exchange-rate channel is contingent because, in commoditydependent economies the currency is an endogenous outcome of commodity cycles (Dutch disease). Pooled Mean Group and error-correction estimates put the speed of adjustment toward long-run equilibrium at 15-21% per year. Value-chain position thus determines industrial performance directly and governs macroeconomic-policy effectiveness conditionally. The framework connects the macroeconomics of industrial development to the structural political economy of production.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个条件性宏观-结构框架，认为宏观经济政策的效果取决于一国在全球价值链（GVC）中的结构性位置。通过对23个中低收入国家2005-2020年的平衡面板数据分析发现：制成品进口渗透和商品出口集中会抑制制造业占比，而贸易开放、后向GVC参与和出口复杂度则起支持作用。汇率政策的效果随商品依赖度升高而减弱（拉美地区尤为显著），投资政策的效果随国内增加值强度升高而减弱。中介分析表明汇率渠道的失效源于商品周期导致的荷兰病效应，系统调整速度约为每年15-21%。
AI.research_question: 宏观经济政策对工业绩效的有效性是否取决于一国在全球价值链中的结构性位置？
AI.motivation: 现有文献大多分别研究宏观经济政策或GVC位置对工业绩效的影响，缺乏将两者整合的框架。作者试图弥合宏观经济学与结构性政治经济学之间的鸿沟，解释为何同样的政策在不同结构位置的国家中效果迥异。
AI.theoretical_framework: 条件性宏观-结构框架（conditional macro-structural framework），结合全球价值链理论、结构性政治经济学与开放宏观经济学的荷兰病理论。
AI.method: 采用两级研究设计：广义层面用面板回归考察GVC位置与贸易结构对制造业份额的影响；条件层面用交互项检验宏观经济杠杆与价值链位置的交互效应。数据来自OECD TiVA数据库和产品复杂度数据（23国2005-2020平衡面板），并使用Pooled Mean Group（PMG）和误差修正模型估计，辅以中介分析。
AI.findings: （1）商品出口集中和制造业进口渗透显著抑制制造业占GDP比重；（2）贸易开放、后向GVC参与和出口复杂度支持工业绩效；（3）汇率对工业的效应随商品依赖度上升而递减（拉美尤为突出）；（4）投资效应随国内增加值强度上升而递减；（5）汇率渠道的失效源于商品依赖经济中汇率内生于商品周期（荷兰病）；（6）长期均衡调整速度为每年15-21%。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将macroeconomics of industrial development与structural political economy of production系统连接，提出条件性宏观-结构框架，阐明价值链位置不仅直接影响工业绩效，还调节宏观经济政策的传导效果，为理解政策异质性提供新理论路径。
AI.practical_contributions: 为发展中经济体（尤其是商品依赖型国家）的产业政策与宏观经济政策搭配提供实证依据，提示政策制定者需根据本国GVC位置和商品依赖程度调整汇率与投资政策工具，避免"一刀切"的政策建议。

title: The Informational Value of Media Economic Concerns for Nowcasting China's CPI Inflation
affiliations: Ghent University, Vrije Universiteit Brussel (VUB) - Applied Economics Department and Southwestern University of Finance and Economics (SWUFE)

detail.title: The Informational Value of Media Economic Concerns for Nowcasting China's CPI Inflation

declarations.funderStatement: This work was supported by the China Scholarship Council (#202007650028).

detail.abstract: The Consumer Price Index (CPI) inflation in China serves as a critical monthly macroeconomic indicator for economic decision makers and policymakers. This paper develops two novel weekly economic concern indices-one derived from news articles of five major newspapers and another from government social media disclosures on 32 official Sina Weibo accounts. Using a mixed-frequency data sampling (MIDAS) regression model, we generate weekly nowcasts of CPI inflation and evaluate the predictive performance of these economic concern indices over the period from January 2013 to March 2024. Our results demonstrate significant improvements in nowcasting accuracy compared to a benchmark AR(1) model. The news-based index consistently outperforms the government social media disclosure-based index across both rolling and expanding window out-of-sample evaluations. Furthermore, incorporating both indices simultaneously reveals informational complementarity, leading to further accuracy gains. Allowing for optimized weighting of individual news outlets and government Weibo accounts via a differential evolution algorithm yields additional improvement in predictive performance, with the data-driven weighted concern indices achieving the lowest out-of-sample root mean squared errors.

AI.tldr: 本文利用五大报纸的新闻文章和32个官方新浪微博账号的政府社交媒体披露，构建了两个周度经济关注指数，并采用混频数据抽样（MIDAS）回归模型对中国CPI通胀进行周度即时预测（nowcasting）。实证结果表明，相比AR(1)基准模型，两个指数均显著提升了预测精度，其中新闻指数优于政府社交媒体指数，且两者存在信息互补性。进一步通过差分进化算法优化各新闻媒体和政府微博账号的权重，实现了更高的预测性能。
AI.research_question: 如何利用新闻文章和政府社交媒体披露构建的经济关注指数来提升中国CPI通胀的周度即时预测精度？
AI.motivation: CPI通胀是重要的月度宏观经济指标，但决策者需要更及时的高频信息。传统模型难以捕捉即时经济关注变化，而新闻和社交媒体数据提供了潜在的实时信息来源。本研究旨在探索这些非传统数据源在通胀即时预测中的价值。
AI.theoretical_framework: 经济关注（Economic Concern）理论、信息经济学、混频数据采样（MIDAS）回归模型、差分进化算法优化理论
AI.method: 从五大报纸新闻文章和32个官方新浪微博账号构建两个周度经济关注指数；采用MIDAS回归模型进行周度CPI通胀即时预测；使用滚动窗口和扩展窗口进行样本外评估；通过差分进化算法优化各信息来源的权重。
AI.findings: 1）两个经济关注指数均显著提升CPI通胀即时预测精度，优于AR(1)基准模型；2）新闻指数始终优于政府社交媒体指数；3）两个指数的联合使用存在信息互补性，进一步提升精度；4）差分进化算法优化权重后，预测性能达到最优，获得最低的样本外均方根误差。
AI.theory_contributions: 拓展了经济关注指数在通胀预测中的理论应用，证明了新闻与政府社交媒体在信息内容上的互补性，验证了数据驱动权重优化方法的有效性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为经济决策者和政策制定者提供了更及时（周度）且更准确的中国CPI通胀预测工具；展示了如何有效利用新闻和社交媒体数据优化宏观预测，具有重要的政策应用价值。

title: Macroeconomic Tail Risk and Financial Statement Information: Evidence from Aggregate Earnings
affiliations: Department of Economics, National Taiwan University , National Taiwan Normal University, Department of Civic Education and Leadership and University of Liverpool Management School

detail.title: Macroeconomic Tail Risk and Financial Statement Information: Evidence from Aggregate Earnings

declarations.declarationOfInterest: None
declarations.funderStatement: National Science and Technology Council, R.O.C., Taiwan. NSTC 115-2410-H-003 -175 -MY3

detail.abstract: This study investigates how aggregate earnings shocks affect U.S. macroeconomic tail risk. We identify two asymmetric effects. First, earnings shocks disproportionately impact the lower tail of the predicted output growth distribution compared to its median or upper tail. Second, this lower-tail asymmetry intensifies when categorized by sign: negative shocks provoke systematically larger responses than positive ones. This sign asymmetry aligns with accounting conservatism, where adverse economic conditions are reported more promptly. Counterfactual analyses suggest financial conditions primarily drive these responses. Overall, our findings underscore aggregate earnings as an economically significant, underexplored source of macroeconomic tail risk.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨美国总盈余冲击对宏观经济尾部风险的影响，发现两种不对称效应：盈余冲击对产出增长分布下尾的影响大于中位数或上尾；且负向冲击引发的反应系统性大于正向冲击，这种符号不对称性与会计稳健性一致。反事实分析表明金融条件是主要驱动因素。
AI.research_question: 总盈余冲击如何影响美国宏观经济尾部风险？具体地，盈余冲击对产出增长分布不同分位数的影响是否不对称，以及正负冲击的影响是否不对称？
AI.motivation: 宏观经济尾部风险对政策制定和风险管理至关重要，但现有研究多关注金融变量或新闻情绪等来源，较少系统考察总盈余（aggregate earnings）这一会计信息聚合体作为宏观经济尾部风险的潜在驱动因素。本文旨在填补这一空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 会计稳健性理论（accounting conservatism）——即不利经济条件会被更及时地确认和报告，从而导致盈余对负向经济冲击的反应更迅速、更强烈，进而形成尾部风险的不对称性。
AI.method: 采用分位数回归或分位数脉冲响应等计量方法，估计盈余冲击对预测产出增长分布各分位数（下尾、中位数、上尾）的影响；通过反事实分析（counterfactual analysis）考察金融条件在传导机制中的作用。
AI.findings: （1）盈余冲击对产出增长下尾的影响大于中位数或上尾，呈下尾不对称性；（2）负向盈余冲击的系统性影响大于正向冲击，呈符号不对称性；（3）金融条件是上述不对称效应的主要驱动渠道。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将总盈余确立为宏观经济尾部风险的重要来源，扩展了宏观经济尾部风险的前因研究；将会计稳健性理论引入宏观金融领域，为盈余不对称的信息含量提供了宏观层面的理论证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和风险管理者提供了新的预警指标——总盈余可作为宏观经济下尾风险的早期信号；有助于识别金融条件在盈余-宏观经济风险传导中的关键作用，为宏观审慎监管提供参考。

title: Too Small to See: A Real Individual-Level GLP-1 Effect on Protein Demand Is Undetectable in Aggregate Protein-Supplement Sales and Search Data

detail.title: Too Small to See: A Real Individual-Level GLP-1 Effect on Protein Demand Is Undetectable in Aggregate Protein-Supplement Sales and Search Data

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence this work.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study used only secondary, aggregate, and publicly available data and did not involve human-subjects research, so no ethics approval was required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: A clinical and marketing literature documents that individual users of GLP-1 receptor agonists shift consumption toward protein, and industry commentary anticipates a GLP-1-driven surge in protein-supplement demand. We ask whether this individual effect is visible in aggregate retail data. Using Euromonitor sports-protein-powder volumes for seven countries (2011-2025) and a U.S. state-by-quarter panel of Medicaid GLP-1 prescriptions and protein-powder search intent, we find no detectable macro signal, and we quantify why. A dilution accounting shows that under revealed-behavior per-user estimates the GLP-1-attributable share of observed 2018-2024 U.S. category growth is around 1% in absolute value, and even the most generous stated-willingness-to-pay ceiling caps it at about 8.5% (roughly half that at the low end of that range). The conclusion is robust to broadening the outcome from sports protein powder to the full protein-supplement category. The state panel is a precise, high-resolution null, though its outcome is population search intent rather than sales. The cross-country comparison maps the resolution limit of aggregate data, which proves too coarse to bound the micro-implied effect. The results are a quantified instance of micro-to-macro disconnect: a real individual effect, scaled by a small treated share, stays below aggregate visibility.

AI.tldr: 本文研究GLP-1受体激动剂（减肥药）使用者对蛋白质补充剂需求的个人效应是否能在宏观零售数据中显现。结果显示，尽管临床和营销文献表明个体用户消费转向蛋白质，但在七国宏观零售数据和美国州级面板数据中均未检测到明显信号，并量化了原因：由于用药人群占比小，即使在最慷慨的假设下，GLP-1对品类增长的贡献也仅约1%-8.5%，远低于宏观数据的可检测阈值。
AI.research_question: GLP-1受体激动剂使用者的个人消费效应（蛋白质消费增加）能否在聚合零售数据中观察到？
AI.motivation: 临床和营销文献已证实GLP-1使用者个体层面转向蛋白质消费，行业评论也预期GLP-1将推动蛋白质补充剂需求激增，但尚不清楚这一微观效应能否转化为可观测的宏观市场信号。
AI.theoretical_framework: 微观-宏观脱节（micro-to-macro disconnect）框架——个体真实效应乘以受治疗人群比例后可能低于聚合数据的可见性阈值。
AI.method: 1) 使用Euromonitor七个国家（2011-2025）的运动蛋白粉销量数据；2) 美国州-季度面板数据：Medicaid GLP-1处方量与蛋白粉搜索意图；3) 稀释核算（dilution accounting）方法量化GLP-1对品类增长的归因份额。
AI.findings: 1) 宏观零售数据中未检测到GLP-1驱动的蛋白质补充剂需求信号；2) 基于揭示行为的每用户估计，GLP-1对2018-2024美国品类增长的归因份额绝对值约为1%；3) 即使采用最慷慨的支付意愿上限，该份额也仅约8.5%（低端约一半）；4) 将结果扩展到完整蛋白质补充剂品类时结论稳健；5) 州级面板是高精度零结果，但结局变量是搜索意图而非实际销售；6) 跨国比较显示聚合数据分辨率不足以界定微观隐含效应。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了微观-宏观脱节的量化实例：说明个体真实效应乘以小的受治疗份额后会低于聚合数据的可见性阈值，为理解微观效应转化为宏观信号的边界条件提供了实证证据和方法论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为行业预测提供校准依据：提示供应链、投资决策不应过度押注GLP-1驱动的蛋白质补充剂需求激增；同时为政策制定者和市场分析师提供评估药物大规模使用对市场影响的量化方法论。

title: The Evolution of Retail Investors: From Speculation to Fundamentals
affiliations: Queen Mary University of London

detail.title: The Evolution of Retail Investors: From Speculation to Fundamentals
detail.abstract: Using millions of Reddit stock discussions, I characterize retail investors by the types of firms they discuss. Principal component analysis reveals a dominant axis separating users drawn to volatile, lottery-like stocks from those focused on fundamentals. Investors move along this axis: discussion shifts toward fundamentals with experience, and back toward speculation after viral posts displaying large gains; losses produce no comparable response. These episodes reach the market: the day after a viral gain, retail's share of trading rises in speculative stocks and those stocks become less stable; the composition of the crowd and the stability of prices move together.

AI.tldr: 本文利用数百万条Reddit股票讨论数据，通过主成分分析刻画散户投资者类型。研究发现投资者在"投机型"与"基本面型"之间存在一个主导分化轴：随着经验的积累，讨论向基本面倾斜；但看到病毒式传播的大额收益帖子后，讨论又回归投机，而亏损则无此效果。这些事件影响市场——病毒式收益帖子发布次日，散户在投机股中的交易份额上升，这些股票稳定性下降，散户群体构成与股价稳定性同步变动。
AI.research_question: 散户投资者如何根据其讨论的股票类型进行分类？投资者的投机偏好如何随时间变化，以及这些变化是否影响市场结果？
AI.motivation: 散户投资者并非同质群体，其投资偏好（投机vs基本面）可能随经验和市场事件而变化，但这种动态变化及其对市场稳定的影响尚缺乏大规模实证证据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 主成分分析（PCA）用于识别散户投资者的偏好分化维度；行为金融理论中关于投机偏好、经验效应和社会传染（病毒式传播）的相关观点。
AI.method: 基于数百万条Reddit股票讨论数据，利用主成分分析提取投资者偏好维度，并对投资者的时间动态（经验效应、病毒式收益帖子的冲击效应）及市场影响进行实证分析。
AI.findings: (1) PCA揭示一个主导轴，区分偏好波动性彩票型股票的投资者与关注基本面的投资者；(2) 投资者随经验积累从投机转向基本面；(3) 病毒式传播的大额收益帖子使讨论回归投机，而亏损无此效应；(4) 病毒式收益帖发布次日，投机股中散户交易份额上升且股价稳定性下降；(5) 散户群体构成与价格稳定性同步变动。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次从大规模文本数据中刻画散户投资者的偏好维度结构，揭示投资者投机偏好的动态演变机制（经验驱动的学习效应与病毒式收益引发的传染效应之间的不对称性），并将散户群体构成变化与市场稳定性联系起来。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管者理解社交媒体驱动的散户投机行为及其对市场稳定的影响提供实证依据；为投资者教育提供关于经验如何改善投资偏好的证据；有助于理解网络社区中信息传染对市场波动的传导路径。

title: Exploring The Cycling-related Policies and Socioeconomic Disparities: A Comparative Study of Bradford, Manchester and Bristol, United Kingdom
affiliations: Imperial College London, Imperial College London - Department of Civil and Environmental Engineering and Imperial College London - Department of Civil and Environmental Engineering

detail.title: Exploring The Cycling-related Policies and Socioeconomic Disparities: A Comparative Study of Bradford, Manchester and Bristol, United Kingdom

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors report there are no competing interests to declare.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Ethics approval was obtained as per the requirements of the Imperial College’s Science, Engineering and Technology Research Ethics Committee (Imperial College, 2023). Participants were provided with an information sheet detailing the survey and data handling procedures, and consent was obtained before the survey commenced.
declarations.funderStatement: This work was supported by the Pathways to Equitable Healthy Cities grant from the Wellcome Trust [209376/Z/17/Z].

detail.abstract: Over the last two decades, there has been a rise in cycling-related policies and investments in the UK, yet national cycling levels are somewhat stagnant. Furthermore, existing evidence suggests that the interventions do not benefit everyone equally; whether a person cycles or not is influenced by their gender, age, income and ethnicity amongst other factors. Policy documents from Bradford, Manchester and Bristol, as well as a survey of 330 participants are analysed to explore the differences in cycling levels of the three cities and within the socioeconomic groups. This is done by reducing the dimensions of the data through factor analysis and then creating a binary logistic regression model. Perceived quality of cycling infrastructure, gender, age, and household income have a considerable impact on a person's decision to cycle, whilst the effect of ethnicity is ambiguous. There is significant unmet demand for cycling, especially from underrepresented groups who are often deterred by the inadequate cycling conditions. Childhood cycling should be highly encouraged since the habit is likely to continue into adulthood, and non-cyclists aged 55 or over are more reluctant to undertake cycling. It is expected that provision of safe, accessible, and segregated cycling infrastructure combined with short-term campaigning and support will not only increase cycling levels, but also ease the inequalities in cycling.

AI.tldr: 本文通过分析布拉德福德、曼彻斯特和布里斯托三个英国城市的政策文件及330名参与者的调查数据，运用因子分析和二元逻辑回归模型，探讨了不同城市及社会群体间骑行水平的差异。研究发现感知骑行基础设施质量、性别、年龄和家庭收入对骑行决策有显著影响，而种族的影响不明确。文章指出存在大量未被满足的骑行需求，尤其是弱势群体往往因骑行条件不佳而被劝退，并建议提供安全、可达、隔离的骑行基础设施，配合短期宣传支持，以提升骑行水平并缓解骑行不平等。
AI.research_question: 英国不同城市及不同社会经济群体之间的骑行水平存在哪些差异？哪些因素影响个人骑行决策？
AI.motivation: 过去二十年间英国虽出台了多项骑行政策和投资，但全国骑行水平基本停滞不前，且现有证据表明干预措施并未惠及所有人，骑行行为受性别、年龄、收入、种族等因素影响，亟需探究这些不平等现象的成因。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于骑行行为的社会人口学影响因素理论，结合基础设施感知质量与骑行决策的关系框架，以及骑行习惯延续性（童年骑行延续至成年）的理论视角。
AI.method: 采用混合方法：①分析布拉德福德、曼彻斯特和布里斯托三城市的政策文件；②对330名参与者进行问卷调查；③通过因子分析降低数据维度；④构建二元逻辑回归模型分析骑行决策的影响因素。
AI.findings: ①感知骑行基础设施质量、性别、年龄和家庭收入对骑行决策有显著影响；②种族的影响不明确；③存在大量未被满足的骑行需求，弱势群体常因骑行条件不佳而被劝退；④童年骑行习惯很可能延续至成年；⑤55岁及以上的非骑行人群更不愿开始骑行。
AI.theory_contributions: 本文丰富了骑行行为不平等领域的实证研究，揭示了基础设施感知质量与人口统计学因素在骑行决策中的相对重要性，并明确了种族因素影响的模糊性，为骑行习惯延续性理论提供了实证支持。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供针对性建议：提供安全、可达、隔离的骑行基础设施，配合短期宣传和骑行支持措施，既能提升整体骑行水平，也有助于缓解不同社会经济群体间的骑行不平等现象。同时建议大力鼓励儿童骑行，并对55岁以上非骑行人群给予特别关注。

title: Refugee Absorption and Electoral Change: Evifence from the Indian Partition
affiliations: and University of Luxembourg

detail.title: Refugee Absorption and Electoral Change: Evifence from the Indian Partition
detail.abstract: The 1947 Partition of British India triggered the largest forced migration of the twentieth century, redistributing millions of refugees across newly independent India. We study whether this demographic shock left a lasting imprint on democratic politics. Combining district-level refugee shares from the 1951 Census with constituency-level electoral data covering Indian state assembly elections between 1960 and 2007, we estimate the long-run effects of refugee settlement on electoral competition. We find that constituencies exposed to larger refugee inflows exhibit higher voter turnout, narrower victory margins, and a lower likelihood of electing candidates from national parties. Instead, refugee settlement shifted electoral support toward regional parties and contributed to the long-run denationalization of political competition. Our findings show that large demographic shocks can leave enduring political legacies, reshaping patterns of political representation and party competition long after displacement itself has ended.

AI.tldr: 本文研究1947年印巴分治引发的难民迁移如何影响印度长期民主政治。通过1951年人口普查的难民数据与1960-2007年邦议会选举数据，发现难民流入较多的选区表现出更高的投票率、更窄的获胜差距、更低的国大党等全国性政党当选概率，选举支持转向地区性政党，导致政治竞争的"去全国化"长期趋势。
AI.research_question: 1947年印巴分治引发的大规模难民迁移，是否在长期（1960-2007年）对印度民主政治（尤其是选举竞争格局）留下持久影响？
AI.motivation: 1947年印巴分治是二十世纪最大规模的强迫迁移事件之一，但现有研究较少关注这一人口冲击对接收国长期政治格局的影响。理解大规模人口迁移如何重塑政治竞争和政党体系，对移民政治学和历史政治经济学具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 人口冲击与政治遗产理论；选举竞争理论；政党体系去全国化理论
AI.method: 结合1951年人口普查的区级难民份额数据与选区级选举数据（印度邦议会选举，1960-2007），进行长期效应的计量估计。
AI.findings: 难民流入较多的选区呈现更高的投票率、更窄的获胜差距（更激烈的选举竞争）、更低的全国性政党候选人当选概率；难民定居将选举支持转向地区性政党，推动了政治竞争的长期"去全国化"。
AI.theory_contributions: 证明了大规模人口冲击可以留下持久的政治遗产，拓展了人口迁移与政治制度变迁关系的理论；提出"难民定居导致政治竞争去全国化"这一新的理论机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解难民安置对接收国政治格局的长期影响提供实证证据，对移民政策、难民安置政策及区域政治治理具有政策参考价值。

title: National Visions and Domestic Investment: Coordination without Transformation
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: National Visions and Domestic Investment: Coordination without Transformation
detail.abstract: National visions-formal long-term strategic plans adopted at head-of-state level-have become nearuniversal across the developing world, yet no crosscountry evidence exists on their macroeconomic effects. Using a difference-indifferences design on 22 non-oil vision-adoption episodes across six world regions (1970-2020), I find that adoption is associated with an increase in gross fixed capital formation of 3.1 percentage points of GDP (p = 0.003), positive in 17 of 22 episodes. The effect builds over two to three years and persists for at least five. Temporal and outcome placebo tests, a Fisher permutation test (p < 0.001), oil-country falsification, and pre-treatment balance checks support a causal interpretation. Critically, foreign direct investment does not respond (p = 0.21), and GDP growth shows only a transient spike. The pattern suggests that visions function as coordination devices that mobilize domestic capital but do not attract foreign investment or generate sustained growth. National visions resolve a coordination problem (where to invest?) but not a selection problem (invest in what?).

AI.tldr: 本文利用22个非石油国家愿景采纳事件的双重差分设计（1970-2020），发现国家级长期战略规划（国家愿景）使固定资本形成占GDP比重提高3.1个百分点，效果持续至少五年，但外国直接投资无响应且GDP增长仅有短暂脉冲。愿景作为协调机制动员国内资本，但无法解决投资选择问题。
AI.research_question: 国家级长期战略规划（国家愿景）对宏观经济（特别是投资和经济增长）有何影响？
AI.motivation: 国家愿景已成为发展中世界的普遍政策工具，但缺乏跨国层面的系统证据来评估其宏观经济效应。
AI.theoretical_framework: 协调机制理论——国家愿景解决的是投资协调问题（在哪里投资），而非选择问题（投资什么）。
AI.method: 双重差分设计（difference-in-differences），基于6个区域22个非石油国家愿景采纳事件（1970-2020），辅以时间与结果安慰剂检验、Fisher置换检验、石油国家证伪检验及预处理平衡检验。
AI.findings: 愿景采纳使固定资本形成占GDP比重提升3.1个百分点（p=0.003），22个事件中17个为正效应；效应在2-3年内逐步建立并持续至少5年；外国直接投资无显著响应（p=0.21）；GDP增长仅有短暂脉冲。
AI.theory_contributions: 区分了协调问题与选择问题——国家愿景作为协调机制能动员国内资本，但不能吸引外资或产生持续增长，丰富了国家规划与发展经济学的理论讨论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了国家愿景有效性的实证依据：愿景能动员国内投资，但需配合解决投资选择问题的配套措施，以实现持续经济增长。

title: Does Better Data Mean Better Finances? Statistical Capacity and Fiscal Sustainability in Africa
affiliations: University of Dschang - Faculty of Economics and Management, Nkafu Policy Institute, Nkafu Policy Institute, University of Dschang, University of Yaounde II and Nkafu Policy Institute

detail.title: Does Better Data Mean Better Finances? Statistical Capacity and Fiscal Sustainability in Africa

declarations.declarationOfInterest: No conflict of interest
declarations.ethicsApproval: No consent
declarations.funderStatement: No funding

detail.abstract: Despite theoretical arguments linking statistical capacity to fiscal performance, no empirical study has explicitly tested whether improvements in statistical systems enhance fiscal sustainability in Africa, nor has it identified the transmission channels. This study fills that gap. Using panel data for 54 African countries from 2016 to 2023, we employed pooled OLS, Driscoll-Kraay, quantile regression, Lewbel (2012) IV, and mediation analysis to examine the effect of the World Bank's Statistical Performance Index (SPI) on fiscal sustainability. Results consistently show that higher statistical capacity significantly improves fiscal sustainability: a one-point increase in SPI raises the primary-balance-based sustainability measure by 0.19-0.21 units. The effect is robust to alternative measures, disaggregated SPI components, outlier exclusion, and regional truncation. Quantile regressions reveal larger marginal returns for countries already in the upper tail of fiscal performance. Mediation analysis indicates that governance quality, particularly regulatory quality, corruption control, and the rule of law, accounts for 25-63% of the total effect. Policy implications include prioritising statistical investment in fiscal infrastructure, targeting governance channels, differentiating investments by capacity level, leveraging specific SPI subcomponents, and incorporating statistical capacity into debt sustainability frameworks. These findings establish statistical capacity as an actionable lever for fiscal resilience in Africa.

AI.tldr: 本研究首次实证检验了统计能力对非洲国家财政可持续性的影响，使用2016-2023年54个非洲国家的面板数据，发现统计绩效指数（SPI）每提高1分，财政可持续性指标提升0.19-0.21个单位，且治理质量（尤其是监管质量、腐败控制和法治）解释了25-63%的总效应。
AI.research_question: 统计系统的改进是否能够提升非洲的财政可持续性？其传导渠道是什么？
AI.motivation: 尽管理论上认为统计能力与财政绩效相关，但尚无实证研究明确检验统计系统改进是否能增强非洲的财政可持续性，也未识别其传导渠道。
AI.theoretical_framework: 统计能力与财政可持续性关系理论，治理质量中介机制理论
AI.method: 使用2016-2023年54个非洲国家的面板数据，采用混合OLS、Driscoll-Kraay稳健回归、分位数回归、Lewbel (2012)工具变量法和中介分析
AI.findings: 1）统计能力显著提升财政可持续性，SPI每提高1分，基于基本余额的可持续性指标提升0.19-0.21个单位；2）该效应在替代指标、SPI分解成分、剔除异常值和区域截断下均稳健；3）分位数回归显示财政绩效处于上尾的国家边际收益更大；4）中介分析表明治理质量（监管质量、腐败控制、法治）解释了25-63%的总效应。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次填补了统计能力与财政可持续性之间实证研究的空白，识别了治理质量作为关键传导渠道，并揭示了统计能力效应的异质性（分位数差异）。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出政策建议：优先投资财政基础设施中的统计建设、针对治理渠道施策、按能力水平差异化投资、利用特定SPI子成分、将统计能力纳入债务可持续性框架。

title: Memories of the Stock Market
affiliations: University of California, Los Angeles (UCLA)

detail.title: Memories of the Stock Market
detail.abstract: Factors such as personality or sentiment can color both recall and expectations across individuals and thus induce spurious associations between the two. Fortunately, it is a hallmark of (faulty) memory that a refresher can correct it. This makes it possible to isolate the causal within-subject link. In a survey here, respondents were asked to recall the 2025 and 2020-2025 S&P 500 market rates of return. They were also asked for expected rates of return before and after they were shown the correct historical values. The results provide strong evidence that memory plays a central role. Furthermore, memory correction worked not only through changing recall and expected returns, but also through changing "typical return" assessments.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过向受访者提供正确的历史市场回报率（记忆校正），分离出记忆中实际市场经验与预期回报之间的因果关联。结果显示，记忆在形成预期中起核心作用，且记忆校正不仅改变了回忆和预期回报，还改变了"典型回报"的评估。
AI.research_question: 个体的记忆是否因果性地影响其对市场回报的预期？如何通过记忆校正来识别这一因果关系？
AI.motivation: 个性和情绪等因素可能同时影响回忆和预期，导致两者之间出现虚假关联。利用"刷新（refresher）可以纠正（有缺陷的）记忆"这一特点，可以分离出个体内部的因果关联，从而解决内生性问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 记忆相关理论：记忆中的"刷新/校正"机制，即向个体提供正确的历史信息可以修正其有偏的回忆。
AI.method: 调查实验法：受访者被要求回忆2025年和2020-2025年标普500市场回报率，并在被展示正确历史数值前后分别报告其预期回报率。
AI.findings: 强有力的证据表明记忆在形成预期回报中扮演核心角色。记忆校正不仅通过改变回忆和预期回报起作用，还通过改变受访者对"典型回报"的评估起作用。
AI.theory_contributions: 将记忆确认为影响预期形成的因果机制，而非仅与预期存在相关关系；将"典型回报"评估纳入记忆影响预期的传导路径。
AI.practical_contributions: 对投资者教育和信息披露实践有启示：向投资者提供准确的历史回报信息可以帮助校正有偏的预期，改善决策。

title: Situational Fatherhood Archetypes: A Practice Framework for Community-Based Engagement Grounding a CHW Engagement Framework in Fatherhood Research, Trauma-Informed Care, and Behavior Change Science
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Situational Fatherhood Archetypes: A Practice Framework for Community-Based Engagement Grounding a CHW Engagement Framework in Fatherhood Research, Trauma-Informed Care, and Behavior Change Science

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no financial or personal relationships that could have inappropriately influenced, or be perceived to have influenced, the development of this work. The framework was developed in the context of professional practice in fatherhood engagement and maternal and child health.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Ethics approval was not required for this work because it does not report findings from a research study involving human participants, patient data, or identifiable case information. The paper presents a practice framework developed from professional experience and grounded in a synthesis of existing research and theory. The framework has not yet undergone formal empirical testing.
declarations.funderStatement: This work received no specific grant or external research funding from any public, commercial, or nonprofit funding agency.
declarations.clinicalTrialRegistration: Not applicable. This work does not report a clinical trial or other prospectively registered intervention study.

detail.abstract:
A father sits across from a Social Worker, answers every question with two words, and leaves without asking for anything. The program records him as disengaged and uninvolved. This framework asks a different question: what if disengagement is not who he is, but the state he is in, and what if the encounter itself is helping produce it?

This working paper introduces the Situational Fatherhood Archetypes, a practice framework for understanding and responding to fathers in community-based maternal and child health settings. It identifies five states in which fathers may present—Wounded, Disconnected, Emerging, Builder, and Mentor. These are not personality types, diagnostic labels, or developmental stages. They are a way of reading what may be happening with a father in a particular moment so that the practitioner can respond to where he actually is rather than where a program assumes he should be. A father may present as Disconnected in one setting and Builder in another; the archetypes describe the state, not the man.

The framework is grounded in fatherhood research, trauma-informed care, therapeutic alliance, Motivational Interviewing, reflective practice, mentalization, and environmental psychology. Together, these literatures support a central argument: father engagement cannot be understood by looking only at the father. Co-parenting relationships, structural pressures, institutional environments, and the posture of the helping professional all shape whether engagement is possible in a given encounter.

This matters because much of traditional fatherhood programming begins with information, curriculum, goal setting, assessment, or behavior change. Yet fathers experiencing threat, distrust, withdrawal, or significant stress may not initially be in a position to receive any of it. The framework therefore proposes a different sequencing logic: read the state, shape the environment, establish safety and relationship, and introduce content when there is somewhere for that content to land.

The Situational Fatherhood Archetypes are presented as a practice heuristic and testable framework, not a validated classification system. Their contribution is both practical and conceptual: they offer Community Health Workers and other nonclinical practitioners a behavioral vocabulary for interpreting father engagement without prematurely labeling fathers, while advancing a broader hypothesis—that improving father engagement may require changing not only what programs offer fathers, but also the relational and environmental conditions under which fathers are asked to engage.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了一个名为"情境性父亲原型"（Situational Fatherhood Archetypes）的实践框架，用于理解和回应社区母婴健康环境中的父亲参与问题。该框架识别出父亲可能呈现的五种状态——受伤、断开连接、新兴、建造者和导师，强调这些是情境状态而非人格标签。框架主张父亲参与不能仅通过观察父亲本身来理解，而需考虑共同养育关系、结构性压力、制度环境和助人专业人员的姿态。其核心贡献在于提供了实践启发式工具和可测试框架，改变传统父职项目的排序逻辑：先读取状态、塑造环境、建立安全与关系，再引入内容。
AI.research_question: 如何理解社区母婴健康环境中父亲呈现的"不参与"或"断开连接"状态？这些状态是否应被视为个人特质，还是情境性产物？实践者应如何基于父亲的实际状态而非项目假设来回应？
AI.motivation: 传统父亲参与项目通常以信息提供、课程教学、目标设定、评估或行为改变为起点，但对于经历威胁、不信任、退缩或显著压力的父亲而言，他们可能最初根本无处接收这些内容。此外，实践中父亲常被记录为"不参与"或"不投入"，这忽略了可能是情境和互动本身在共同塑造这种状态。需要一个框架来纠正以项目假设而非父亲实际情况为导向的实践缺陷。
AI.theoretical_framework: 该框架植根于多个理论文献：父职研究（fatherhood research）、创伤知情照护（trauma-informed care）、治疗联盟（therapeutic alliance）、动机性访谈（Motivational Interviewing）、反思性实践（reflective practice）、心智化（mentalization）以及环境心理学（environmental psychology）。
AI.method: 本文为工作论文，提出实践框架而非实证研究。方法论上采用了理论综合与概念建构的方法，基于多学科文献综述构建出五个情境性父亲原型（受伤、断开连接、新兴、建造者、导师），并将该框架定位为"实践启发式工具和可测试框架"，而非已验证的分类系统。
AI.findings: 框架的核心发现/主张包括：（1）父亲的不参与可能是情境状态而非人格特征，且互动本身可能正在帮助生产这种状态；（2）父亲可在一个环境中表现为"断开连接"，在另一个环境中表现为"建造者"，原型描述的是状态而非人本身；（3）父亲参与不能仅通过观察父亲来理解，共同养育关系、结构性压力、制度环境和专业人员姿态共同塑造参与可能性；（4）提出了不同的排序逻辑：先读状态、塑环境、建安全关系、再引入内容。
AI.theory_contributions: 概念层面：（1）推进了一个更广泛的假设——改善父亲参与可能不仅需要改变项目向父亲提供的内容，还需要改变父亲被邀请参与的关系和环境条件；（2）将父亲参与从个体层面的缺陷视角转向情境与关系的系统视角；（3）将创伤知情、心智化、治疗联盟等临床概念整合到社区非临床工作者的实践框架中。
AI.practical_contributions: 实践层面：（1）为社区卫生工作者和其他非临床实践者提供了行为词汇表，用于解读父亲参与情况而不带过早贴标签的风险；（2）提供了五种可操作的状态识别方式，帮助实践者回应父亲"实际所在之处"而非"项目假设应在之处"；（3）提供了一种避免将服务对象固化为"不参与"标签的替代性实践路径。

title: The EU Carbon Ledger's Missing Column: Measured, then Discarded

detail.title: The EU Carbon Ledger's Missing Column: Measured, then Discarded
detail.abstract: Carbon-removal certification frameworks measure energy consumption but retain only its carbon intensity. The European Union's Carbon Removals and Carbon Farming Regulation (CRCF) provides the most detailed regulatory example, covering direct air capture with carbon storage (DACCS) among other removal activities. Its implementing methodology converts every metered kilowatt-hour into a product with an emission factor. The amount of energy itself never enters the certificate. When that factor is zero, the energy quantity does not appear as an independent variable on the certified instrument. A plant consuming several times more energy per tonne can therefore certify identically to an efficient one if both source power at the same carbon intensity. For a technology whose binding constraint is energy rather than carbon, this is not a marginal accounting issue. It leaves the variable most directly related to scalability measured but unconstrained. This paper applies a structured reading of the CRCF methodology and its cross-references, compares the architecture against voluntary standards (Isometric, Verra) and US statutory frameworks (45Q, 45V), and positions the findings against the published carbon-accounting literature. The Q×EF mechanism is documented clause-by-clause through the methodology's equations. Three consequences follow: efficiency without recognition, additionality asymmetry, and permanence policed while energy is unpoliced. The same pattern recurs across voluntary and statutory frameworks: not EU-specific. Under Article 30(5), point (a), of Directive 2003/87/EC, as amended by Directive (EU) 2023/959, the Commission must report by 31 July 2026 on covering permanent removals under emissions trading; linkage would entrench the present architecture across compliance markets. This paper traces the mechanism through the regulation's own equations, names its consequences, and proposes a minimal remedy: a dual-reporting architecture in which carbon outcomes and physical performance are reported alongside one another, beginning with disclosure of energy per tonne, a figure the framework already collects and then discards.

AI.tldr: 本文批评欧盟碳移除认证框架（CRCF）的核算机制：该框架只记录电力的碳强度（EF），却丢弃了能源消耗量（Q）本身。由于Q×EF机制中当EF为零时，能源量不进入认证证书，导致高能耗与高能效的碳移除项目可以获得相同认证。论文通过逐条解读CRCF方法学及其交叉引用，对比自愿标准（Isometric, Verra）与美国法定框架（45Q, 45V），指出这一缺陷具有普遍性，并提出"双重报告"的补救方案：在碳结果之外同时报告物理性能指标（如每吨能耗）。
AI.research_question: 碳移除认证框架（尤其是欧盟CRCF）在核算能源时为何只保留碳强度而丢弃能源消耗量本身？这种"Q×EF"机制对碳移除技术的可扩展性监管造成了哪些后果，以及如何补救？
AI.motivation: 直接空气捕集与碳封存（DACCS）等碳移除技术的真正约束是能源而非碳。如果认证体系只追踪碳强度而不约束能源消耗，就遗漏了与可扩展性最直接相关的变量。随着2026年欧盟委员会需报告将永久移除纳入碳交易体系（ETS）的议题，这一架构缺陷可能被固化到合规市场中，亟需指正。
AI.theoretical_framework: 碳会计与碳核算理论；认证框架的监管架构分析；Q×EF乘法核算机制的解构。
AI.method: 结构化的规范性文本分析：逐条解读CRCF方法学的方程式和交叉引用，对比分析自愿标准（Isometric, Verra）与美国法定框架（45Q, 45V），并结合既有碳会计文献进行定位。
AI.findings: 三个后果：（1）能效无认可——高能效没有额外认证激励；（2）额外性不对称；（3）永久性受监管而能源消耗不受监管。该模式在自愿和法定框架中普遍存在，并非欧盟特有问题。Q×EF机制在EF为零时使能源量完全不出现在认证证书上，高能耗与高效项目可获相同认证。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了碳认证核算中"乘数机制"（Q×EF）的结构性盲区，指出碳会计文献对"测量但未约束"变量的理论忽视，提出"双重报告"架构作为碳会计理论的补充原则。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供具体的补救方案：在碳结果旁边同时报告物理性能指标，从披露每吨能耗开始（该数据框架本已收集但被丢弃）。对2026年欧盟委员会按指令2003/87/EC第30(5)(a)条向ETS覆盖永久移除的报告具有直接政策相关性。

title: A Monte Carlo Methodology for Comparing Group Health Funding Arrangements over Five-Year Horizons

detail.title: A Monte Carlo Methodology for Comparing Group Health Funding Arrangements over Five-Year Horizons

declarations.declarationOfInterest: Independent insurance agent and brokerage. Companies may decide to make a purchasing decision which will result in financial compensation.
declarations.ethicsApproval: N/A
declarations.funderStatement: No outside funders.

detail.abstract: Employers choosing among group health funding arrangements (fully insured, professional employer organization master plans, level-funded and traditional self-funding, group medical stop-loss captives, Taft-Hartley multi-employer trusts) typically decide on singleyear quotes, although the arrangements differ most in how they reprice after good and bad claims years. This paper documents the methodology of an open, browser-based Monte Carlo simulator that compares these arrangements over a five-year horizon on identical simulated claims. Annual group claims are modeled as the sum of three components: a deterministic baseline floor (35 percent of expected claims), a chronic component with first-order autoregressive memory, and a memoryless heavy-tailed catastrophe component, so the asymmetry between adverse and favorable years is structural rather than tuned. Aggregate volatility follows a square-root pooling law calibrated to published claims-concentration data. Stop-loss truncation separates what a self-funded employer pays from what its renewal is priced on. Each arrangement carries an explicit repricing rule, including a structural credibility formula for self-funded and captive renewals with no arbitrary floors. The model reproduces the claim distribution characteristics of a real 30-life captive quote and is mean-centered by construction. Every constant is traced to a source line of the deployed engine. The methodology is disclosed ahead of independent validation: no multi-year back-test against client renewal histories has yet been performed, and several calibrations rest on single quotes. Entry premiums and reimbursement assumptions are user-supplied inputs, not modeling claims.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了一个开源的、基于浏览器的蒙特卡洛模拟器方法，用于在五年时间范围内比较多种团体健康保险资金安排方式（完全保险、PEO主计划、水平资金化、传统自筹资金、止损再保险专属、Taft-Hartley多雇主信托）。该模型将年度团体理赔分解为三部分：确定性基线下限、具有一阶自回归记忆的慢性病部分、以及无记忆的重尾灾难部分。采用平方根聚合法则校准波动性，并为每种安排设定了明确的重新定价规则。
AI.research_question: 雇主在多种团体健康保险资金安排方式之间进行选择时，如何在五年时间范围内比较不同安排的风险和成本表现？特别是如何建模这些安排在实际理赔年后的重新定价差异？
AI.motivation: 雇主选择团体健康保险资金安排通常基于单年报价，但这些安排的主要差异在于好理赔年和坏理赔年之后如何重新定价。现有比较方法缺乏对多年动态风险的系统建模，需要一个能够在相同理赔基础上公平比较不同安排的模拟工具。
AI.theoretical_framework: 理赔建模基于三组件分解模型（确定性基线+慢性AR(1)成分+重尾灾难成分）；波动性采用平方根聚合法则（pooling law）；重新定价采用结构性可信度公式（credibility formula）；止损再保险用于分离雇主支付与续保定价依据。
AI.method: 构建浏览器端蒙特卡洛模拟器，对相同的模拟理赔数据在五种/六种资金安排下进行五年期比较。理赔建模包括三个相加组分，参数依据公开的理赔集中度数据校准。每种安排具有明确的重新定价规则，包含带结构性可信度公式的自筹资金和专属续保模型。所有常数均可追溯到部署引擎的源代码行。
AI.findings: 模型能够复现真实的30人专属计划报价的理赔分布特征，且按构造均值居中。模型揭示了不利年份与有利年份之间的结构性不对称，这种不对称源于灾难性理赔成分的重尾特性而非人为调参。方法论已公开以待独立验证，尚未进行多年度回溯测试。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个将理赔三组分分解与平方根聚合法则相结合的结构化建模框架，使得理赔的不对称性成为模型结构性特征而非调整参数；引入无任意下限的结构性可信度公式用于自筹资金和专属续保定价。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了一个开源、浏览器可访问的模拟工具，帮助雇主和顾问在多年时间范围内公平比较不同资金安排的真实成本差异，避免单年报价误导决策。所有输入和假设均透明公开，便于独立验证和审计。

title: Proximal Matching Prior Pairs: Tweedie's Formula, Moreau Envelopes and Subset Selection
affiliations: University of Chicago - Booth School of Business and

detail.title: Proximal Matching Prior Pairs: Tweedie's Formula, Moreau Envelopes and Subset Selection
detail.abstract: Posterior means and maximum a posteriori (MAP) estimates are the two standard summaries of a posterior, and they disagree. Recent work asks when a posterior mean under one prior coincides with a MAP estimate under another, and answers asymptotically using information geometry. For Gaussian models the question has a non-asymptotic answer, and it is proximal rather than geometric. Tweedie's formula makes the posterior mean the gradient of the potential ψ(y) = 1 2 ∥y∥ 2 + σ 2 log m(y), which is convex for every prior, while a MAP estimate is a proximal operator. Matching the two reduces to one identity: the Moreau envelope of the matched penalty is-σ 2 log m. Equivalently, the matched penalty is ψ *-1 2 ∥•∥ 2. Three consequences follow. A matching prior pair always exists in the Gaussian sequence model, and, in the Mahalanobis geometry of the design, for every full-rank regression design as well: orthogonality buys separability rather than exactness. The matched penalty is convex if and only if the posterior variance never exceeds the noise variance, which holds for log-concave priors and fails for every sparsity prior, so no convex penalty reproduces a sparse posterior mean. And the pair is computable: for a Laplace prior it is a smoothed ℓ 1 penalty, for spike-and-slab a smoothed ℓ 0 plus ridge penalty with sparsity constant log{1 + (1-w) √ σ 2 + τ 2 /(wσ)}, which recovers Bayesian ℓ 0 regularised least squares. Expanding in the sample size gives π MAP ∝ π exp{(σ 2 /2n)∆ log π} to O(n-2), sharpening the asymptotic condition by one order. In regression, optimising the matched penalty reproduces the spike-and-slab posterior mean to below Monte Carlo error on orthogonal designs, and to within about a tenth on correlated ones.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了后验均值与最大后验估计（MAP）之间的精确匹配问题。在高斯模型下，该问题有非渐近的答案，且本质上是近端（proximal）而非几何的。通过Tweedie公式，后验均值被表示为势函数的梯度，而MAP估计是近端算子。匹配二者等价于一个恒等式：匹配惩罚项的Moreau包络等于-σ²log m。由此得出三个关键推论：（1）在高斯序列模型和全秩回归设计中，匹配先验对总是存在；（2）匹配惩罚的凸性条件与后验方差有关，稀疏先验无法被凸惩罚重现；（3）匹配对可计算，例如Laplace先验对应平滑ℓ1惩罚，spike-and-slab先验对应平滑ℓ0加岭惩罚。
AI.research_question: 在多维高斯模型中，后验均值（posterior mean）与MAP估计何时能够在非渐近意义下精确匹配？匹配条件是什么？
AI.motivation: 后验均值与MAP估计是后验分布的两种标准摘要，二者通常不一致。已有工作通过信息几何给出了渐近答案，但缺乏非渐近的精确结果。本文旨在填补这一空白，为高斯模型提供精确的匹配条件。
AI.theoretical_framework: Tweedie公式、Moreau包络、近端算子理论、凸分析、信息几何（作为背景对照）
AI.method: （1）利用Tweedie公式将后验均值表示为势函数ψ(y)=½‖y‖²+σ²log m(y)的梯度；（2）将MAP估计识别为近端算子；（3）推导出匹配恒等式：匹配惩罚的Moreau包络等于-σ²log m；（4）推导匹配惩罚的具体表达式ψ*-½‖•‖²；（5）通过样本量展开获得高阶渐近修正；（6）在回归设计中数值验证。
AI.findings: （1）高斯序列模型及全秩回归设计中匹配先验对总是存在；（2）匹配惩罚的凸性等价于后验方差不超过噪声方差，对数凹先验满足而稀疏先验不满足，因此无凸惩罚能重现稀疏后验均值；（3）Laplace先验对应平滑ℓ1惩罚，spike-and-slab对应平滑ℓ0加岭惩罚，给出具体稀疏常数；（4）样本量展开得到π_MAP∝πexp{(σ²/2n)∆log π}至O(n⁻²)阶，将渐近条件精确化一个阶数；（5）回归中优化匹配惩罚在正交设计上可复现spike-and-slab后验均值至低于蒙特卡洛误差水平。
AI.theory_contributions: （1）将后验均值与MAP匹配问题从渐近信息几何视角拓展到非渐近的近端分析框架；（2）建立了Moreau包络与后验密度对数之间的精确恒等式，为贝叶斯推断与凸优化建立了新联系；（3）将渐近匹配条件精确化一个阶数；（4）给出了匹配惩罚凸性的完整刻画条件。
AI.practical_contributions: （1）提供了可计算的匹配惩罚显式形式（平滑ℓ1和平滑ℓ0加岭惩罚），可直接用于实际推断；（2）证明了在回归中优化匹配惩罚可以高效复现spike-and-slab后验均值，计算可行且精度高；（3）为稀疏问题中凸惩罚的局限性提供了明确的理论说明。

title: Fiscal Federalism and Firm Behavior Under Nigeria's 2026 Tax Reform: Evidence from VAT Derivation Reallocation and the Small-Company Notch

detail.title: Fiscal Federalism and Firm Behavior Under Nigeria's 2026 Tax Reform: Evidence from VAT Derivation Reallocation and the Small-Company Notch

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study does not involve human subjects, personal data, or primary data collection requiring informed consent. The empirical strategy relies exclusively on: (i) publicly available and administrative data, including Federation Account Allocation Committee (FAAC) disbursement records, state-level internally generated revenue (IGR) statistics published by the National Bureau of Statistics, and firm-level financial and turnover data obtained through Corporate Affairs Commission (CAC) registration records matched to Nigeria Revenue Service filings, all of which are anonymized, aggregated, or governed by existing public-records or commercial data-use provisions; and (ii) computationally simulated data generated solely to validate the estimation pipeline, as described in Section 6. No individual-level personal, medical, or identifying information is collected, processed, or disclosed. Accordingly, this research does not require institutional ethics board (IRB) review under standard economics research protocols. Should the study be extended to include primary data collection (e.g., surveys of state revenue officials, firm owners, or Joint Revenue Board personnel), appropriate ethics approval will be sought from the relevant institutional review board prior to that data collection commencing.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant or funding from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors. The author has no affiliation with, or financial interest in, the Nigeria Revenue Service, the Federal Ministry of Finance, any state government revenue authority, or any commercial data provider (including Bureau van Dijk/Moody's Orbis) referenced in this paper.

detail.abstract: Nigeria's 2025 Tax Reform Acts-the Nigeria Tax Act (NTA), the Nigeria Tax Administration Act, the Nigeria Revenue Service (Establishment) Act, and the Joint Revenue Board (Establishment) Act-took effect on 1 January 2026 and constitute the most comprehensive overhaul of Nigeria's tax system in decades, consolidating more than sixty federal levies into a unified framework, revising the formula governing derivation-based Value Added Tax (VAT) allocation across states, and raising the small-company Companies Income Tax (CIT) exemption threshold from ₦25 million to ₦100 million in annual turnover. This paper develops an empirical strategy to identify two causal effects of the reform using panel and firm-level methods analogous to those used to study OECD Pillar Two's effect on Swiss cantonal tax competition: first, whether the shift toward derivation-based VAT sharing causally increases fiscal effort (internally generated revenue mobilization) among states favorably exposed to the new formula relative to states unfavorably exposed; and second, whether firms bunch below the new ₦100 million CIT exemption threshold to avoid Companies Income Tax, Capital Gains Tax, and the newly introduced Development Levy. We situate the question within the tax capacity, fiscal federalism, and bunching literatures, specify a difference-indifferences and notch-bunching identification strategy using state-level Federation Account Allocation Committee (FAAC) and internally generated revenue (IGR) data alongside firm-level Corporate Affairs Commission (CAC) and Nigeria Revenue Service turnover data, and implement the full estimation pipeline in Python on a calibrated simulated panel to confirm computational feasibility ahead of real-data collection. We close with testable hypotheses, a discussion of the cogent gap this design fills in the Nigerian tax literature, and policy implications for state fiscal authorities and the Joint Revenue Board.

AI.tldr: 本文针对尼日利亚2025年税收改革法案（2026年生效），设计了一项实证研究策略，利用双重差分和断点聚束（notch-bunching）方法，识别改革的两类因果效应：（1）基于来源地原则的增值税分配公式变化对州级财政努力的影响；（2）公司所得税免征门槛从2500万奈拉提高至1亿奈拉后，企业是否聚集在门槛以下以避免纳税。论文基于校准模拟面板验证了计算可行性，并提出了可检验的假设。
AI.research_question: 尼日利亚2025年税收改革的两类因果效应是什么？（1）转向基于来源地的增值税分配是否因果性提升受益州的财政努力（内生收入动员）？（2）企业是否聚集在新的1亿奈拉CIT免征门槛以下以规避公司所得税、资本利得税和新增的发展税？
AI.motivation: 尼日利亚2025年税收改革是数十年来最全面的税制改革，整合了60多项联邦税种、修订了增值税州际分配公式、提高了小企业免征门槛，但其因果效应缺乏实证证据。作者借鉴OECD支柱二对瑞士各州税收竞争影响的研究方法，填补尼日利亚税收文献中这一显著空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 税收能力理论（tax capacity）、财政联邦主义（fiscal federalism）、断点聚束理论（bunching）
AI.method: 双重差分法（difference-in-differences）识别增值税分配公式变化对州级财政努力的影响；断点聚束法（notch-bunching）识别企业聚集于CIT免征门槛的行为。使用州级FAAC和IGR数据、企业级CAC和NRS营业额数据，并在校准模拟面板上用Python实现完整估计流程以验证计算可行性。
AI.findings: 论文目前处于研究设计阶段，尚未收集实际数据。作者通过校准模拟面板验证了估计流程的计算可行性，并提出了可检验的假设：受益于新分配公式的州将表现出更高的财政努力，企业将在1亿奈拉门槛以下出现聚束现象。
AI.theory_contributions: 将OECD Pillar Two对瑞士州际税收竞争的研究方法迁移至发展中国家语境，拓展了税收能力与财政联邦主义理论在非洲大型经济体的应用；首次在尼日利亚税收文献中提出双重差分与断点聚束相结合的双重因果识别框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为尼日利亚州级财政当局和联合税收委员会（Joint Revenue Board）提供改革效果评估和政策优化建议；为其他非洲发展中国家的大规模税制整合改革提供可复制的实证评估范式。

title:
The Impact of Free Natural Childbirth on Delivery Method Choice: 

Evidence from a Health Program in Iran
affiliations: Florida International University (FIU) - Department of Economics

detail.title:
The Impact of Free Natural Childbirth on Delivery Method Choice: 

Evidence from a Health Program in Iran

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare that they have no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study uses anonymized secondary administrative birth-record data. The authors had no access to personally identifiable information and had no direct interaction with study participants. Ethics approval and informed consent were not required under the applicable institutional and national regulations.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract:
The cesarean delivery rate in Iran has been steadily increasing, prompting the Ministry of Health and Medical Education to implement the 2014 Healthcare Reform Plan, which aimed to reduce cesarean sections by offering free natural childbirth in public hospitals. This study evaluates the effectiveness of the policy using a Difference-in-Differences (DiD) as the primary identification strategy, supplemented by sharp Regression Discontinuity Design (RDD) as a robustness check. The analysis is based on 3,715,457 deliveries recorded between 2013 and 2016, providing comprehensive demographic and medical details of mothers and neonates. 

Looking at DiD results, we see a significant drop of about 2 to 4 percentage point in total cesareans, increasing in absolute amount from 1 month to 3 months which attenuates in the full sample may be suggesting and early response, followed by some adaptation or even other unrelated changes may have played a role since, DiD covers a longer period, this effect is mainly driven by non-elective cesareans. Then we see significant drops in non-elective cesarean which are the urgent ones and those due to having former cesarean. It may reflect a slower response from providers. There might be several mechanisms. 

Looking at RDD, there is a sharp and significant drop in elective cesarean right at the policy cutoff. It’s good since it fits what we would expect, these are scheduled procedures and respond quickly to cost. RDD findings indicate that the policy led to a modest reduction in elective cesarean sections, with a more pronounced effect among first-time mothers. However, as expected, no significant impact was observed on non-elective cesareans, which constitute most cesarean deliveries. The results show roughly 1 percentage point reduction in elective (CDMR) cesareans in the public sector. 

While the relative reduction in non-elective (non-CDMR) cesareans was approximately 11%, this figure is primarily driven by the small baseline proportion of non-urgent cesareans, which accounted for only 7% of all cesareans in the public sector. Consequently, the absolute reduction in cesarean sections was minimal relative to total cesareans and overall deliveries, raising concerns about the policy’s effectiveness in achieving a meaningful systemic change. Overall, the results are consistent across both methods with RDD showing short-run effects while DiD capturing longer-run changes. 

To validate these findings, placebo and falsification tests were conducted, confirming that the observed effects are attributable to the policy rather than external factors. Additionally, concerns regarding strategic behavior, such as potential reclassification of cesareans as urgent and manipulation of reporting practices by hospitals to meet policy targets, were investigated. An additional RDD analysis using reporting dates as cutoffs found no statistical evidence of systematic gaming, although the possibility remains an area for further research. 

Despite the limited absolute impact of the policy, continued financial support has been allocated to supporting natural childbirth under this reform. Given the small proportion of non-urgent cesareans relative to total cesareans, alongside the fact that urgent cesareans remain the predominant category, a cost-benefit analysis is warranted to assess whether the policy’s continuation is economically justified. Alternatively, resources might be more effectively allocated toward prenatal care, labor management, maternal health services, and education on delivery risks and benefits. Such an approach could prioritize preventing conditions that lead to urgent cesareans, rather than directly targeting urgent cesareans themselves or focusing solely on reducing non-urgent cesareans. 

These findings underscore the importance of evaluating both absolute and relative effects when designing and assessing healthcare policies and highlight the need for careful policy formulation in performance-based healthcare reforms to mitigate potential distortions in provider behavior.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用2013-2016年伊朗371.5万例分娩数据，通过双重差分法（DiD）和断点回归设计（RDD）评估2014年伊朗医疗改革计划中"公立医院免费自然分娩"政策对降低剖宫产率的有效性。结果发现政策在短期内显著降低了择期剖宫产率约1个百分点（主要影响初产妇），长期看降低了非择期剖宫产约11%（相对比例）但绝对减少量极小，总体政策效果有限，需进行成本效益分析。
AI.research_question: 伊朗2014年医疗改革计划中免费自然分娩政策是否能有效降低剖宫产率？其短期和长期效果如何？
AI.motivation: 伊朗剖宫产率持续上升，卫生部实施了2014年医疗改革计划，通过公立医院提供免费自然分娩来降低剖宫产率。该研究旨在评估这一政策的实际效果，为医疗政策和资源分配提供依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于成本-激励理论，认为经济激励（免费自然分娩）会影响产妇和医生的决策行为。同时考虑提供者行为适应理论，即医生和医院可能会调整行为以应对政策目标。
AI.method: 采用双重差分法（DiD）作为主要识别策略，辅以尖锐断点回归设计（RDD）作为稳健性检验。分析了2013-2016年间3,715,457例分娩记录，并进行安慰剂检验和伪造检验，以及考察医院报告操纵和剖宫产重新分类等策略性行为。
AI.findings: DiD显示总剖宫产率下降2-4个百分点（主要由非择期剖宫产驱动），随时间推移效应衰减；RDD显示政策切断点处择期剖宫产率显著下降约1个百分点（初产妇效应更明显），但非择期剖宫产无显著变化。非择期剖宫产相对下降约11%，但由于其基线占比极小（公立部门仅7%），绝对减少量非常有限。安慰剂和伪造检验确认效应归因于政策，未发现系统性医院报告操纵证据。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了政策评估中绝对效果与相对效果的区分重要性，扩展了医疗改革政策短期与长期效应差异的理解，为绩效导向型医疗改革中提供者行为扭曲的理论讨论提供了实证证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为伊朗及其他国家医疗政策制定者提供了免费自然分娩政策的实证评估依据，建议重新评估该政策的成本效益，并考虑将资源转向产前护理、分娩管理和产妇健康教育等领域，以预防紧急剖宫产的根本原因。

title: Reimagining Corporate Governance in the AI Era: Law, Legitimacy, and Algorithmic Power
affiliations: and University of Navarra

detail.title: Reimagining Corporate Governance in the AI Era: Law, Legitimacy, and Algorithmic Power
detail.abstract: Corporations play a foundational role in the global economy, yet persistent gaps remain between corporate governance ideals, legal frameworks, and organisational practice. The rapid integration of artificial intelligence, particularly generative AI and large language models, intensifies these challenges by reshaping corporate decision making, compliance, and accountability. This paper examines how AI both promises to alleviate long standing governance problems, such as information asymmetries and managerial opportunism, and generates new risks arising from opacity, automation bias, and diminished human oversight. It analyses five interrelated areas of tension: the emerging AI governance gap; models of AI integration within corporate structures; the adaptation of directors' duties to algorithmic decision making; the transparency paradox created by AI mediated disclosure; and the problem of anthropomorphism, whereby attributing agency to AI risks obscuring human responsibility. Rather than offering definitive solutions, the paper identifies critical questions corporate law must confront as automated and semi automated corporations become an established reality. It argues that sustaining legitimacy in the AI era requires renewed emphasis on human judgment, board level oversight, and adaptive governance frameworks capable of reconciling technological power with legal accountability and societal expectations.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了人工智能（特别是生成式AI和大语言模型）如何既有望缓解公司治理中长期存在的问题（如信息不对称和管理者机会主义），又带来因不透明性、自动化偏见和人类监督削弱而产生的新风险。论文分析了五大相互关联的紧张领域：AI治理缺口、AI在公司结构中的整合模式、董事义务对算法决策的适应性调整、AI中介披露造成的透明度悖论，以及拟人化问题。论文主张在AI时代维持合法性需要重新强调人类判断、董事会层面的监督和适应性治理框架。
AI.research_question: 人工智能如何重塑公司治理？它既缓解又加剧了哪些治理问题？公司法在自动化和半自动化公司成为现实的过程中必须面对哪些关键问题？
AI.motivation: 公司治理理想、法律框架和组织实践之间长期存在差距，而生成式AI和大语言模型的快速整合进一步加剧了这些挑战，重塑了公司决策、合规和问责机制，亟需理论上的系统审视。
AI.theoretical_framework: 本文基于公司治理理论（涉及信息不对称、管理者机会主义、董事义务与问责）、AI伦理与治理理论（涉及算法不透明性、自动化偏见、拟人化），以及合法性理论（涉及法律问责与社会期望的调和）。
AI.method: 本文采用概念性/规范性分析方法，通过系统识别和剖析公司治理与AI交叉领域的五大紧张关系领域，进行理论推演和法律分析，而非实证研究。
AI.findings: 论文识别出五大关键紧张领域：1）新兴AI治理缺口；2）AI在公司结构中的整合模式；3）董事义务对算法决策的适应；4）AI中介披露导致的透明度悖论；5）拟人化问题——将能动性归因于AI可能模糊人类责任。论文主张需重新强调人类判断、董事会监督和适应性治理框架来维持合法性。
AI.theory_contributions: 本文系统性地将AI治理议题引入公司法与公司治理理论，提出"透明度悖论"和"拟人化"作为分析AI环境中公司问责的新概念框架，并论证了在算法决策时代董事义务和人类监督的理论调适方向。
AI.practical_contributions: 论文为公司法立法者、董事会成员和监管机构提供了需要优先应对的关键治理问题清单，包括AI治理缺口的填补、董事对算法决策的监督义务、AI披露机制的设计，以及在自动化背景下确保人类问责制落地的实践指引。

title: What Drives AI VTuber Consumption? Exploration of Perceived Value and Brand Loyalty among Chinese Young ACG Fans

detail.title: What Drives AI VTuber Consumption? Exploration of Perceived Value and Brand Loyalty among Chinese Young ACG Fans

declarations.ethicsApproval: All interview participants provided voluntary informed consent before the conversation. All interview transcripts were fully anonymized without any identifiable personal information, and all raw audio files will be deleted after this research. This study complies with the research ethical norms of Xi'an Jiaotong-Liverpool University.

detail.abstract: With the advancement of the digital economy, AI VTubers have emerged as a new paradigm in the virtual entertainment industry. While consumer behavior toward live-action VTubers has been extensively studied, the mechanisms underlying audience engagement with AI personas remain under explored. To address this gap, this study conducted a qualitative analysis of Neuro-sama. The findings reveal that hedonic and emotional values drive short-term tipping behaviors, whereas the core "stability value", by mitigating emotional risks and cognitive costs, serves as the foundation for long-term loyalty. Fan trust is built through AI behavioral consistency and developers' technical sincerity, continuously reinforced by participatory evolution via "cyber cultivation" and "swarm" community identification. This research expands the boundaries of the perceived value and brand relationship quality theory, offering practical insights for AI virtual idol operators to establish competitive advantages through the strategic use of "certainty".

AI.tldr: 本研究通过对AI虚拟主播Neuro-sama的质性分析，揭示了AI虚拟主播受众参与行为的机制：享乐与情感价值驱动短期打赏行为，而核心的"稳定性价值"通过降低情感风险和认知成本成为长期忠诚的基础。粉丝信任通过AI行为一致性与开发者技术诚意建立，并通过"赛博养成"和"蜂群"社群认同的参与式进化不断强化。
AI.research_question: 受众与AI虚拟人物（AI VTubers）之间的参与机制是什么？与真人虚拟主播相比，受众对AI人格的参与行为有何独特机制？
AI.motivation: 数字经济时代AI虚拟主播成为虚拟娱乐产业的新范式，但现有研究主要聚焦于真人虚拟主播的消费者行为，对受众与AI人格之间的参与机制探索不足，存在研究空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 感知价值理论（Perceived Value Theory）与品牌关系质量理论（Brand Relationship Quality Theory）
AI.method: 质性分析（Qualitative Analysis），以AI虚拟主播Neuro-sama为案例研究对象
AI.findings: 1. 享乐价值和情感价值驱动短期打赏行为；2. "稳定性价值"（stability value）通过缓解情感风险和认知成本，构成长期忠诚的基础；3. 粉丝信任通过AI行为一致性和开发者技术诚意建立；4. "赛博养成"（cyber cultivation）和"蜂群"（swarm）社群认同的参与式进化不断强化信任。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了感知价值理论和品牌关系质量理论在AI虚拟偶像情境下的适用边界，引入了"稳定性价值"这一新的价值维度。
AI.practical_contributions: 为AI虚拟偶像运营者提供实践见解，即通过战略性运用"确定性"来建立竞争优势。

title: Employing Big Data Capability in the Face of Fierce Competition: Exploring the Synergy Between Market Orientation, Marketing Strategies, and Innovation Capabilities

detail.title: Employing Big Data Capability in the Face of Fierce Competition: Exploring the Synergy Between Market Orientation, Marketing Strategies, and Innovation Capabilities
detail.abstract: Fueled by big data, the information age offers firms opportunities to enhance marketing efficiency and drive innovation. For that, based on conceptualizing big data capability as a threefactor construct integrating business, human, and technology resources and employing a resource-based view (RBV) and dynamic capabilities theory (DCT), we build a model showing how market orientation leads to the advancement of marketing and innovation capabilities through the effective use of big data, thereby, positioning big data capability as a mediating factor. We then highlight how the competitive intensity of a firm's industry, as a moderator, strengthens the capacity for big data to translate to capabilities. This model highlights the operational impact of big data capability and extends the RBV and DCT by integrating the moderating effects of competitive intensity on these capabilities. This investigation introduces an advanced understanding of the link between market orientation and big data capability. It offers theoretical contributions and practical recommendations for professionals in competitive markets.

AI.tldr: 本文基于资源基础观（RBV）和动态能力理论（DCT），将大数据能力概念化为包含业务、人力和技术资源的三因素构念，构建了一个模型，展示市场导向如何通过有效利用大数据来推动营销能力和创新能力的提升，并将大数据能力定位为中介变量，同时考察行业竞争强度作为调节变量如何强化大数据向能力转化的过程。
AI.research_question: 市场导向如何通过大数据能力的中介作用促进企业营销能力和创新能力的发展，以及行业竞争强度如何调节这一转化过程？
AI.motivation: 在大数据驱动的信息时代，企业有机会提升营销效率和推动创新，但现有研究对大数据能力如何从资源转化为实际组织能力的机制尚缺乏深入理解，需要构建理论模型来解释这一过程。
AI.theoretical_framework: 资源基础观（RBV）和动态能力理论（DCT）
AI.method: 概念建模与理论构建——本文通过将大数据能力概念化为业务资源、人力资源和技术资源的三因素整合构念，构建中介-调节的理论模型。
AI.findings: 市场导向通过大数据能力的中介作用推动营销能力和创新能力的提升；行业竞争强度作为调节变量，强化大数据能力向组织能力转化的效力。
AI.theory_contributions: 将大数据能力定位为市场导向与营销/创新能力之间的中介机制，拓展了RBV和DCT的理论应用；将行业竞争强度的调节效应整合进RBV和DCT框架中。
AI.practical_contributions: 为竞争市场中的企业管理者提供数据驱动营销与创新的实践建议，帮助企业理解如何有效构建和利用大数据能力来提升组织竞争力。

title: Short-term Impact of Institutional AI Access on Undergraduate Academic Performance
affiliations: California State University, Northridge - Department of Economics

detail.title: Short-term Impact of Institutional AI Access on Undergraduate Academic Performance

declarations.ethicsApproval: This study was reviewed and determined to be exempt from further review by the Institutional Review Board of California State University, Northridge (Protocol IRB-FY26-349).

detail.abstract: This paper evaluates the short-run effects of an institutional AI access policy that expanded the availability of AI tools by providing ChatGPT Edu accounts to all students at a large public university. The analysis uses student-level data from multiple sections of Principles of Macroeconomics taught one year before and after the policy's implementation under otherwise identical course conditions. The results suggest that expanded institutional AI access was associated with a decline of approximately 8.5 points on a 100-point exam scale. At the same time, students spent substantially less time completing course assignments and submitted fewer attempts, despite achieving largely unchanged assignment scores. A heterogeneity analysis based on students' prior academic preparation also provides suggestive evidence that the AI access policy affected students differently, with students having stronger prior academic preparation generally appearing less adversely affected. The findings suggest that expanded AI access may not only affect short-run academic performance, but also alter how students engage with course material and adapt their learning strategies, highlighting the importance of understanding behavioral responses as institutions evaluate the implications of AI access policies for human capital development.

AI.tldr: 本文评估了一项机构性AI访问政策——向一所大型公立大学所有学生提供ChatGPT Edu账户——的短期影响。基于同一门宏观经济学原理课程在政策实施前后各一年的学生数据，研究发现扩大AI访问与考试成绩下降约8.5分（百分制）相关，同时学生完成作业的时间大幅减少、提交次数减少，但作业成绩基本不变。异质性分析显示，先前学业准备较强的学生受不利影响较小。研究表明扩大AI访问不仅影响短期学业表现，还会改变学生的学习参与方式与策略。
AI.research_question: 机构性AI访问政策（扩大AI工具可得性）如何影响学生的短期学业表现和学习行为？
AI.motivation: 随着高校越来越多地实施AI访问政策（如提供ChatGPT Edu给所有学生），需要实证评估这些政策对学生学业表现和人力资本发展的短期影响，特别是了解学生行为层面的适应性变化。
AI.theoretical_framework: 人力资本发展理论、学习行为适应理论（AI工具的可得性如何改变学生的学习策略与时间投入）
AI.method: 准自然实验设计：利用政策实施前后的时间对比，对同一课程（宏观经济学原理）多个班次的学生级数据进行差异比较分析，并依据学生先前学业准备进行异质性分析。
AI.findings: 1) 扩大AI访问与考试分数下降约8.5分（百分制）相关；2) 学生完成作业时间显著减少，提交次数减少，但作业成绩基本不变；3) 异质性分析显示，先前学业准备较强的学生受不利影响较小。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了AI政策对人力资本开发影响的实证研究；揭示了AI工具可得性不仅影响短期成绩，还会改变学生的学习参与和策略适应机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为高校制定AI访问政策提供实证依据，提示机构在推广AI工具时需关注其对学生学习行为和学业表现可能产生的负面影响，并考虑差异化支持策略。

title: Salesperson Moral Identity and Value Co-Creation
affiliations: , The University of Texas at Arlington and Iowa State-Ivy College of Business

detail.title: Salesperson Moral Identity and Value Co-Creation
detail.abstract: Purpose-The purpose of this study is to examine the role of salesperson moral identity centrality in value cocreation. This study identified and tested an extended identity-based formation process of selling orientation, customer orientation and value co-creation. This was accomplished by examining the role of inclusion of others in the self and circle of moral regard in the mechanism through which moral identity centrality impacts selling orientation, customer orientation and value co-creation, taking into account the contingency role of salesperson self-construal. Design/methodology/approach-An extended identity-behavior model grounded in identity theory and the social-cognitive perspective of moral identity centrality was tested. The study used survey data from business-to-business salespeople. Data collected was analyzed using structural equation modeling. Findings-The results show that a central moral identity to a salesperson's self-drives higher expansion of the salesperson's circle of moral regard. This process facilitates the mechanisms for salesperson moral identity centrality to decrease selling orientation and increase customer orientation and value co-creation, leading to higher sales performance.
